title.ja: 月影島事件

summary: 柯南受委托前往月影岛调查麻生圭二相关事件，案件推动了早期作品的调查与推理基调。

culprit.zhHans: 浅井成实，真实身份为麻生成实；以女性身份在月影岛行医。

motive.zhHans: 为十二年前被杀害的父亲麻生圭二及家人复仇；相关岛上人物曾利用父亲的国际演奏活动掩护毒品交易。

method.zhHans: 利用钢琴房、录音播放、月光奏鸣曲乐谱暗号、现场布置和伪造自杀痕迹制造连续案件与不在场效果。

evidence.zhHans: 乐谱暗号、钢琴调音痕迹、录音播放时间、现场拖拽痕迹以及与旧案和受害者关系相互印证。

resolution.zhHans: 身份和案件真相被柯南推理揭示后，成实在燃烧的钢琴房中自杀；临终将柯南抛出窗外，并留下感谢侦探的音乐暗号。

suspectsZh: 两名戴墨镜的留胡男子

title.ja: 外交官殺人事件

summary: 服部平次登场并与柯南展开推理较量的重要早期案件。

motive.zhHans: 为女儿雪子及山城家遭受的旧案复仇；她认为丈夫津村功曾参与毁掉山城家的人生。

method.zhHans: 先用安眠药使丈夫昏睡，再用藏在钥匙扣吊坠中的毒针刺杀；随后利用钥匙扣和鱼线布置假密室，制造受害者死于封闭房间的假象。

evidence.zhHans: 毒针与钥匙扣、安眠药、鱼线布置、假密室机关以及案件现场的时间和物证相互印证。

resolution.zhHans: 公江在推理揭示后认罪并向警方投案；她请求高志照顾雪子，高志答应，案件结束。

title.ja: 図書館殺人事件

summary: 少年侦探团在米花图书馆调查失踪员工与藏毒书籍，案件涉及电梯和无书脊伪书的异常线索。

motive.zhHans: 津川在米花图书馆的无书脊伪书中藏匿毒品并逐批出售；馆长玉田发现了毒品，因此津川为灭口杀害玉田。

method.zhHans: 津川杀害玉田后，将尸体从电梯井抛下并藏在电梯箱顶部；同时把藏毒的无书脊伪书排成儿童区的第三排，制造书架排列异常。

evidence.zhHans: 电梯在载荷看似不足时触发超重警报，提示电梯箱顶部有尸体；儿童区书架出现由无书脊伪书形成的第三排，且书籍排列不齐；书中藏有毒品。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南根据电梯超重警报、尸体位置和藏毒伪书的排列机关识破案件，津川作为犯人被揭发。

title.zhHans: 高尔夫练习场杀人事件
title.zhHant: 高爾夫練習場殺人事件
title.ja: ゴルフ練習場殺人事件
title.en: The Golf Driving Range Murder Case

summary: 高尔夫练习场发生爆炸杀人案，柯南从球杆与高尔夫球的异常中追查真正的爆炸机关。

motive.zhHans: 南智史因上司忽视自己的才能，并偏袒对阿部稔，于是杀害上司并试图嫁祸阿部。

method.zhHans: 把炸弹预先藏进修理过的球杆头内的高尔夫球中，使目标挥杆时发生爆炸；同时准备替代球，并假装胃痛让阿部收集目标要使用的球，以制造嫁祸条件。

evidence.zhHans: 南智史曾连续两晚接触并维修目标的球杆；现场发现的高尔夫球只是替代物；真正的爆炸球藏在球杆头内，爆炸方式与球杆机关相互印证。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南识破球杆头内高尔夫球炸弹和嫁祸阿部的计划，南智史作为犯人被揭发。

victims.name: Eisuke Tachibana (fatal) and Tatsuya Okubo (not fatal)
victims.causeOfDeathZh: 高尔夫球炸弹爆炸致死
victims.nameZh: 立花英介（致死）与大久保达也（未致死）

suspects: Minoru Yasui, Tatsuya Okubo, and Tomofumi Minami
suspectsZh: 安井实、大久保龙也与南知文

title.ja: 謎の凶器殺人事件

summary: 公寓阳台发生钝器杀人案，柯南从花盆破损、钓鱼线痕迹和现场印记中追查隐藏的钓鱼竿凶器。

motive.zhHans: 被害人井本龙介关闭了寺泽经营的钓具店，并准备将店址改作公司财产；在拒绝寺泽请求、又折断其珍贵鱼竿后，寺泽决定杀人。

method.zhHans: 寺泽用钓鱼竿发射铅坠击中井本头部，并利用破碎的向日葵花盆制造被钝器直接击打的假象。

evidence.zhHans: 邻室废弃公寓留下的深刻印记符合甩竿姿势；阳台栏杆有铅坠撞击痕迹，飞鸟也曾被误击；现场找到带有寺泽指纹的鱼竿握柄。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南通过甩竿痕迹、栏杆撞击痕迹和带指纹的鱼竿握柄揭露寺泽为犯人。

suspects: Takako Imoto, Tetsuo Dobashi, and Norio Terasawa
suspectsZh: 井本贵子、土桥哲夫与寺泽德夫

title.ja: ゲーム会社殺人事件

summary: 游戏公司发布会发生爆炸误杀，柯南追查 Tequila、交换手提箱和黑衣组织情报交易之间的关系。

motive.zhHans: 竹下认为中岛秀明抛弃曾与两人交往的大学拳击部经理吉美，导致吉美自杀，因此杀害中岛并试图嫁祸。

method.zhHans: 竹下事先调换手提箱编号，使装有炸弹的箱子在中岛与 Tequila 交换时误交给 Tequila，利用爆炸杀死目标但实际造成 Tequila 误中。

evidence.zhHans: 中岛手提箱的钥匙能打开竹下手中的箱子；竹下在得知中岛箱内只有 Tequila 给的钱时表现出异常；酒店号码、调换编号和爆炸箱形成完整证据链。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南揭示手提箱调换和炸弹机关，竹下认罪；随后柯南前往 Tequila 的联络地点，发现琴酒和伏特加为灭口而引发爆炸。

suspects: Hideaki Nakajima, Koji Ueda, and Hironobu Takeshita
suspectsZh: 中岛英明、上田浩司与竹下博信

title.ja: 列車トリック殺人事件

summary: 跨线列车之间存在时间差，柯南调查一名嫌疑人与另一列车受害者之间看似不可能的移动和毒杀。

motive.zhHans: 受害者内海掌握伊达收受药企回扣的证据并以此勒索；伊达不想继续被勒索，因此决定杀死内海。

method.zhHans: 伊达在水之川站下车后戴上假胡子和帽子、翻转外套伪装，再换乘受害者所在的列车；通过电话谎称遗失物品拖延列车，接近内海后用注射器注入诱发心脏病的药物，并抢走硬币伪装成随机抢劫。

evidence.zhHans: 硬币原本由列车女服务员找零给内海，若硬币上出现女服务员指纹，就能证明硬币曾随内海转移到另一列车并证明伊达在案发列车上；假装借款和抢劫动机也无法解释这一指纹证据。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南揭示跨线换车、伪装、拖延列车和硬币指纹证据，伊达在证据链面前崩溃并认罪。

title.zhHans: 小じゃマンボウ杀人事件
title.zhHant: 小じゃマンボウ殺人事件
title.ja: おじゃマンボウ殺人事件

summary: 清洁公司附近发生钢梁坠落杀人案，柯南从口琴、屋顶监控和反光观察机关中追查犯人。

motive.zhHans: 被害人藤井常久与中山的妹妹分手，导致妹妹退出小じゃマンボウ清洁公司，并在横滨工地工作时遭遇致命事故；中山从妹妹日记得知此事后决定复仇。

method.zhHans: 中山把口琴放在地面诱使藤井弯腰，再把清洁公司卡车停在对面利用反光观察藤井的位置；他将屋顶钢梁与监控摄像机用钢丝连接，通过监控画面掌握时机远程放下钢梁。

evidence.zhHans: 屋顶由中山公司安装的监控摄像机拍到了中山自己的倒影；口琴上没有藤井或犯人的指纹；摄像机与钢梁之间的钢丝机关说明中山具备并利用了作案条件。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南根据监控画面中的倒影、口琴指纹缺失和钢梁远程机关揭露中山为犯人。

title.ja: ホームズフリーク殺人事件

summary: 柯南、兰、小五郎和服部参加福尔摩斯迷聚会，案件围绕多起伪装事故、艾琳·艾德勒争议和服部对柯南身份的怀疑展开。

motive.zhHans: 户野健人憎恨小说《Irene Adler Sneer》对艾琳·艾德勒的侮辱；该作品由广之和俊明创作，书中让福尔摩斯遭到艾琳嘲笑。

method.zhHans: 户野先杀害广之，将尸体放入汽车并踩住刹车，开暖气、挂挡后打开车库使汽车驶入海中；将尸体抛下悬崖掩盖死亡时间。随后以漏油、断电和打火机制造车库火灾，并利用断电机会刺杀俊明。

evidence.zhHans: 绫子试图抄写众人填写的问卷，却发现户野的问卷一题未答，说明他预先知道主人会死亡；汽车机关、车库火灾和断电时机共同指向户野。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南揭示户野的多段伪装事故和问卷证据，户野在证据面前承认犯案；案件后柯南向服部平次说明自己缩小前后的真实身份。

title.ja: 初めてのお使い殺人事件

summary: 少年侦探团追查一名孩子在废弃商店附近目击到的杀人案，案件起因与商店拆迁有关。

motive.zhHans: 村濑经营的商店即将被拆除，负责拆除的掮客要把店址推平；村濑因不愿失去商店而杀死了对方。

method.zhHans: 村濑在废弃商店处杀害负责拆迁的掮客，并在孩子经过时误以为孩子看见了自己，从而试图灭口。

evidence.zhHans: 村濑对孩子在废弃商店出现表现出异常恐惧；孩子只是去旧商店购买物品，并未真正看见杀人过程，村濑的反应反而暴露了其心理。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南和少年侦探团救下孩子并揭示商店拆迁背景，村濑因意识到自己误判孩子目击情况而崩溃认罪。

title.ja: イラストレーター殺人事件

summary: 插画家长野泉死亡后被伪装成自杀，柯南从蝴蝶标记、绘画署名和阳台机关追查花冈健仁。

motive.zhHans: 长野泉是花冈的幽灵画师和秘密情人，花冈的大部分作品实际由她创作；泉要求他离婚并以揭露关系和代笔事实施压，花冈因此失控杀人。

method.zhHans: 花冈用水晶烟灰缸击打泉致死，把尸体倚在阳台并用鱼线、花盆和门上的钉子组成机关；开门后花盆脱落，鱼线和尸体被拉向排水口，制造自杀假象。

evidence.zhHans: 泉作品中的蝴蝶标记、花冈脚趾甲上被指甲油留下的蝴蝶标记，以及阳台鱼线机关共同指向花冈；花冈声称从未到过现场也与机关矛盾。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南通过蝴蝶标记和阳台机关揭穿花冈伪造自杀的计划，花冈最终承认因泉要求他面对婚姻和代笔事实而杀人。

title.ja: 幽霊船殺人事件

summary: 志木岛发现与幽灵船和失踪黄金有关的连续杀人线索，柯南在岛上追查伪造枪击和黄金藏匿地点。

motive.zhHans: 木下为寻找志木岛幽灵船失踪的黄金而追杀掌握线索的人，目标是独占被埋藏的巨额黄金。

method.zhHans: 木下为逼问滨田浩二而绑架并折磨他，随后杀害知情者；他伪造上原的枪击自杀，并试图把杀人罪嫁祸给毛利小五郎；之后又杀死上原并袭击柯南和三上铃。

evidence.zhHans: 上原的枪伤位于错误的一侧，枪被放在错误的手中；伤口附近有火药灼痕，说明枪击距离和方向与自杀不符；黄金砖块被苔藓覆盖，揭示其长期藏在洞穴废墟中。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南揭露伪造枪击、黄金藏匿和嫁祸计划，木下被制服；黄金原本埋在废墟中，岛民因此一直以为诅咒和债务已经结束。

title.zhHans: 大怪兽哥美拉杀人事件
title.zhHant: 大怪獸哥美拉殺人事件
title.ja: 大怪獣ゴメラ殺人事件

summary: 少年侦探团参观哥美拉电影拍摄现场时，制片人龟井在片场被杀，现场脚印让人以为是怪兽哥美拉行凶。

culprit.zhHans: 松井秀豪（Shugo Matsui），即哥美拉皮套演员。

motive.zhHans: 龟井散布“松井厌倦演哥美拉、想转向其他角色”的流言，松井得知后不愿最后一部哥美拉电影完成，于是杀害龟井。

method.zhHans: 松井事先用哥美拉皮套脚部印出脚印并涂上颜料，让人以为足立留下痕迹；行凶后在楼梯处脱下皮套，跑进楼下储物间把皮套从窗户丢出并点火，制造怪兽行凶的假象；他先用影视道具血伪装腿伤，事后又用另一把刀刺伤自己的腿并把刀藏进道具箱，还换掉衬衫以掩盖出汗痕迹。

evidence.zhHans: 地面只有哥美拉的脚印而没有尾痕；松井换过衬衫，而早前步美把果汁洒在他衣服上；腿伤前后矛盾、道具箱里的另一把刀，以及他与足立、智美的串供一起指向他。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南借助阿笠博士揭穿脚印与皮套调包手法，松井承认因流言而杀人；足立和智美此前是在替他隐瞒。

suspects: Daisuke Mikami, Ryota Adachi, Shugo Matsui, and Tomomi Sakaguchi
suspectsZh: 穿着戈梅拉人偶服的人
三上大辅、足立亮太、松井修吾与坂口友美

title.ja: 第3の指紋殺人事件

summary: 码头枪杀案中枪上出现第三枚指纹，嫌疑人指向毛利小五郎的前上司寺冈警部。

culprit.zhHans: 寺冈警部（Inspector Teraoka），警视厅搜查四课管理官，毛利小五郎的前上司。

motive.zhHans: 松山以揭发寺冈收受贿赂、泄露警方行动情报为把柄勒索他，并索要资金以便从自己犯下的另一起杀人案中脱身、逃往国外，寺冈因此杀死松山。

method.zhHans: 寺冈在码头枪杀松山，试图把案件引向抢劫或意外方向；他随身携带的配枪藏在裤下枪套里，因此进入车内时发出金属碰撞声。

evidence.zhHans: 枪上出现的第三枚指纹属于寺冈的妻子美沙子，她无意中碰到寺冈藏起来的枪；柯南从寺冈上车时听到的异常金属声判断他使用的是自己的枪。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南查明第三枚指纹来自误触配枪的美沙子，也确认寺冈为灭口而杀人；寺冈在毛利面前承认受贿被勒索的事实。

title.ja: カニとクジラ誘拐事件
title.en: A Crab and Whale Kidnapping Case

summary: 远藤圭太在自家前院被绑架，绑匪留下不许报警的字条，柯南与毛利一家在时限内追查赎金交付地点。

culprit.zhHans: 两名绑架者：一名男子与一名女子（页面人物表列为 Keita 的绑架者，未给出正式姓名）。

motive.zhHans: 两名绑架者以远藤圭太为人质向远藤圭吾勒索大笔日元，准备得手后携款潜逃。

method.zhHans: 二人从远藤家前院绑走5岁的圭太，留下“孩子在我们手上，报警就杀了他，等我们联系”的字条，随后用电话遥控赎金交付流程，并在酒店准备逃跑。

evidence.zhHans: 字条内容与赎金指示、绑匪对交付地点的选择，以及南水族馆相关线索帮助柯南锁定赎金交接与藏匿位置；两名绑架者在酒店准备出逃时被柯南当场击中制服。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南在酒店制服两名绑架者，圭太被安全送回父亲身边，二人被逮捕。

title.ja: 夜道殺人事件

summary: 池田义郎在夜路被钝器击杀，血迹却出现在废弃大楼墙面、屋顶栏杆和高层公寓玻璃上，毛利一家与旧友大村淳共同追查登山社团的旧事。

culprit.zhHans: 竹野浩二（Kouji Takeno），米花大学二年级学生，常盘圭子的男友。

motive.zhHans: 竹野与池田都爱慕常盘圭子；圭子在雪山事故中因脚伤被留在山上冻死。竹野后来得知池田是故意扰乱队伍、让圭子得不到及时救援，还曾在酒桌上向同样醉酒的日下炫耀此事，于是决定复仇。

method.zhHans: 竹野把水族馆的小溪石装进自己登山用的耐磨运动袜，装满石头后做成沉重钝器，用钓鱼绳绑好后从远处向站在街上抽烟的池田投掷，将其一击打死。

evidence.zhHans: 血液之所以溅到废弃大楼墙面、屋顶栏杆和上层公寓玻璃上，是因为装满石头的袜子在高强度撞击后反弹所致；水族馆石堆中残留的羊毛纤维，以及竹野没有换下的、沾有池田血迹的袜子成为决定性证据。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南揭穿“袜装溪石”的投掷手法和羊毛纤维来源，竹野承认是为圭子复仇而杀人；池田当年故意拖延救援的事实也随之曝光。

suspects: Masami Kusaka, Yoichi Shimizu, Kouji Takeno, and Hidenori Nakamura
Yoshiro Ikuta, Masami Kusaka, Yoichi Shimizu, Kouji Takeno, and Hidenori Nakamura
suspectsZh: 日下正美、清水洋一、竹野浩司与中村英纪
生田义郎、日下正美、清水洋一、竹野浩司与中村英纪

title.ja: 舞台女優殺人事件

summary: 毛利小五郎受委托调查威胁信，在米花剧场目击当红女演员大出祥子演出中被氰酸钾毒杀。

culprit.zhHans: 佐々木瞳（Hitomi Sasaki），大出祥子的经纪人。

motive.zhHans: 宇田雄一原本是佐々木的恋人，后来为大出祥子与她分手；佐々木已经接受了这个结果。但祥子随即又甩掉宇田，说他无趣又迟钝，扬言要把他还给佐々木，还傲慢地笑着。佐々木无法原谅祥子根本没有认真对待这段感情、只是存心把宇田从她身边夺走。

method.zhHans: 佐々木利用舞台布景上方悬挂的星星道具作为定位点，用钓鱼线把毒液滴入祥子的杯子；杯子按剧本规定的位置预先摆好，滴毒因此能精准命中。

evidence.zhHans: 佐々木手上留有强行把钓鱼线从星星道具上扯下时的划痕，说明她当时慌了神；案发后毛利小五郎让所有人留在原地，那根用于作案的钓鱼线应该还在她的口袋里。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南揭穿钓鱼线滴毒手法，佐々木承认杀人；案件结束后盐田平八郎打算接手侦探事务所，却被妻子接回家。

suspects: Kazuo Motoki, Hitomi Sasaki, Eiko Nakayama, Junichi Tateoka, and Yuuichi Uda
suspectsZh: 本木和夫、佐佐木瞳、中山英子、馆冈纯一与宇田雄一

title.ja: 闇の男爵殺人事件

summary: 伊豆公主大饭店的暗夜男爵谜题活动中，软件公司社长江原时男身着男爵装束坠楼身亡，柯南在“公主风”中追查真相。

culprit.zhHans: 狭山明子（Akiko Sayama），软件公司职员、前田聪的未婚妻。

motive.zhHans: 三年前她敬爱的兄长因江原时男入侵其公司系统、盗走他投入全部资金的程序而跳楼自杀；狭山为复仇策划了这场暗夜男爵谜题活动，并假称掌握传说中的暗夜男爵病毒，引江原参赛。

method.zhHans: 晚餐后狭山以交付病毒为由把江原叫到自己的1901室，将他迷昏，再潜入江原房间放置手套、制造从内部反锁的密室；她给昏迷的江原换上男爵装束（省去假发），把尸体从背风的窗户抛下，让尸体恰好落在江原房间阳台正下方，看起来像是江原反锁房间、扮成男爵试图翻进下层房间时失足坠楼。

evidence.zhHans: 当时唯一能使尸体落在江原阳台下方的方法，是从背风区域抛下，而该区域只有20层以下的房间能够进入，最终只能指向1901室；柯南让警方从各嫌疑人房间抛下绑有配重、系着被单冒充披风的卷起被褥，结果全部被“公主风”吹离各自阳台下方，反证江原不可能从自己阳台坠落；狭山从房间打到前台的电话记录也证明抛尸时她在案发现场。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南借沉睡的小五郎揭穿密室与风向诡计，狭山被认定为凶手；未婚夫前田聪为替她制造不在场证明，偷走男爵装束假扮男爵，最终因妨碍调查被起诉，兰查证其不在场证明为他洗脱杀人嫌疑；狭山被带走时哭着让前田忘了她，前田承诺等她出狱。

title.ja: ストーカー殺人事件

summary: 登山途中，毛利一家撞见一名青年在街上毒发身亡，现场遗留的饮料瓶把线索指向长期跟踪他的女性。

culprit.zhHans: 西谷美穂（Miho Nishitani），家庭餐厅店员、永井达也的跟踪受害对象。

motive.zhHans: 永井长期跟踪西谷，在她报警后当众把她推下车站楼梯；西谷判断警察保护不了自己，认为永井迟早会杀了她，于是决定先下手。

method.zhHans: 西谷事先买好一瓶“Guts-man”运动饮料，投入磷酸毒物，再从自动贩卖机另买一瓶做样子，假装取出机器多给的那一瓶喝下，实际取出的是毒瓶；她把毒瓶留在栏杆上等永井喝，永井误以为是机器多送的而喝下毒发。

evidence.zhHans: 毒瓶上的贴纸宣传的是早已结束的抽奖活动，而且贩卖机里不太可能还留着旧货；毛利小五郎又在机器里发现了她真正付钱买的那一瓶，证明她事先准备了毒瓶。更关键的是，永井把隐藏摄像机装在自己的打火机里，拍下了西谷按柯南所述方式投毒的全过程。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南揭穿毒瓶与贴纸破绽，西谷承认杀人。由于是预谋投毒，正当防卫不成立；但柯南在她家门外灌木丛中发现装有多种危险工具的袋子，上面有永井的指纹，证明永井原本打算折磨她，西谷因此很可能获得从轻判决。事后毛利感叹，如果她没有杀人，本可以有别的路。

title.ja: 三つ子別荘殺人事件
title.en: The Triplet's Country Home Murder Case

summary: 园子陪姐姐绫子拜访富泽家时，三胞胎兄弟的父亲在雨中屋外被石头砸死，四名目击者只看见凶手相同的眼睛。

culprit.zhHans: 富泽太一（Taichi Tomizawa），富泽家长子、小说家。

motive.zhHans: 太一靠写作维生，但工作量减少、收入下滑，向父亲要钱时才发现父亲一直在向编辑施压，让对方拒绝给他约稿；他误以为父亲要逼自己放弃写作、回公司接班。听说父亲这天要去看三子佑造未婚妻，他认为这是行凶的好机会。

method.zhHans: 太一提前把父亲答录机上的时钟调早，跟踪父亲回家后行凶，用石头砸死父亲，随后播放事先录好的留言，再把时钟调回；他还打坏了卫星天线，逼迫父亲到屋外，制造电话留言与作案时间吻合的假象。作案时他戴着假发伪装，并把窃听麦克风藏进父亲的手表，用来掌握比赛结束、父亲回家等一切动向，行凶后取走手表销毁证据。

evidence.zhHans: 案发时11:30有长达十分钟的停电，停电时答录机无法录音，只靠电池维持时钟与通话；太一那条“11:30打来”的留言与作案时刻恰好吻合，这需要不可能的运气，反证只有能改动答录机时钟的人才能做到。他自称11:30在弹珠店，但法律要求弹珠店11点前必须关门，不在场证明不成立。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南借铃木园子之口揭穿答录机时钟与停电诡计，指认太一为凶手。园子姐姐绫子的婚事因此告吹，但案件结束后康纳与兰仍为园子假装推理的表现感到好笑。

suspects: Yuzo Tomizawa, Tatsuji Tomizawa, and Taichi Tomizawa
suspectsZh: 富泽雄三、富泽达二与富泽太一

title.ja: 少年探偵団遭難事件

summary: 水上乐园里，少年侦探团发现一名女子失踪，海边的山洞中留下求救信号；同行的未婚夫坚称那只是玩笑。

culprit.zhHans: 春日辉彦（Teruhiko Kasuga），春日集团继承人。

motive.zhHans: 春日完全是奉父亲之命才与富家女忍订婚的，父亲要求他要娶富家女，否则就断绝经济援助。他想回到从前那种花心的日子，于是决定杀掉未婚妻，并伪装成意外事故。

method.zhHans: 春日把忍带到海边一处可以望见海的洞穴，让她喝下掺有安眠药的果汁，趁她昏睡时把她丢在洞里，打算让上涨的潮水把她淹死；随后他谎称洞中留下的SOS只是玩笑，试图拖住救援。

evidence.zhHans: 洞中留下的求救信号与忍的失踪直接矛盾，春日“只是玩笑”的说法站不住脚；柯南与少年侦探团在洞中找到了昏迷的忍。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南一行带着昏睡的忍往洞穴深处走，被潮水从另一处洞口冲到潮池，正好撞上在那里偷偷钓鱼的小五郎与春日。春日狗急跳墙，把步美当人质，威胁要杀掉在场所有人，被一位老人扔罐头打中，随后兰与管理员赶到将其制服逮捕。小五郎则因为在禁钓潮池钓鱼，被管理员训了整整一小时。

title.ja: 死神陣内殺人事件
title.en: The Death God Jinnai Murder Case

summary: 《死神阵内》第八集首映后，主演收到预告死亡的通知，随后在办公大楼七楼中弹身亡，房间外却看不出有人进出。

culprit.zhHans: 吉野里美（Satomi Yoshino），南条隼人的经纪人、前演员。

motive.zhHans: 三年前北野弘之拿到了《死神阵内》的主演位置，嫉妒的南条诱骗他不带替身完成特技，并拆掉他车上的螺栓，导致车辆失控爆炸，北野身亡。某个夜晚吉野开车送醉酒的南条回家，他把这件事全部说了出来，吉野由此决定复仇。

method.zhHans: 吉野用乙烯胶带和钓鱼线在窗户上做出人体剪影，把线连到电灯开关与电梯上；电梯下行时先点亮房间的灯，再把胶带从窗户上扯掉，从楼下与外面看去就像房里有人走过。她以此制造“死神阵内现身”的假象，同时在七楼射杀南条。

evidence.zhHans: 柯南在电梯处被胶带绊倒，发现胶带与钓鱼线连动机关的痕迹；现场所谓“走动的人影”随电梯运行才出现，与真人行动不符。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南揭穿电梯联动的人体剪影诡计，指认吉野为凶手；吉野承认是为北野复仇，并说出南条醉酒后亲口承认三年前动手的经过。这话也说明三年前北野之死是南条所为，北野的旧案随之真相大白。

suspects: Miyuki Nanjo, Satomi Yoshino, and Tadao Ohno
suspectsZh: 南条美雪、吉野里美与大野忠夫

title.zhHans: 金融公司社长杀人事件
title.zhHant: 金融公司社長殺人事件
title.ja: 金融会社社長殺人事件

summary: 麻将桌上缺一个人，众人去找迟迟不来的金融公司社长，发现他倒在反锁的办公室里，死于氰化钾中毒。

culprit.zhHans: 藤井贵子（Takako Fujii），Hida金融职员。

motive.zhHans: 贵子从大学毕业后三年一直因心脏病住院，父母已故、脾气不好又没朋友，只有男友来探望她。男友为她借了日田的钱，无力偿还后上吊自杀；贵子事后才知道男友是为她借钱，而合约就压在男友脚下。她进入公司从底层做起，只为等复仇的时机。

method.zhHans: 贵子事先在厨房煤气灶旋钮的左侧涂上氰化钾，然后在离开办公室前把鸣笛水壶坐上火。水壶鸣笛时，多疑的日田慌着去关火，绝大多数灶具按右手习惯设计，他很自然会用右手拇指去拧旋钮左侧，毒物就这样沾在拇指上；他回办公室舔手指，随即中毒身亡。她原本打算第二天早上再擦掉毒物，尸体却被提前发现。

evidence.zhHans: 毒物只出现在办公室门的内侧把手上，外侧没有，符合日田匆忙开门、沾毒、返回锁门的过程，也解释了房间反锁。案发后只有藤井贵子靠近过灶台，她借“泡茶”之机用手帕擦掉毒物；手帕是湿的但不是水，目暮在上面滴碘液后颜色消失，说明上面是漂白剂。漂白剂能中和氰化物，也能漂白痕迹，且不常在药店出售，却出现在女厕的柜子里。此外她惯用右手，取烟、点烟、拿东西都用右手，唯独那天用左手去拧旋钮，因为她抽烟时手指会碰嘴唇，怕残留毒物。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南借沉睡的小五郎揭穿旋钮涂毒与漂白剂灭证，藤井贵子承认杀人。她把毒涂在左侧、用左手拧旋钮这两个细节，连同漂白剂手帕，一起构成了无法辩驳的证据链。

suspects: Hisayoshi Minamizawa, Takako Fujii, and Hiroshi Iino
suspectsZh: 南泽久义、藤井贵子与饭野宏

title.ja: コナンVS怪盗キッド

summary: 铃木财团委托毛利小五郎保护传世黑珍珠“漆黑之星”，怪盗基德留下一封暗号预告函，柯南与他在屋顶和船上两度交手。

culprit.zhHans: 怪盗基德（黑羽快斗）；本集没有杀人凶手，作案目标为黑珍珠“漆黑之星”。

motive.zhHans: 基德盯上铃木财团收藏的世界最大黑珍珠“漆黑之星”，按预告函在愚人节动手；这一次既是为盗宝，也是他与柯南的第一次正式交锋。

method.zhHans: 基德先用暗号预告函“四月一日，当月亮分成两半时，我将前来拜访漆黑之星之名起源之地，随海浪的呼唤”给出线索，在酒店天台与柯南初次见面时冒充中森警部的声音把警员都调上天台，再用闪光弹脱身；博物馆那次只是预演，他在船上伪装成铃木史郎混入，把真正的黑珍珠留在铃木朋子身上，让全员戴的复制品接连爆炸制造混乱，趁乱得手。

evidence.zhHans: 柯南识破船上“铃木史郎”是基德假扮，因为园子打电话发现真正的父亲与姐姐还在家里；他又从朋子对珍珠“孔雀色”的描述、握持方式与因年代而黯淡的光泽，判断博物馆那颗太亮是赝品，从而锁定基德真正偷走的是朋子身上那颗。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南在船上揭穿基德假扮成小兰，基德认输交还黑珍珠；柯南踩碎他的手机，防止他再用同样手法。基德临走谎称已剥走小兰的衣服，把柯南支开，实际只是在交给小兰前把礼服复制了一份，还留卡片向小兰道歉、夸她可爱。次日柯南被媒体捧为“守护黑珍珠的英雄”，他本人并不高兴；基德则因跳进冷海逃走而感冒，被青子笑骂。

title.ja: 名家連続変死事件
title.en: Distinguished Family's Consecutive Accidental Death Case

summary: 长门家以寻找初恋为名请来毛利小五郎，服部平次也随父亲到场；当晚女婿三木昭在阳台下被栅栏刺死，两天后长子秀臣的尸体从庭院池塘里浮出。

culprit.zhHans: 日向美雪。她杀死长门三木昭，并参与藏匿长门秀臣的尸体；秀臣本人是自杀。三木昭另有独立计划：杀害岳父长门道三并嫁祸秀臣，以抓钩勒杀未遂。

motive.zhHans: 二十年前那座小旅馆的大火由秀臣与三木昭引起，美雪的父母因此丧生、秀臣半张脸被烧伤。美雪得知真相后仍爱上秀臣，秀臣却在她求婚时因负罪而自杀。三木昭又当着美雪的面轻描淡写地谈那场纵火，美雪因此决定杀他，并让秀臣替他背下这桩命案。

method.zhHans: 三木昭先伪造秀臣的杀人现场：用注射器抽自己的血染绷带、戴泳帽再套毛线帽以免留下头发、把抓钩当作勒杀道三的器具，并以电话里假装被袭的喊声把所有人引到楼下。美雪在这个计划里反手杀他：她以“杀了道三就能当上新社长”为诱饵，在阳台上用旧钢笔刺伤他的手，让他松手坠落到栅栏上。秀臣的尸体此前由两人用庭院里的坑洞暂埋，后来以失踪的床单裹住投入池塘；案发前两天出现的“秀臣”，由美雪或三木昭穿他的衣服、缠他的绷带扮演。

evidence.zhHans: 三木昭手上一处小刺伤，与美雪那把笔尖弯折、已无法使用的旧钢笔对应；他坠落前抓住美雪的手腕，使她的手表脱落。阳台底部的抓钩痕迹也是连续几天“怪声”的来源。柯南另以秀臣素描对照宅内家具摆放、用一幅新买的名画破绽，逐项确认推断。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南借毛利小五郎揭穿美雪，服部平次以抓钩爬上阳台当场演示三木昭的嫁祸手法。美雪承认自己是为让秀臣“不再孤零零泡在冷水里”才动手，随后用装了苯的热水瓶和打火机试图与众人同归于尽并自杀；柯南与服部事先调换了热水瓶内容物，未能引爆。她崩溃哭喊后被带走。

title.ja: 銀行強盗殺人事件

summary: 保龄球之后去银行兑现支票，撞上一场持枪抢劫；一名职员中弹，另一名职员夺枪击毙歹徒，看起来是正当防卫。

culprit.zhHans: 谷口升。他是抢劫犯佐伯透的共犯，在佐伯开枪打伤前岛之后将其击毙灭口。

motive.zhHans: 灭口。佐伯意外打伤职员前岛哲也，事态失控；谷口担心佐伯被捕后供出自己，于是当场开枪打死同伙，再把现场包装成正当防卫。

method.zhHans: 两人事先约定以电话铃声为暗号：佐伯遇到麻烦，谷口就拨他手机提醒。抢劫中谷口按约定拨号，但前岛正好从背后扑向佐伯，佐伯误以为响的是自己的手机而僵住，慌乱中开枪打伤前岛。谷口也随即慌了，索性开枪杀死佐伯，伪装成夺枪自卫。

evidence.zhHans: 一批止咳润喉糖。谷口到银行前与佐伯见过面，见他感冒便分了一半糖条给他；后来又把这半条给了同样感冒的柯南。抢劫过程中佐伯的糖吃完，想起谷口还有，就把包装纸丢在地上翻找外套，而糖早不在谷口身上。两半包装纸拼合完全吻合，证明二人是共犯。另有被挟持者用录音机偷录的现场声音，与各人手机铃声逐一比对，确认响的是佐伯的手机，即谷口在作案期间确实给他打过电话。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南借用园子的声音当场揭穿谷口是共犯并说明其杀人经过，警方将其逮捕。

title.ja: 放浪画家殺人事件

summary: 美术馆里一个衣衫褴褛的男子对着画作发呆，次日少年侦探团又在棒球场上遇见他；他因失忆被送医，随后逃走，最终死在山坡上。

culprit.zhHans: 早濑喜美江。死者早濑达夫是她“死去”一年的丈夫。

motive.zhHans: 早濑达夫在银行任职期间挪用公款，失踪后把罪责留给妻子独自承受社会指责，她因此恨他到极点。杀他既为报复，也为把那笔藏起来的公款据为己有——用她自己的说法，是要“把失去的时间买回来”。

method.zhHans: 一年前达夫在雪山失踪其实是伪装，他被妻子藏匿起来。他因失忆流落在外，靠素描本能反复画着自家房子，记忆逐渐恢复，最终循着素描找回自家门口，被妻子发现后勒死，尸体弃在山坡上。喜美江还专门请清洁公司彻底清扫屋内，并否认死者是自己的丈夫。

evidence.zhHans: 达夫恢复记忆后回家时在屋内留下的指纹，证明死者正是早濑达夫本人；喜美江客厅家具的摆放与素描中的位置不符，说明素描画的并非现在的房屋；她刚在画廊买下一幅昂贵的画，也与挪用款去向的追问相扣。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南把众人召集到早濑家当场说明真相，指出凶手是早濑喜美江，她承认杀人。柯南对她几乎没有同情，只说了一句：她在监狱里还有很多时间。

origin.note: 漫画 File.144-146 改编；2015 年重制版分两集重播。

culprit.zhHans: 宫原悟史（Satoshi Miyahara）及其助手

motive.zhHans: 灭口与销毁证据：宫原在跨年夜于正觉寺附近枪杀一名曾共同抢劫后逃往国外又回来勒索他的男子，Two-Mix 听到枪声后误当作烟花写进歌词，歌词意外暴露了作案细节；他绑架两人是要在警方找到她们前连人带样带一并毁掉。

method.zhHans: 先枪杀受害者，再把重新装填的枪塞进死者手中朝地面开一枪，使警方在其手上检出硝烟痕迹，从而被判定为正当防卫；助手在其报警期间带走一发子弹与第一枪的空弹壳。绑架阶段则在录音室外将两名成员强行押上车。

evidence.zhHans: Two-Mix 的样带歌词与案发当夜所听到的时间、声响细节吻合；柯南借手机机关定位并救出人质；寺院住持虽是聋人整夜在寺中，仍看到过宫原的脸。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南用手机机关救出少年侦探团与 Two-Mix 两名成员，30 分钟后警方逮捕两名绑架者；宫原供认杀人，被害人是当年抢劫同伙、回国后勒索他。演唱会得以按时开始。

title.en: The Kidnapping of a Popular Artist Case
title.ja: 人気アーティスト誘拐事件 (Ninki Ātisuto Yūkai Jiken)
aliases: 人気アーティスト誘拐事件

origin.note: TV 原创；无漫画 File 对应。

culprit.zhHans: 外科医生白井光雄（Mitsuo Shirai）

motive.zhHans: 被害人江藤胜敏长期嘲讽他，还以揭发手段逼他退出两人争抢的晋升名额，他遂起杀意。

method.zhHans: 先用 CPR 假人做前三夜的「幻影刺杀」：借对面房间的灯光把人影投到小五郎房的窗上，让人以为小五郎出现幻觉、精神失常，便于把罪栽给他；第四夜在对面房间真实刺杀江藤，再以钝器打昏小五郎并把刀塞进他手里。

evidence.zhHans: 咖啡杯上没有他的指纹：他戴乳胶手套捏住杯把冲洗，护士的指纹却仍留在杯上；他称自己清洗过杯子，无法解释为何只洗掉自己的指纹。另查到他根本不在办公室，是用免提电话与护士通话制造在场假象。

resolution.zhHans: 白井当面对质后认罪，交代动机与被打压的晋升竞争；小五郎洗清嫌疑。

title.ja: 総合病院殺人事件 (Sōgō Byōin Satsujin Jiken)

summary.en: Kogoro is in the hospital after his leg injured by a criminal he was chasing down. While there, he witnesses a silhouette of one person stabbing another person in the back. He notifies the nurses immediately, only to find out that the room in which the murder took place is empty. This happens continuously for three nights in a row, before an actual murder has taken place on the 4th night. Even worse, Kogoro is found passed out next to the corpse and mistaken to be the killer, and now Conan will have to clear his name.

suspects: Katsutoshi Eto, Mitsuo Shirai, Keiko Okita and Kazumi Nakayama
Mitsuo Shirai, Keiko Okita and Kazumi Nakayama
suspectsZh: 卫藤胜敏、白井光夫、冲田惠子与中山和美
白井光夫、冲田惠子与中山和美

origin.note: 漫画 File.139-143 改编，双集一案。

culprit.zhHans: 米原晃子（Akiko Yonehara），帝丹小学前教师，被害者们的同事

motive.zhHans: 三年前十二岁的持田美奈子在排球社教室被吊死，校方以考试压力自杀结案；晃子判断她是被杉山与另一名教师（岛田）灭口，遂以「合宿」名义把相关教师聚到山庄复仇。

method.zhHans: 先杀音乐教师杉山并藏尸屋外让其冻僵，扰乱死亡时间；再袭园子制造不在场证明，随即假扮成被害人（园子看到的「晃子」其实是杉山尸体）；最后以假发编成的发辫勒杀，用完可收回头上、不留凶器。各处留下口红写的「美奈子」。

evidence.zhHans: 死者岛田颈部有细小的血痕抓伤，假发上检出他的血迹；凶器始终搜不到，因为就是她头上的长假发。

resolution.zhHans: 晃子摘下假发认罪，说无法原谅背叛甚至杀害学生的教师，也承认自己伤及园子同样有罪；兰情绪崩溃跪抱柯南。暴风雪停后警方抵达。

solvedBy: Ran Mouri (via Conan as Shinichi Kudo on phone)

title.ja: スキーロッジ殺人事件 (Sukii Rojji Satsujin Jiken)
aliases: スキーロッジ殺人事件

origin.note: 改编自《名侦探柯南特别篇》，非本篇 File 编号体系。

culprit.zhHans: Tomidokoro（富所），被绑架女孩准子的父亲所租住大楼的受害者家属

motive.zhHans: 他被租户（准子之父）的疏忽害死了幼女：大楼施工期间屋顶门锁损坏达一周无人修理，孩子从屋顶坠落身亡，而对方获判无罪，他无法接受遂行报复。

method.zhHans: 绑架并捆绑准子，把她带到附近大楼的露台；用对讲机遥控指示准子之父行动，最后要求他自刎，否则杀死准子。

evidence.zhHans: 光彦的新无线电收音机截获了犯人与被害者家属的通话，据此锁定位置。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南把对讲机踢到犯人脸上将其击昏，救出准子并用对讲机告知其父，阻止了自杀；柯南因此错过兰的空手道比赛，还因谎称看到背踢取胜被兰识破。

title.ja: 誘拐現場特定事件 (Yūkai Genba Tokutei Jiken)

summary.en: Mitsuhiko has a new radio transceiver that intercepts other peoples conversations, but when it intercepts a kidnap case, Conan must figure out the hidden location before a young daughter loses her life.

culprit.zhHans: 町田保（Tamotsu Machida），死者之弟，画家

motive.zhHans: 他长期靠兄长接济，得知兄长要把全部财产捐给濒危鸟类保护后，为继承遗产而杀兄并嫁祸侄子博。

method.zhHans: 在壁炉烟囱内架好弩，用橡皮筋固定一块木片卡住扳机，木片与钓鱼线相连；等博朝标本鸟发射十字弓的同时拉动钓鱼线触发弩箭射死秀三，再用钓鱼线把弩从烟囱里拉出。

evidence.zhHans: 准备替换破窗的玻璃上有一道划痕，来自博射出的十字弓；碎玻璃整齐排列说明被超弹性镜面挡住；烟囱内有钓鱼线留下的直线状空隙；他后裤袋里有一根来自烟囱顶鸟巢的羽毛。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南借小五郎之口推翻博的误杀自白，指认真凶町田保；秀三的两名子女最终决定按其遗愿把遗产捐给濒危鸟类。

title.en: The Crane's Return of a Favor Murder Case
title.ja: 鶴の恩返し殺人事件 (Tsuru no Ongaeshi Satsujin Jiken)

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan take a trip to Kushiro marshland, Hokkaido Prefecture, to see the red-crowned cranes. They run into an old man who takes care of the cranes and he invites them to his house. His daughter and son rush into the room demanding the reason why he is donating his life savings to the city. The group is allowed to soak in the hot spring near the house, but they are called when they find out the old man has been murdered.

culprit.zhHans: 田所俊哉（Toshiya Tadokoro），死者弟子兼实际代笔人

motive.zhHans: 妹妹香织患肾衰竭，寅仓以负担医疗费为条件让他做「影子写手」；寅仓却买通医生只维持不治愈以延长合作，最终香织一年前病亡，且长期谎称她仍在美洲住院。护士愧疚告知真相后他崩溃报仇。

method.zhHans: 屋顶雪面未留脚印，因为他把梯子架在相邻屋顶之间跨过去；留声机胶片卷轴既营造恐怖气氛，又靠胶片一端系门实现离开后自动关门、且不留下指纹；事先在酒窖藏一支同样的木桩，解决无法从密室取走凶器的问题。

evidence.zhHans: 他声称在房内听到胶片卷轴的转动声，但该房间做了隔音处理，这一点只有真凶才说得出来；此外密室的门是靠胶片自动关上。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南识破胶片与屋顶梯子的机关，指出只有田所能说出「听到卷轴声」这一点，田所认罪。

title.ja: ドラキュラ荘殺人事件 (Dorakyura-sō Satsujin Jiken)
aliases: ドラキュラ荘殺人事件

summary: 被害人：白木大辅（Daisuke Shiraki），58 岁，Bay Front 酒店老板；先被氯仿麻醉，再用领带勒死。

culprit.zhHans: 尾崎翠（Midori Ozaki），33 岁，理香的经纪人。

motive.zhHans: 理香对外宣称的花道绝技实为其姐春香所创。理香与白木合谋窃取春香技艺并买通花道界赞助人，令春香被整个花道圈封杀、名声尽毁，春香最终在卧室用数十束花同时绽放释放毒物自杀。尾崎翠发现姐姐陈尸花丛后查出真相，遂以经纪人身份潜入理香身边，策划一并杀死理香与白木。

method.zhHans: 把氯仿与氰化钾各冻成小球，分别塞进经低温处理、退回花苞状态的鲜花里。赠送给宾客的花中放氯仿球，随时间推移花朵绽放、氯仿挥发令目标昏睡；舞台上的花中放氰化钾球，同理在表演时释放，企图杀死理香并在其中一并自尽。只有同时负责宾客用花与舞台用花的人才能完成这套布置。

evidence.zhHans: 柯南在被褥箱中发现氯仿（CHCl₃）与氰化钾（KCN）两瓶化学品，并从受害者的花上闻到氯仿气味；搜查理香随身物品时找到一瓶氯仿，确认为同一来源。因宾客收到的花本应已盛开、而舞台上的花仍是花苞，柯南据此判定第二批毒花针对的是理香本人；又因花由经纪人尾崎翠一人经手，锁定凶手。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南揭穿冰镇毒花球的机关，指出尾崎翠是把姐姐的绝技变成杀人手段。尾崎翠的计划是先杀白木、再在舞台上与理香同归于尽；理香获救，幕后旧案一并被揭开。

title.ja: 花の香り殺人事件 (Hana no Kaori Satsujin Jiken)

summary: 被害人：关口由美子（Yumiko Sekiguchi），被劫匪团伙挟持；住院的烧伤病人为团伙成员，是灭口对象。

culprit.zhHans: 劫匪团伙：首领山本、赤羽右卫门、英子、高垣，另有伪装成警察与护士的两人参与。直接胁迫者为该团伙，动手者被逼为银行职员关口义男。

motive.zhHans: 团伙为撇清银行抢劫案，打算杀掉烧伤住院的同伙灭口，并把银行职员关口义男伪造成策划整起抢劫的主谋；为此挟持他的女儿关口由美子，逼他动手。

method.zhHans: 把枪藏在糖果盒里交给义男，让他用里面的武器杀死烧伤病人；同时用手机在院内多处监视义男的行动，由同伙在商场楼顶露台用望远镜远程观察，一旦他迟疑就威胁对其女儿下手。

evidence.zhHans: 柯南注意到义男声称很忙却一直提着糖果盒在院内走动，而糖果盒本不该是给父亲的礼物（其父为糖尿病人，不能吃糖）；院内禁止使用手机，却有数人一直打电话并注视义男。他又屡次望向商场方向并低声念女儿名字——柯南据此判断女儿被挟持在商场楼顶露台，因为从那里可以用望远镜清楚观察他们的动静。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南当面拦下义男并道破胁迫结构。义男承认被设局。柯南从糖果盒里取出枪，引起伪装警察与持报男子注意，随即用增强踢力鞋踢出足球制服二人；又用麻醉手表放倒伪装护士及看守女儿的woman，其余少年侦探团成员配合行动。父女团聚，劫匪团伙全部被捕。

title.ja: 強盗犯人入院事件 (Gōtō Hannin Nyūin Jiken)

summary: 被害人：平井健一（Kenichi Hirai），22 岁，登山向导；被飞刀擦伤脸颊后失去平衡坠崖，头部撞石致死。

culprit.zhHans: 代号「狐狸」的职业杀手，本作中冒充山间小屋管理员岩田重吉（Juukichi Iwata）。

motive.zhHans: 平井长期往返该山道，认识真正的岩田重吉，是「狐狸」冒名顶替计划中的变数，因此在计划推进前被灭口。「狐狸」本身是受雇杀手，与牛尾文三之间另有因果：半年前他刺杀高利贷公司社长时，对方车辆失控撞上幼儿园接送巴士，造成牛尾独生女、5 岁的千纱死亡；「狐狸」由此销声匿迹避风头。文三查不到他的脸和身份，只能拿自己的命当诱饵把他引出来。

method.zhHans: 在登山途中向平井投掷小刀；平井仓促躲闪只被划伤脸颊，但失去平衡坠下高崖。「狐狸」事前已将真正的管理员岩田重吉绑架并囚禁在附近洞穴，自己以管理员身份在小屋接待一行人，掌握所有人的动向。

evidence.zhHans: 柯南与毛利小五郎下崖验尸，发现平井后脑撞在岩石上，但脸颊另有一道刀割伤，且近处有一把带血的小刀——说明有人先向他掷刀，他勉强避开却被划伤、失衡坠亡，并非单纯失足。其后文三目睹「老人」岩田在滑坡中把川边推下悬崖后健步逃走，才判断这个「管理员」就是「狐狸」本人。

resolution.zhHans: 文三坦承整趟登山都是他设的局：他从未生病、也不想寻死，一切只为亲手杀掉害死女儿千纱的「狐狸」。他一度举枪，柯南拿出他钱包里千纱的照片请他不要弄脏自己的手，文三放下枪；「狐狸」抢枪欲杀众人，被柯南踢飞，逃跑时被小五郎以柔道摔倒，伪装脱落、真面目远比外表年轻。「狐狸」、文三与川边肇三人被捕；离开前文三向柯南道谢并含笑告别。

title.ja: 恐怖のトラヴァース殺人事件 (Kyōfu no Toravāsu Satsujin Jiken)
aliases: 恐怖のトラヴァース殺人事件

spoilerNote: 同一集的独立事件（不可并入本案）：凉子（Kyoko Saegusa）之死与「狐狸」无关——川边肇（Akira Kawabe）为灭口而杀害她，二人此前共同犯下抢劫杀人案；牛尾文三雇凶杀自己的委托与本次登山均为其复仇布局的一部分，文三本人不构成杀人既遂；在毛利侦探事务所遭狙击、以及小五郎在睡梦中被刺，原文均记为未遂事件。
spoilerNoteSource: fix-spoiler-type-pollution.py：原 spoiler 字段被自由文本污染，文本迁此，等级恢复为同级默认值

origin.note: TV 原创（Filler），无漫画对应 File。

summary: 被害人：绢田亚希子（Akiko Kinoshita），26 岁，以「雪女」一角走红的电影女星，死于低温失温（hypothermia），遗体被埋在雪中。

culprit.zhHans: 被害人的专属替身演员、同岁同伴浅沼洋子（Yoko Asanuma）。

motive.zhHans: 嫉妒。亚希子始终拿到关注与名声，而洋子作为替身最多只能做她的影子，永远站在二线。

method.zhHans: 洋子先伪造一封亚希子自称生病、想自杀的信，再预订自己多年前打工过的山形温泉旅馆房间，安排两人同住。次日滑雪途中给亚希子下药使其昏睡，脱下她的滑雪服换上一身白色和服，把人埋进雪里造成失温死亡；随后自己穿上亚希子含全脸面罩的滑雪装返回旅馆，此后一人分饰两角。因熟悉旅馆地形，众人一直以为亚希子只是「生病」待在房间。

evidence.zhHans: 众人先因那封伪造信认定亚希子是想自杀出走，直到雪中挖出遗体也以「自杀」收场。柯南从一人分饰两角时无法同时出现在两处、以及旅馆动线与入住安排上的破绽反推出真相，把「雪女」的传说外观还原成一场人为的低温杀人。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南揭穿洋子的替身身份与分饰两角的手法，说明那封「自杀信」是她伪造的、白色的和服与雪地是故意制造的雪女意象。真相在旅馆众人面前公开，洋子的嫉妒动机与其长期作为影子的处境一并被点明。

title.ja: 雪女伝説殺人事件 (Yuki-on'na Densetsu Satsujin Jiken)

origin.note: TV 原创（Filler），无漫画对应 File。

summary: 被害人：竹中一美（Kazumi Takenaka），29 岁，公司职员，胸口中刀死于自宅公寓。

culprit.zhHans: 被害人的室友、进口商品销售总监岛村幸子（Sachiko Shimamura）。

motive.zhHans: 灭口。一美掌握幸子在日本销售违禁商品的把柄，并以此勒索，威胁向警方举报。

method.zhHans: 命案发生前二十分钟，幸子刻意让快递员把邮件交给一美签收，并当场确认圆珠笔还留有墨水——这封签收单就此成为她「不久后一美还活着」的时间证据。二十分钟后她持刀刺死一美，尸体倒地时圆珠笔滚落，她慌乱间抓起笔，随后把笔放进自己车里。

evidence.zhHans: 关键物证是那支圆珠笔：签收单上的笔迹证明一美当时还活着并能正常签字，而包裹签收与死亡之间只有二十分钟，期间出入公寓的只有幸子。柯南据此戳破幸子的不在场说法。

resolution.zhHans: 小五郎本已抓着圆珠笔要质问幸子，却因手从桌面滑开、头部撞到桌子当场昏倒；柯南改用变声领结以小五郎的声音完成推理，指认幸子为凶手。幸子认罪并交代一美以违禁商品之事勒索她。被带走时柯南问她为何不在那个观景点对小五郎下手，她答自己对小五郎并无怨恨。

title.ja: 小五郎のデート殺人事件 (Kogorō no Dēto Satsujin Jiken)
aliases: 小五郎のデート殺人事件

origin.note: 漫画改编，Volume 14，File.131-138（漫画案件 #37、#38 两个案件合为 2 小时特别篇）。

summary: EP.96 特别篇的第一案。被害人：九十九元康（Motoyasu Tsukumo），知名魔术师，死于氰化钾中毒；另有十四年前的旧案死者吉野（Yoshirou Kinoshita，20 岁），在水遁魔术中溺亡。

culprit.zhHans: 凶手是元康的弟子三代目（Mako Miyoshi），本名三代木下真湖（Mako Kinoshita）。旧案的真凶则是元康本人。

motive.zhHans: 为兄复仇。十四年前，才华出众的吉野在水遁逃脱魔术中溺亡，表面是意外，实为师父元康嫉妒其天赋、担心被超越而暗中动了手脚——元康在后台对手铐做了处理，使吉野表演时无法自行脱身而溺死。当时年仅七岁的真湖在后台目睹了元康动手，却因年纪太小无法作证，此案最终按意外结案。真湖此后苦学魔术，只为成为元康的入室弟子并伺机复仇。

method.zhHans: 真湖以弟子的身份接近元康，把元康绑起后以氰化钾将其毒杀，使元康死于氰酸钾中毒。元康知道她的真实身份与杀意，被绑后始终神态平静。

evidence.zhHans: 旧案的关键在于当年幼小的目击者所见与手铐被动手脚的事实；本案则以元康中毒的死因、以及弟子三人各自的动机与在场关系层层收束到真湖身上。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南在不弄晕小五郎的情况下协助破案，揭出真湖本名木下真湖、是被元康害死的吉野之妹，十四年前的事故实为谋杀。因元康被绑后毫无惧色，真湖一度威胁要杀掉元康的女儿绫乃（Ayano，6 岁），想看见他真正恐惧的表情；但绫乃终究无辜，真湖最后无法下手，也承认自己不止一次起过杀念。

origin.note: 漫画改编，与九十九元康案同属 Volume 14 File.131-138 的 2 小时特别篇。

summary: EP.96 特别篇的第二案，发生在群马县薮内家。被害人：薮内真知子（Machiko Yabuuchi），39 岁，薮内吉近的第二任妻子，胸腹受刀伤死亡，遗体被投入庭院水井——与第一任薮内夫人的死亡是同一口井；胸口插着一朵山茶花。另有以十字弓射向薮内芳房（Yoshifusa，64 岁）的未遂袭击。

culprit.zhHans: 「薮内芳房」是冒名顶替者。真芳房多年前已死在巴西，顶替者是田中秋彦（Hickson Tanaka），巴西出生的日裔，是卡洛斯（Carlos）的保镖兼监护人。真知子之死是他正当防卫中刺中对方所致；设置十字弓的是薮内圭子（Keiko Yabuuchi）。

motive.zhHans: 田中冒名的动机是保护卡洛斯：卡洛斯才是真芳房与巴西女子所生的儿子、遗产继承人之一。假冒芳房可让所有威胁指向自己，同时让外界以为卡洛斯只是保镖、不会对他动手。真知子之死源于她自己意图谋夺「芳房」的那份遗产：她不知道真芳房早已死亡，也不知道眼前的人是假的。圭子设十字弓是想逼「芳房」回巴西，她欠着债，指望没有这个人遗产份额就能覆盖。

method.zhHans: 真知子在都市酒会上打了一通电话制造不在场证明，然后坐车返回、等待下手时机；她事先告诉薮内裕美（Hiromi）去把加热露天浴池的火重新烧旺，借此让「芳房」被单独留在浴池。她带着那朵山茶花，打算把嫌疑引向一直指控薮内家害死自己姐姐的姐夫。但田中身手极好，她持刀刺去时被格挡、刀被反送回来，反而刺死了自己。

evidence.zhHans: 真知子胸口的山茶花与第一任薮内夫人溺亡的那口井构成刻意布置的误导；关键在「芳房」这个人的身份链——巴西的死亡记录、卡洛斯的真实身世，以及他收到的两封威胁信（一封来自真知子、一封来自圭子）。柯南的父亲优作随有希子回到日本并潜入薮内家，部分内容由他揭示，其余由柯南麻醉山村刑警后说出。

resolution.zhHans: 田中秋彦承认自己在真知子之死中的角色，说明自己是卡洛斯的家教兼保镖，随后平静地向警方投案。优作正式现身并去见有希子。另需注意：本集的表层主线是兰因看到柯南摘下眼镜的脸而怀疑他就是新一，有希子以一套复杂但说得通的解释替柯南脱身；这一层与命案本身相互独立。

origin.note: TV 原创（Filler），无漫画对应 File。

summary: 被害人：市川小太郎（Kotaro Ichikawa），65 岁，市川产业社长，死于毒物引发的心脏病发作。另有柯南被绑架囚禁于市川家酒窖地下室的插曲，被绑架者实为社长本人所安排。

culprit.zhHans: 社长的私人医生冈野仁（Hitoshi Okano）。

motive.zhHans: 复仇。市川当年把作为生意伙伴的冈野之父逼到破产，老人此后酗酒、抑郁，在久病的妻子去世几年后自杀，那时冈野正要上大学。身为私人医生，冈野随时都可以下手，但他一直忍着；直到市川向他吐露，打算装作心脏病发作来「测试」两个女儿和泉（Kazue）与瑞江（Mizue）到底有多爱自己，他才决定动手。

method.zhHans: 冈野没有按社长的剧本演戏，而是利用这场「测试」给市川注射了致命剂量的药物，让心脏病发作成为真实的死亡。绑架并囚禁柯南的人其实是市川本人——他事先安排，好让这场测试显得像真的。

evidence.zhHans: 柯南曾在洗手间看到和泉带着疑似装有药物的注射器走向酒窖，这条线索与后来绑匪身份的反转互相印证：真正动手的另有其人，且早有预谋地把别人的计划当成掩护。此外长女和泉确实起过杀父之心，也备有可用来下手的毒酒，但最终不是她下的手。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南与毛利小五郎逐一辨明视频证据与线索，把真凶指向私人医生冈野仁。冈野的动机由此被揭开：父亲的破产、酗酒与自杀，以及市川亲口说出的「测试」。

今村敏明、冈野仁、市川和江与市川瑞枝

summary: 毛利一家受邀到陶艺家喜久卫门（本名土屋万吉）宅邸度周末，席间小五郎赢得一只贵重陶杯。一夜饮酒后，众人发现长媳土屋益子吊死在储藏室。现场像自杀，目暮起初怀疑另有蹊跷。
victimDescription: 土屋益子（42 岁），喜久卫门已故长子的妻子，死因为缢死。

culprit.zhHans: 濑户隆一（Ryuichi Seto），喜久卫门的徒弟之一，35 岁。

motive.zhHans: 益子背著公公仿制喜久卫门的代表作品高价出售。她失手打碎一只仿品后极度恐慌，担心曝光；隆一看出碎片是赝品当面对质，劝她收手被粗暴顶回。隆一既因被拒、也因自尊受挫而动了杀机。

method.zhHans: 益子烂醉昏睡时，隆一把她抱进储藏室而不是卧室，塞进抽屉、脖颈边垂一条松绳，又把她当闹钟用的手机放她身旁。几小时后益子被手机闹铃吵醒，酒还没醒，起身时自己吊了上去。抽屉上突出的铁钉划开她的腿，成为现场血迹的来源。

evidence.zhHans: 「自杀」无法解释的两处硬伤：血迹来自抽屉外露铁钉造成的腿伤，与缢死过程吻合但和「因打破名品而愧疚自尽」的动机叙事对不上；以及她醒来的位置在抽屉里而非床上。隆一对赝品的知情，把「她怕被揭穿」这条线接到他自己身上。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南推翻自杀结论，指认隆一。手法成立的关键是益子用手机当闹钟的习惯——把她挪到绳下、再把闹钟放在她身边，等于让她自己完成绞刑。

title.ja: 名陶芸家殺人事件 (Meitōgeika Satsujin Jiken)

summary: 自称新一「初恋」的内田麻美（18 岁，东都大学文学部新生）邀小兰、园子和小五郎到别墅参加生日会。凌晨 2:50 别墅起火，麻美被困；柯南与小兰把她救出，小兰因吸入浓烟昏倒。
victimDescription: 内田麻美（18 岁），东都大学文学部新生，被烧成重伤但未死亡。本案是纵火未遂，不是杀人既遂。

culprit.zhHans: 泽井学（Manabu Sawai），22 岁，东都大学文学部四年级，推理研究会会长。

motive.zhHans: 不是要杀麻美。他上个月向麻美表白被拒——此前从没有女生拒绝过他——于是想制造一场「英雄救美」：把麻美置于险境，再由自己冲进去救出来，以此换取她的感激和爱意。

method.zhHans: 在传真机下方的椅子上摆好插着蜡烛的生日蛋糕，然后跑到便利店假装打电话，实际发出传真；传真纸落到未熄的蜡烛上引燃，火从客厅蔓延整栋屋子。他事先反复发过几份传真测试这个方法能成。

evidence.zhHans: 消防员递给柯南两张烧焦的纸，来自两份不同的传真——麻美教授发来的生日贺电，和泽井在便利店发的测试件。便利店店长记得众人唱歌时泽井单独用过传真机；传真确认页留有他的号码与指纹。柯南让消防员在废墟上复现同样的装置，证明他不必在场也能点火。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南借小五郎之口点破：众人离开后泽井趁「暂停」时间挪动家具，把被下了药的麻美从沙发搬到地板，以免她被烧到——这个「体贴」反倒成了破口。柯南怒斥他：只要路上塞车、抛锚或爆胎晚到两分钟，麻美就真的会死。泽井交出那张还沾着奶油的教授传真，平静自首。

summary: 小五郎带柯南、小兰去探班时代剧演员土方幸三郎，同栋公寓另一层住着特技演员冲田一。土方之妻、女演员永仓严在冲田房间隔壁的阳台上被发现吊死，尸体随后坠落。冲田有充分动机——永仓曾当面羞辱他，且他当晚的行踪说不清楚，警方几乎要定他的罪。
victimDescription: 永仓严（38 岁），女演员，土方幸三郎之妻。被钢丝勒死，尸体先被吊起，后坠落到楼下阳台。

culprit.zhHans: 土方幸三郎（51 岁），时代剧演员，被害人丈夫。

motive.zhHans: 两个动机叠加：妻子永仓严有外遇，同时他即将破产，需要她的保险金。他由此起了杀意。

method.zhHans: 他事先租下同栋楼里三间格局完全相同的公寓，在其中一间杀人后把尸体运到冲田房间隔壁的阳台。为了让人误判楼层，他涂黑了电梯楼层显示数字六左下角的那一笔，使「6」看起来像「5」；又刻意站在数字显示板前递名片，让同行的人都低头看名片而错过实际楼层。尸体先用钢丝吊在阳台上，再定时让钢丝断裂坠落，制造出刚被发现的时点。

evidence.zhHans: 决定性物证是小五郎在土方房里弄坏、随手塞进沙发坐垫下的一把道具枪。那把枪后来出现在众人被带往的房间里——而按土方的说法他们都待在五楼，道具枪却在六楼。柯南由此反推出电梯数字被动手脚，楼层判断整个错了。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南借小五郎之口拆穿：电梯「6」被刮改成「5」，递名片是让人低头的掩护，三间同装修公寓解释了尸体怎么能「凭空」出现在隔壁房间。土方承认杀人，动机是外遇加保险金。

aliases: 哥布林盗贼团洋馆事件
summary: 小五郎收到署名「中村操」的委托信，误以为是女性便兴冲冲赶去洋馆，到场却见两个自称是委托人亲属的男人，屋里几十座钟同时敲响，还有一座报时鸟被换成妖怪像的钟。真正的委托人中村操被绑架藏了起来。
victimDescription: 本案无命案被害人。真中村操（推理作家、饭渊茂次郎的外孙女）被绑架后关在阁楼，获救时存活。饭渊茂次郎本人已病故，死因与本案无关。另有两起未遂：小五郎与柯南在书房险遭枪击，小兰被勒颈挟持后自行反制。

culprit.zhHans: 两名假冒「中村操」及其兄长的男子，实为妖怪团（盗贼团）前成员。页面未给出二人姓名。

motive.zhHans: 不是为钱而杀人，而是为了宝石。两人想找出当年首领私吞、没有分给手下的赃物宝石。饭渊茂次郎生前把藏匿点的线索设计成钟表机关谜题，他们解不开，于是绑架真中村操、冒名写信把小五郎（实际是柯南）骗来借用推理能力。

method.zhHans: 绑架加冒充：把真中村操关进阁楼，由一人缠绷带伪装成她本人（绷带手里藏枪），另一人扮作她的兄长，用委托信引来名侦探。为逼迫解谜，他们在书房对柯南与小五郎开枪（未击中），又勒住循声赶来的小兰做人质。解谜线索本身是饭渊留下的两道：一座数字钟显示 11:00，最后两个零之间有一道划痕，读作 110|0，日语谐音「百獣の王」（ひゃくじゅうのおう）即百兽之王、指向狮子；第二道线索是字母 L N R，取 light / night / right 的首字母。柯南还用打火机照出妖怪像与钟表之间的对应关系，才看穿两人冒充者的身份。

evidence.zhHans: 绷带手中藏枪暴露两人并非委托人亲属；妖怪团的齿轮式手法与那座妖怪报时钟勾连，使柯南确认对方身份；阁楼里找到被绑的真中村操，绑架事实当场成立。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南解出 110|0 → 百獣の王 → 狮子，配合 L N R（光、夜、右）确定报时鸟的取法，找到藏在钟里的宝石。假中村操被小五郎打倒，其同伙被小兰制服，真中村操从阁楼获救。两名妖怪团前成员落网。

summary: 摄影师柳濑龙一在天使城饭店获颁第 35 届读切摄影奖，并当场得到一只新手表。记者中井晃突然现身，往他脸上吹了一把白色粉末。当夜中井打电话向小五郎求助，称有人要杀他；柯南赶到时，中井砸破窗户、浑身着火从公寓坠楼身亡。柳濑恰好在高架桥上拍下了全过程，声称纯属运气。
victimDescription: 中井晃（Atsushi Nakai），报社记者。头部遭钝器击打后被烧，砸破窗户坠楼身亡。

culprit.zhHans: 柳濑龙一（Ryuuichi Yanase），「犯罪摄影」摄影师，第 35 届读切摄影奖得主。

motive.zhHans: 灭口。柳濑那些获奖的「恰好拍到」的犯罪照片，全是他在现场动手布置后自己拍下的；中井看穿了这个把戏，当众往他脸上吹生石灰来摊牌——生石灰正是他用来纵火的手段。中井打电话给小五郎求助，等于要把事情捅出去，柳濑于是先下手。

method.zhHans: 生石灰（caustic lime）加水放热的延时纵火装置。生石灰遇水会产生高达约 300 度的放热反应，与运动场划线用的消石灰不同。他把生石灰和报纸一起布置在厨房水槽，并将水龙头扳手压到 1/4 开——水慢慢流出、渗进石灰，延迟一段时间后自燃。这段延迟正好够他离开公寓、赶到高架桥上「恰巧」拍到坠楼的瞬间。高架巴士乘客楼梯让他只需三分钟就能往返现场，所以他有办法先布置、再出现在远处的拍摄点。

evidence.zhHans: 决定性物证是他颁奖礼上刚拿到的那只手表，被发现烧毁在中井家厨房台面上；而他自己的手腕上表不见了。他辩称是中井偷的，柯南便请阿笠博士处理他获奖照片里车身反射的影像——放大后能看到案发前他手腕上还戴着那只表，而这只表出现在中井家厨房，证明他当时人在现场。另一旁证：他因看到烟雾而下意识加速，被监控拍到超速，粉色违章通知从他口袋掉了出来。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南借上电视节目与小五郎同台的机会麻醉小五郎，用变声领结以「名侦探」身份当面指认：纵火装置是生石灰，时间差由水龙头开度控制，获奖照片是自导自演，手表被烧毁在现场而照片证明他戴着表。柳濑无从辩解。

title.en: A Code of Stars and Tobacco
title.ja: 星とタバコのコード (Hoshi to Tabako no Kõdo)
ゾンビが囲む別荘 (Zonbi ga Kakomu Bessō?)

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Ria Kawabata. She helped Joji perform the trick but did not realize he had become stuck. His death was truthfully an unfortunate accident. A while later Takashi found messages from Joji inside the dresser where he had scratched in blood that he blamed Ria for his death. Takashi then began to blackmail Ria, which is why she killed him. Kyoko was killed because she realized that the video used for Takashi's death was the one from eight years ago.

motive.quote: Takashi then began to blackmail Ria, which is why she killed him.

method.quote: Conan reveals that the way the killer knew the movie subtitle was that they used a toilet paper roll to block out the light and make the words on the paper visible through the envelope.

evidence.quote: A while later Takashi found messages from Joji inside the dresser where he had scratched in blood that he blamed Ria for his death.

motive.zhHans: 随后 Takashi 开始敲诈 Ria，这就是她杀死他的原因。Kyoko 被杀是因为她察觉到用于 Takashi 死亡的录像是八年前的那一个。
motive.en: Takashi then began to blackmail Ria, which is why she killed him. Kyoko was killed because she realized that the video used for Takashi's death was the one from eight years ago.

method.zhHans: Conan 指出，凶手知道电影字幕的方法是用一卷卫生纸挡住光线，使信封内纸上的文字透出来。这和 Joji 八年前表演消失魔术时用的是同一手法。然而那是一个他独自一人无法完成的手法。她帮助 Joji 完成了这个手法，却没有意识到他已经卡在里面了。Kyoko 被杀是因为她察觉到用于 Takashi 死亡的录像是八年前的那一个。
method.en: Conan reveals that the way the killer knew the movie subtitle was that they used a toilet paper roll to block out the light and make the words on the paper visible through the envelope. This was the same trick that Joji had used for his disappearing act 8 years ago. However it was a trick that he couldn't do alone. She helped Joji perform the trick but did not realize he had become stuck. Kyoko was killed because she realized that the video used for Takashi's death was the one from eight years ago.

evidence.zhHans: 一段时间之后，Takashi 在梳妆台里发现了 Joji 留下的信息，他在上面用血刻下自己将死亡归咎于 Ria 的字句。
evidence.en: A while later Takashi found messages from Joji inside the dresser where he had scratched in blood that he blamed Ria for his death.

resolution.zhHans: Heiji 指出，手机上的录像是他们八年前拍摄那部电影时最初的素材。今天第一次见到 Takashi 和 Kyoko 时，Takashi 留着胡子、穿着不同的裤子，Kyoko 化着妆，发型也和两段录像里看到的略有不同。此外，如果放大来看，可以看到 Kyoko 的衬衫上有一个 E，而她的尸体上没有。
resolution.en: Heiji reveals that the videos on the cell phones are the ones that were originally from the movie they were filming eight years ago. When they first met Takashi and Kyoko today, Takashi had a beard and different pants and Kyoko was wearing makeup and her hair style was a bit different than what was seen in the two videos. Also if you zoom in, you can see an E on Kyoko's shirt that is not present on her corpse.

title.ja: 物言わぬ航路 (Mono Iwanu Kōro)

culpritSource.quote: After investigating, it is revealed the culprit (Masaharu Motoyama) took two plane rides to create his alibi. Instead of taking the direct route from Miyazaki to Okinawa, Motoyama had taken a plane to Tokyo first, then a retour flight (Flight JAL 931) to Okinawa, where he arrived at 9:20 am, precisely 10 minutes before he committed the murder. He then returned to the airport, pretending that he had just come off the direct Miyazaki-Okinawa flight. Hence Motoyama's cryptic historical reference to him being Hideyoshi and Noze being Mitsuhide, as Hideyoshi had caught up with Mitsuhide much quicke

motive.quote: While the tennis ball's felt coating could not retain Motoyama's fingerprints, Kogoro has suggested otherwise in order to have Motoyama guide him and the police to the location of the bloodstained raincoat and murder knife, still hidden in the trunk of the car Motoyama rented for the deed.

method.quote: After investigating, it is revealed the culprit (Masaharu Motoyama) took two plane rides to create his alibi.

evidence.quote: After investigating, it is revealed the culprit (Masaharu Motoyama) took two plane rides to create his alibi.

motive.zhHans: 网球表面的绒布留不住 Motoyama 的指纹，小五郎故意说成相反的情况，为的是让 Motoyama 自己带着他和警方去找那件沾血的雨衣和凶刀——它们还藏在 Motoyama 为行凶而租的那辆车的后备箱里。后来野濑利用自己的人脉替 Motoyama 弄到了体育记者的工作；而 Motoyama 事后通过一段体育脱口秀未经剪辑的录音震惊地得知，野濑当初是故意让他退出竞技生涯的，为的是除掉这个他视为争夺名声的对手。
motive.en: While the tennis ball's felt coating could not retain Motoyama's fingerprints, Kogoro has suggested otherwise in order to have Motoyama guide him and the police to the location of the bloodstained raincoat and murder knife, still hidden in the trunk of the car Motoyama rented for the deed. While Nose subsequently used his contacts to get Motoyama the sports reporting job, a shocked Motoyama learned later, through an unedited studio recording of a sports talkshow, that Nose had intentionally caused Motoyama to drop out of active sports in order to get rid of, what he considered, his competitor for fame.

method.zhHans: 经调查揭示，犯人（Masaharu Motoyama）坐了两趟飞机来制造不在场证明。随后他回到机场，装作自己刚从那班宫崎—冲绳直飞航班下来。Motoyama 碰巧与柯南、小兰和小五郎同机，并且化了装，还接住了小兰不小心掉下的一颗球。后来野濑利用自己的人脉替 Motoyama 弄到了体育记者的工作；而 Motoyama 事后通过一段体育脱口秀未经剪辑的录音震惊地得知，野濑当初是故意让他退出竞技生涯的，为的是除掉这个他视为争夺名声的对手。
method.en: After investigating, it is revealed the culprit (Masaharu Motoyama) took two plane rides to create his alibi. He then returned to the airport, pretending that he had just come off the direct Miyazaki-Okinawa flight. Motoyama was incidentally on the same flight Conan, Ran and Kogoro had boarded and, in disguise, had caught one of the balls Ran had inadvertently dropped. While Nose subsequently used his contacts to get Motoyama the sports reporting job, a shocked Motoyama learned later, through an unedited studio recording of a sports talkshow, that Nose had intentionally caused Motoyama to drop out of active sports in order to get rid of, what he considered, his competitor for fame.

evidence.zhHans: 经调查揭示，犯人（Masaharu Motoyama）坐了两趟飞机来制造不在场证明。网球表面的绒布留不住 Motoyama 的指纹，小五郎故意说成相反的情况，为的是让 Motoyama 自己带着他和警方去找那件沾血的雨衣和凶刀——它们还藏在 Motoyama 为行凶而租的那辆车的后备箱里。
evidence.en: After investigating, it is revealed the culprit (Masaharu Motoyama) took two plane rides to create his alibi. While the tennis ball's felt coating could not retain Motoyama's fingerprints, Kogoro has suggested otherwise in order to have Motoyama guide him and the police to the location of the bloodstained raincoat and murder knife, still hidden in the trunk of the car Motoyama rented for the deed.

resolution.zhHans: 经调查揭示，犯人（Masaharu Motoyama）坐了两趟飞机来制造不在场证明。他没有走宫崎到冲绳的直飞航线，而是先飞到东京，再搭乘一趟返回航班（JAL 931），于上午 9:20 抵达冲绳——正好在他行凶前 10 分钟。随后他回到机场，装作自己刚从那班宫崎—冲绳直飞航班下来。因此 Motoyama 才留下那句晦涩的历史典故：他是秀吉，野濑是光秀——因为秀吉追上光秀的速度远比预想得快。
resolution.en: After investigating, it is revealed the culprit (Masaharu Motoyama) took two plane rides to create his alibi. Instead of taking the direct route from Miyazaki to Okinawa, Motoyama had taken a plane to Tokyo first, then a retour flight (Flight JAL 931) to Okinawa, where he arrived at 9:20 am, precisely 10 minutes before he committed the murder. He then returned to the airport, pretending that he had just come off the direct Miyazaki-Okinawa flight. Hence Motoyama's cryptic historical reference to him being Hideyoshi and Noze being Mitsuhide, as Hideyoshi had caught up with Mitsuhide much quicker than anticipated.

method.quote: Conan figures out the trick to the locked room murder was stringing the 200 Shobel masks into a weapon that extended 3 meters long with a knife at the very end.

Knowing that his mother wasn't responsible for the accident as on that day she was celebrating his birthday with him, he decided to take revenge Suou in and pinned the crime on Inaba, who was also involved with Suou's charity fraud.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Touya Aikawa。柯南解开了密室杀人的手法：把 200 张肖贝尔面具串成一件长达 3 米的凶器，最前端绑着刀。证据是其中一张面具上血迹分布不均，随后的血迹只溅在其他面具的嘴部周围。Touya 认罪，并交代他的母亲曾被指责为一起肇事逃逸的肇事者——那起事故其实是 Suou 本人造成的，Katagiri 的妻子因此身亡，之后又被 Suou 杀害，而 Suou 是靠办慈善博取名声与利益起家的。外界一直认为 Aikawa 夫人之死是自杀。他得知母亲对那起事故并无责任——事发当天她正陪他过生日——于是决定向 Suou 复仇，并把罪名栽给同样牵涉 Suou 慈善诈骗案的 Inaba。
resolution.en: The culprit is Touya Aikawa. Conan figures out the trick to the locked room murder was stringing the 200 Shobel masks into a weapon that extended 3 meters long with a knife at the very end. This was proven by the uneven distribution of blood on one mask, and the subsequent splatters of blood on other masks, but only around the mouths. Touya confesses and reveals that his mother was blamed for a hit and run incident in which Suou herself had caused, in which Katagiri's wife was killed, and later murdered by Suou, who started her charity for the fame and profit. Mrs. Aikawa's death was believed to be a suicide since then by the public. Knowing that his mother wasn't responsible for the accident as on that day she was celebrating his birthday with him, he decided to take revenge Suou in and pinned the crime on Inaba, who was also involved with Suou's charity fraud.

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are invited to stay at a mansion by Beniko Suo, the hostess of a car accident charity, in North Shinjuku forest. While driving, they find a message from the Phantom of the Cursed Masks, who tells them they should not go the place. Once there, they find other famous celebrities: a baseball player, a prophet, a rockstar, and a photographer who lost his wife in a "Hit and Run" incident. The mansion is huge and divided into east and west sides, with the twin sisters Minaho and Honami Shimogasa taking care of each wings, and the only room connecting the two sides is the mask room. The mask room is locked at midnight each night due to Beniko's collection of Julio González's masks, a collection of 200 masks that are believed to be cursed. They were created by a famous man who lost everything and became engrossed in his masks; once he created 200 of them, he was found dead in his room surrounded with bloody masks. People who have owned his masks have suffered tragic fates. Suo, who now owns all 200 masks, had a priest place a seal on the curse, but the room is locked at midnight to prevent the masks from wandering. During their stay, Suo is murdered in a locked room, with Shobel's masks surrounding her and a dagger in her throat.

suspects: Masanori Katagiri, Mamoru Matsudaira, Haruka Nagara, Honami Shimogasa, Minaho Shimogasa, Kazuyo Inaba, and Touya Aikawa

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Kaori Kosuda. She had coveted the rare ticket because she wanted to impress her boyfriend, a guitarist, on his birthday. However, at the day Ran and Sonoko visited the cafe, she overheard Kona telling her friend that her own boyfriend was also a guitarist and would have his birthday at exactly the same date, indicating that her man was really an exploitative two-timer. Not only that, but the man was planning to the tickets Kosuda had brought for them to take Kona, his other woman, to the concert. Therefore Kosuda committed the theft.

motive.quote: She had coveted the rare ticket because she wanted to impress her boyfriend, a guitarist, on his birthday.

method.quote: However, Mooka had overlooked a red ball pen (used in the cafe for writing down customer orders) in the pocket of Kosuda's apron, and as the apron was being washed, the pen's ink was diluted and spilled out, staining Mooka's other laundry pieces in the machine.

motive.en: She had coveted the rare ticket because she wanted to impress her boyfriend, a guitarist, on his birthday. Kosuda attempted to make the accident look like the work of a burglar, and in order to facilitate the ruse, she replaced her own apron with Mooka's.

method.zhHans: 然而，Mooka 忽略了 Kosuda 围裙口袋里的一支红色圆珠笔（咖啡馆里用来记录顾客点单的），围裙被清洗时，笔里的墨水被泡开溢出，染脏了洗衣机里 Mooka 的其他衣物。

evidence.zhHans: 她在把围裙放进洗衣机之前就找到了那张门票，并且正打算拿到网上去卖。

resolution.zhHans: 凶手是 Kaori Kosuda。她觊觎那张稀有门票，是想在她男朋友——一名吉他手——生日那天给他一个惊喜。然而，在毛利兰和铃木园子造访咖啡馆那天，她无意中听见 Kona 跟朋友说，她自己的男朋友也是吉他手，而且生日恰好是同一天，这说明她的男人其实是个脚踏两条船、占尽便宜的家伙。不止如此，那男人还打算用 Kosuda 买好的那两张门票，带 Kona——他的另一个女人——去听演唱会。于是 Kosuda 实施了偷窃。
resolution.en: The culprit is Kaori Kosuda. She had coveted the rare ticket because she wanted to impress her boyfriend, a guitarist, on his birthday. However, at the day Ran and Sonoko visited the cafe, she overheard Kona telling her friend that her own boyfriend was also a guitarist and would have his birthday at exactly the same date, indicating that her man was really an exploitative two-timer. Not only that, but the man was planning to the tickets Kosuda had brought for them to take Kona, his other woman, to the concert. Therefore Kosuda committed the theft.

summary.en: In a bar called "Marin Coffee", Sonoko tells Ran to be able to get two tickets for a concert. At the same moment, a girl becomes aware due to not having with her tickets for the same event and charges Sonoko of theft. The next day, the girl comes back in the room stating that her tickets were put on sale in internet and the nickname of the seller led her to think that tickets have been stolen by one of the waiters.

title.ja: 宝石強盗現行犯 (Hōseki Gōtō Genkōhan)

culpritSource.quote: The Detective Boys and Conan solve the case and show the police that they were wrong about almost everything that happened. The culprit is Sakanobu Nekota. It was revealed that Atomura was not the robber they saw, but Nekota was actually the one.

motive.quote: Because Nekota was a former Triathlonist, he had no problem in performing the stated stunts.

method.quote: After he had confirmed that the body landed on the truck, he set up the rope used for the escape and had the workers continue the moving.

evidence.quote: It was revealed that Atomura was not the robber they saw, but Nekota was actually the one.

motive.zhHans: 由于 Nekota 出身铁人三项选手，完成那些动作毫无问题。又因为他必须尽快赶去和发现 Atomura 尸体的人会合，他来不及处理掉化装用品、绳索，以及抢劫时放在外套口袋里的那枚胸针。Nekota 不愿被勒索，于是决定让 Atomura 永远闭嘴。但他对杀害 Atomura 也怀着愧疚——从两人创立公司那天起，他们就一起吃苦、并肩工作；于是他决定先把胸针留着，等风波过去，再以「她亡夫生前留下的礼物」之名交给 Atomura 的妻子。
motive.en: Because Nekota was a former Triathlonist, he had no problem in performing the stated stunts. Because he had to join up with those that discover Atomura's body as fast as possible, he is unable to dispose of the disguises, rope, or the broach that he had kept in the coat's pocket during the robbery. Not willing to be blackmailed, Nekota decided to silence Atomura. However, Nekota also feels guity about murdering Atomura, as he had gone through hardship and worked alongside him since the day they founded the company, and decides to keep the broach until the situation die down and gives it to Atomura's wife as the "present from her late husband".

method.zhHans: 在确认尸体落到卡车上之后，他架好逃跑用的绳索，让工人们继续搬东西。接着，他化装去抢劫珠宝店，并把高木引到旧事务所对面那栋楼的楼顶。又因为他必须尽快赶去和发现 Atomura 尸体的人会合，他来不及处理掉化装用品、绳索，以及抢劫时放在外套口袋里的那枚胸针。另一方面，由美又在盘算让另一位警官上她的当。
method.en: After he had confirmed that the body landed on the truck, he set up the rope used for the escape and had the workers continue the moving. Next, he went to rob the jewelry store in disguise, and lured Takagi to the top of the building across the old office. Because he had to join up with those that discover Atomura's body as fast as possible, he is unable to dispose of the disguises, rope, or the broach that he had kept in the coat's pocket during the robbery. Elsewhere, Yumi is scheming for another officer to fall for her trick again.

evidence.zhHans: 经揭示，他们看到的那个强盗并不是 Atomura，真正的犯人其实是 Nekota。
evidence.en: It was revealed that Atomura was not the robber they saw, but Nekota was actually the one.

resolution.zhHans: 少年侦探团与柯南解开案件，向警方证明他们对整起事件的判断几乎全都错了。犯人是 Sakanobu Nekota。经揭示，他们看到的那个强盗并不是 Atomura，真正的犯人其实是 Nekota。首先，Nekota 把搬家工人叫到旧事务所的九楼，把 Atomura 推了下去。在确认尸体落到卡车上之后，他架好逃跑用的绳索，让工人们继续搬东西。
resolution.en: The Detective Boys and Conan solve the case and show the police that they were wrong about almost everything that happened. The culprit is Sakanobu Nekota. It was revealed that Atomura was not the robber they saw, but Nekota was actually the one. First, Nekota called the moving workers to the 9th floor of his old office and pushed Atomura to his doom. After he had confirmed that the body landed on the truck, he set up the rope used for the escape and had the workers continue the moving.

summary.en: Yokoto Owada, a doctor of the Beika Central Hospital, wins the third place prize at a raffle. The raffle makes it his third winning of the week: the first was a lottery, the second was a one year supply of beer. When Conan returns home, he discovers that the one year supply of beer that Owada supposedly won is a lie because the draw had been postponed and hadn't started yet. The next day, the Detective Boys find out the raffle had been fixed by a tall and slender woman posing as the doctor's wife. While investigating, they overhear gossip of the doctor's other made up winnings. What was the purpose of these strange rumors?

summary.en: Kazunobu Chiba searches the storage room of Teitan Elementary School for an thirteen year old VHS tape from his childhood love, Naeko Miike, which contains the reply to his love letter. At the same time, the Detective Boys are sent to the archives to search for a tape for their teacher. Chiba reveals to them that he received a phone call from Naeko Miike asking him if he has seen the tape, prompting him to resume his search for it. Conan deduces the tape contains the video Chiba and Naeko filmed years ago and finds the tape has been recorded over.

title.en: A Woman Standing by the Window
title.ja: 窓辺にたたずむ女 (Madobe ni tatazumu onna)

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Tatsuko Dojima. She was actually the one who robbed Towa Akabane's jewelry in order to "teach the latter a lesson" for flaunting her richness. However, Tatsuko became paranoid of Saki witnessing her crime due to the latter's habit of sitting by the window, waiting for her boyfriend who never came back. Fearing for Saki's reputation as a blackmailer in order to clean up her boyfriend's debt, Tatsuko plotted to murder her.

motive.quote: She was actually the one who robbed Towa Akabane's jewelry in order to "teach the latter a lesson" for flaunting her richness.

method.quote: Tatsuko lured Saki to her room, pretending to have information about Saki's boyfriend.

motive.zhHans: 她实际上就是偷走 Towa Akabane 珠宝的人，目的是为了"教训"后者炫耀自己的富有。出于对 Saki 作为敲诈者的名声的担忧，为了还清男友的债务，Tatsuko 策划杀害她。杀人手法与证据 首先，Tatsuko 向 Junnosuke Tachibana 和 Michiyo Konno 寄出敲诈信，以增加该案的潜在嫌疑人，并煽动其中一人替她杀害 Saki，Numagaki 上钩了。由于在 Saki 坠落的时间段内她有不在场证明，Tatsuko 会被警方排除在嫌疑人名单之外。此外，由于 Tatsuko 对自己的诡计非常有信心，她不太可能把犯罪的所有罪证都处理在自己房间里，而那些罪证一旦警方开始搜查必定会被找到。
motive.en: She was actually the one who robbed Towa Akabane's jewelry in order to "teach the latter a lesson" for flaunting her richness. Fearing for Saki's reputation as a blackmailer in order to clean up her boyfriend's debt, Tatsuko plotted to murder her. Because she has an alibi during the time that Saki fell, Tatsuko would be excluded from the list of suspects by the police. Additionally, because Tatsuko is very confident about her trick, she is unlikely to have disposed all the incriminating evidences of the crime in her room, which are sure to be found once the police begin their search.

Because she has an alibi during the time that Saki fell, Tatsuko would be excluded from the list of suspects by the police. Additionally, because Tatsuko is very confident about her trick, she is unlikely to have disposed all the incriminating evidences of the crime in her room, which are sure to be found once the police begin their search.

Fearing for Saki's reputation as a blackmailer in order to clean up her boyfriend's debt, Tatsuko plotted to murder her.

title.ja: 灰原哀監禁事件 (Haibara Ai Kankin Jiken)

summary.en: The Detective Boys are wandering the streets in the residential area around Professor Agasa's house, worrying about Haibara, who has gone missing since she went shopping several hours ago. At first, Genta, Mitsuhiko, and Ayumi are wondering whether Haibara has become the victim of a traffic accident, but then Conan finds a cat's shawl lying on the street. Seeing this, he remembers how he, Haibara and the Professor recently met a friendly young woman named Mitsuru Higaki, along with her pet cat Chiro, who wore the shawl, and her Indian Star Tortoise.

title.en: Akaoni Village Fire Festival Murder Case
title.ja: 赤鬼村火祭殺人事件 (Akaoni Mura Himatsuri Sastujin Jiken)

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Yutaka Abe. Yutaka's reason to kill his best friend is that he is on the verge of bankruptcy and he tricked the much richer Negishi to fall on his plan. He made a bet with a drunk Negishi that if he successfully went into hiding, Abe would give his life insurance policy to him. He betrayed Negishi, then commited the murder because he wanted to take the insurance.

motive.quote: He made a bet with a drunk Negishi that if he successfully went into hiding, Abe would give his life insurance policy to him.

method.quote: Yutaka's reason to kill his best friend is that he is on the verge of bankruptcy and he tricked the much richer Negishi to fall on his plan.

evidence.quote: This is the proof that the person Kogoro stalked is not Negishi but a different person.

motive.zhHans: 他与喝醉的 Negishi 打赌：只要他能成功藏匿起来，Abe 就把自己的人寿保险金给他。他背弃了这个约定，随后为了把那笔保险金据为己有而杀人。第二天，Yutaka 让小五郎跟踪一个长相酷似 Negishi 的替身，好让小五郎以为 Negishi 一直到周三夜里都还活着。Yutaka 的计划是带着 Negishi 的钱逃往国外，去西雅图。
motive.en: He made a bet with a drunk Negishi that if he successfully went into hiding, Abe would give his life insurance policy to him. He betrayed Negishi, then commited the murder because he wanted to take the insurance. The next day, Yutaka had Kogoro follow a fake who looked like Negishi in order to make him think Negishi was alive through Wednesday night. Yutaka's plan is to escape the country, going to Seattle, taking Negishi's money with him.

method.zhHans: Yutaka 杀害挚友的原因是濒临破产，于是他设计让远比他有钱的 Negishi 落入自己的圈套。第二天，他让小五郎跟踪一个长相酷似 Negishi 的替身，好让小五郎以为 Negishi 一直到周三夜里都还活着。接着，Yutaka 在周五夜里结束旅行归来，装作若无其事，并拿出了完整的不在场证明。小五郎意识到自己被欺骗后怒不可遏，但他只能证明 Yutaka 骗他去跟踪了一个替身，并不能证明 Yutaka 就是凶手。所幸柯南在 Yutaka 登机外逃之前当面揭穿了他，设法诱使他亲口承认罪行并录了下来。
method.en: Yutaka's reason to kill his best friend is that he is on the verge of bankruptcy and he tricked the much richer Negishi to fall on his plan. The next day, Yutaka had Kogoro follow a fake who looked like Negishi in order to make him think Negishi was alive through Wednesday night. Then, Yutaka came back from his trip on Friday night acting innocent with his complete alibi. Kogoro is completely infuriated when he realizes that he had been lied to, but he can only prove that Yutaka tricked him into following a double, NOT that he is the criminal. Fortunately, Conan confronts him for the murder before he escapes on an airplane and Conan manages to trick him and record him admitting the crime.

evidence.zhHans: 这就是证据，说明小五郎跟踪的人并非 Negishi，而是另一个人。Negishi 的尸体是在周四傍晚、也就是著名的火祭期间被发现的。小五郎意识到自己被欺骗后怒不可遏，但他只能证明 Yutaka 骗他去跟踪了一个替身，并不能证明 Yutaka 就是凶手。柯南还把录音磁带留在 Yutaka 身边，这样警方找到他时，就能凭充分的证据将他逮捕。
evidence.en: This is the proof that the person Kogoro stalked is not Negishi but a different person. Negishi's body was found on Thursday evening, during the famous fire festival. Kogoro is completely infuriated when he realizes that he had been lied to, but he can only prove that Yutaka tricked him into following a double, NOT that he is the criminal. Conan also leaves the casette tape beside Yutaka so when the police find him, he will be arrested with sufficient evidence.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Yutaka Abe。他杀害挚友的原因是濒临破产，于是他设计让远比他有钱的 Negishi 落入自己的圈套。他与喝醉的 Negishi 打赌：只要他能成功藏匿起来，Abe 就把自己的人寿保险金给他。他背弃了这个约定，随后为了把那笔保险金据为己有而杀人。Negishi 实际上是在周二夜里、也就是 Yutaka 出发去九州旅行前的那晚死亡的。第二天，Yutaka 让小五郎跟踪一个长相酷似 Negishi 的替身，好让小五郎以为 Negishi 一直到周三夜里都还活着。Negishi 是右撇子，而照片上的男人却是左撇子。这就是证据，说明小五郎跟踪的人并非 Negishi，而是另一个人。
resolution.en: The culprit is Yutaka Abe. Yutaka's reason to kill his best friend is that he is on the verge of bankruptcy and he tricked the much richer Negishi to fall on his plan. He made a bet with a drunk Negishi that if he successfully went into hiding, Abe would give his life insurance policy to him. He betrayed Negishi, then commited the murder because he wanted to take the insurance. Negishi really died on Tuesday night, the night before Yutaka left on his vacation in Kyushu. The next day, Yutaka had Kogoro follow a fake who looked like Negishi in order to make him think Negishi was alive through Wednesday night. Negishi is right-handed but the man on the photos is left-handed. This is the proof that the person Kogoro stalked is not Negishi but a different person.

summary.en: As Conan is waking form Agasa house he sees Kogoro following someone. When he asks, Kogoro sends Conan home for dinner. A few days later at the Akaoni Village Fire Festival a burnt body is found in the fire.

title.ja: 宮野明美のタイムカプセル (Miyano Akemi no Taimu Kapuseru)
アリバイ証言殺人事件 (Aribai Shōgen Satsujin Jiken)
title.zhHans: 不在场证明证词杀人事件

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are meeting Souhei Tatsumi, a well-known lawyer with many large corporations as clients, who's office is in a luxury hotel. While there, Conan picks up a phone call from Souhei's wife, Kazumi Tatsumi. During the phone call, a musical melody is heard from Kazumi's side. Souhei takes over the phone call and tells his wife he will call later and asks Conan and Ran to leave so he may talk with Kogoro. Kogoro returns telling Ran and Conan he took Souhei's request to spy on Kazumi and her affair. On the way home, they spot police cars in front of a house and decide to investigate. They found out it is Souhei Tatsumi's house. Inside they learn that Kazumi was found dead in the bathtub.

title.en: Alpine Hut in the Snowy Mountain Murder Case
title.ja: 雪山山荘殺人事件 (Yukiyama Sansō Satsujin Jiken)

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are on a skiing holiday. Since Kogoro has lost the key to their ski lodge, they accept Professor Masashi Oyama's invitation to his lodge. At dinner, they meet his assistants, who are celebrating the success of his latest publication. After dinner, everyone goes their separate ways. Kaori Nakahara, who forgot something while shopping, goes back to get groceries for the others, Professor Oyama watches his favorite TV show, Ginji Tobita goes night skiing, and Tomoyasu Kanazawa takes a bath. While Kogoro sleeps off his hangover, Conan and Ran help Kaho Ezumi with the dishes.

suspects: Kaori Nakahara, Tomoyasu Kanazawa, Ginji Tobita, and Kaho Ezumi

summary.en: What began as an enjoyable day for Kogoro, Conan, and Ran, who is being interviewed for a potential job as a fashion model for Eiko Ashiya, a top fashion designer in Japan, soon turns deadly as Mika Taniguchi, Eiko's secretary, is found dead. All signs point to a simple break in, but Conan knows that not all is as it seems.

title.en: An Encouragement of the Perfect Crime

summary.en: Takagi and Sato request Kogoro's help investigating multiple criminal activities that were plotted by the help of a mastermind. A criminal advisor who has been giving criminals plots for the "perfect crime".

title.en: An Idol's Locked Room Murder Case
title.ja: アイドル密室殺人事件 (Aidoru Misshitsu Satsujin Jiken)

summary.en: Conan declines to walk home from school with classmates Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko. He arrives at the Mouri Detective Agency to see that without work, Kogoro spent all day drinking beer and watching his favorite popstar, Yoko Okino, on TV. When a client arrives during one of her shows, Kogoro even tries to make them return later, until he realizes that the client is Yoko Okino herself, accompanied by her manager. Kogoro quickly makes himself presentable and hears her concerns about a recent stalker. He agrees to investigate at her apartment, and Ran and Conan tag along. Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko were watching the agency and also follow, so when the front door opens everyone sees the body on the floor inside.

suspects: Yoko Okino, Yuko Ikezawa, and Eiichi Yamagishi
suspectsZh: 冲野洋子、池泽优子与山岸荣一

title.en: And It'd Be Nice if Everybody Disappeared

summary.en: A man named Yasutaro Sasamoto is nearly killed by a falling cinder block. He believes that it's his old college friend, Taeichi Hikage, who disappeared three years ago, since he has written a murder novel with a prophecy where he kills his three friends from college. One of the friends, Takeshi Nezu, was already discovered murdered in a park, and so the two remaining friends seek Kogoro's help.

While discussing the reward and how they should tackle the issue, a man named Koji Tanaka passes by and gets caught up in it as soon as he and Conan see the suspect's face.

title.ja: 美術館オーナー殺人事件 (Bijutsukan Ōnā Satsujin Jiken)

summary.en: Two security guards at the Beika Art Museum see a medieval suit of armor moving on its own. Ran hears the rumor and wants to visit the museum; when Conan and Kogoro mock her for believing it might be true, she forces them to come along after her fearsome display of smashing Kogoro's desk with her fist. While admiring a painting, Ran meets Ochiai, the curator of the museum, who explains his love for the art and then berates a museum worker named Kubota for not handling a painting properly. Another worker, Iijima, takes over the job before they are interrupted by the museum's new owner, Manaka, arriving with an architect. The museum will be demolished soon to make a casino, despite the sale having hinged on the promise to keep the museum open. After Kubota accidentally drops a helmet, Manaka mentions his plans to sell all the museum pieces, which frustrates Kubota enough to throw it down after, but Conan notices that Ochiai doesn't lecture Kubota this time.

title.en: Ballad of the Woman Who Loved Cake
title.ja: ケーキを愛する女のバラード (Kēki o Aisuru Onna no Barādo)

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Yayoi Ito. She is revealed to be the mysterious woman that came to the shop a week ago and planned the murder, using Hanako Ogawa and the Detective Boys. The woman who was crushed by the building's debris was not Yayoi, but Hanako. Yayoi tricked Hanako in coming to the abandoned building, where she already prepared a trap. Hanako trigged the trap and was crushed by the debris.

motive.quote: Because of that, she also planned to murder them.

method.quote: She is revealed to be the mysterious woman that came to the shop a week ago and planned the murder, using Hanako Ogawa and the Detective Boys.

evidence.quote: She is revealed to be the mysterious woman that came to the shop a week ago and planned the murder, using Hanako Ogawa and the Detective Boys.

motive.zhHans: 因为这个缘故，她也策划了杀害他们的行动。
motive.en: Because of that, she also planned to murder them.

method.zhHans: 她被揭露是一个星期前来过店里、并策划了这场谋杀的神秘女人，她利用了小川花子和少年侦探团。Yayoi 把 Hanako Ogawa 诱骗到废弃大楼，那里她早已布置好了陷阱。她还从大楼到蛋糕店伪造了一条血迹。在制造好不在场证明之后，她前去杀害社长，来到店里，穿上和 Hanako 相同的连衣裙，在腿上制造假伤口，然后若无其事地吃着蛋糕。幸运的是，江户川柯南事先提醒了 Hiroshi，说凶手就是 Yayoi，并让他和妻子在没有吃下 Yayoi 准备的有毒蛋糕的情况下，假装中毒。
method.en: She is revealed to be the mysterious woman that came to the shop a week ago and planned the murder, using Hanako Ogawa and the Detective Boys. Yayoi tricked Hanako in coming to the abandoned building, where she already prepared a trap. She also made a fake blood trail from the building to the cake shop. resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Kenya Settsu。他在毛利兰进入 Waka 房间的 30 分钟前杀害了 Waka，把毛巾缠在她头上、给她戴上口罩，然后在浴室里散播三氯甲烷。几天前，他已设法让 Rumi 在一个瓶子上留下指纹，而这个瓶子看来正是警方找到的、装有三氯甲烷的那个瓶子。这一切让世良真纯指认 Rumi 就是犯人（正如 Kenya 所预判）：那条毛巾和那只口罩会让毛利兰怀疑自己是否真的见到了 Waka，或者那其实不是 Rumi 假扮成 Waka——那么，在毛利兰昏倒之后，她就会真的杀死 Waka，并把 Waka 与这些物件一并安置在浴室里，仿佛她从一开始就在那里。但江户川柯南指出，这个诡计实在太不连贯；他还注意到，Kenya 一直被表现为视力很差（无法把物体放到正确的位置等），而这可能是因为他的一片隐形眼镜不见了。那片隐形眼镜其实是在他与 Waka 搏斗时脱落的，而 Waka 在昏过去之前把它捡起来、戴到自己眼上，然后闭上了眼睛，这就解释了她为什么一直在眨眼。因此，只要掰开她闭着的那只眼，就能证明 Kenya 就是凶手：他的指纹仍会留在那片隐形眼镜上。
resolution.en: The culprit is Kenya Settsu. He killed Waka 30 minutes before Ran came into her room, put a towel around her head and a face mask on her, then spread chloroform in the bathroom. A few days before, he had ensured Rumi had left her fingerprints on a bottle, which appeared to be the bottle containing the chloroform which was found by the police. All this led Masumi Sera to point Rumi as the culprit (as Kenya had foreseen that): the towel and the face mask would lead Ran to doubt if she really saw Waka, or if it was not rather Rumi who had disguised herself in Waka - then, after Ran had collapsed, she would have really killed Waka and put them in the bathroom as if she had been there from the beginning. But Conan declares that this trick was way too inconsistent; he also notices that Kenya has been shown to have a bad sight (being unable to put objects at the right place, etc.), and that it may be due to the disappearing of one of his eyes contacts. This eye contact had actually been lost when he was fighting with Waka, and before passing out, she had collected it and put it on her own eye, before closing it, which explains why she was winking. By opening her closed eye, it could be therefore proved that Kenya was the murderer: his fingerprints would still be on the eye contact.

summary.en: As Conan and Ran are waiting for a meeting with Eri, they meet Masumi, who is investigating Rumi Kitao's boyfriend, Kenya Settsu, about adultery. Thinking that Kenya will make a move upon seeing Ran, Masumi has Conan and Ran approach the couple upon the pretense of needing a meal. However, Kenya doesn't seem to be interested in Ran and asks Ran to accompany Rumi to wake Waka, Kenya's ex-girlfriend. Rumi and Ran has to open Waka's apartment with a key when no one answers.

suspects: Rumi Kitao, Kenya Settsu, and Mitsuaki Kaga

Ishigami said that he hadn't come over. However, Cha-Cha did but it's unimaginable that a kitten opened the door and came in. In other words, that fragment came from another beckoning cat that didn't belong to this collection. Then Conan, who gets lifted by two strikers, which heads the goal. Lastly, Kento Tachibanada, a player from the Kawasaki Frontale team, shoots the ball into the goal. Detective Boys gets extremely satisfied, Mitsuhiko then asks Kento what his secret to success is, he answers steadily: "First, relax and calm down." "And, keep a broad field of view. Look at not the pitch, but the entire stadium." Kuryu Matsuki added. Conan sighs and thinks people who compete internationally are on another level. At the same time, within the Metropolitan Police Department, Megure seems to be well-dressed for something. However, when his colleague asks him, he conceals his intent, and utters that it is only some minor business.

summary.en: At the greenhouse, the wealthy property owner named Zenzou Sunada is showing Conan, Ran, and Sonoko the golden barrel cactus and it blooms flowers after 50 years. Zenzou raised it when it was small when he was Ran's age. He was able to get it big and make the flowers bloom. In the past of the greenhouse, Sonoko came with her father when she was a little baby and she barely walked. There is a flower on top of the golden barrel cactus and it looks as if it's trapped by thorns on top. The yellow ones are growing. Not just only that, Zenzou has lots of expensive cactuses in the greenhouse and he sets up the security alarm system. After night falls, only he can deactivate the system with his home security card. He always keeps the card in his breast pocket and he thinks it feels most reassuring. Suddenly, Zenzou's two sons named Naoki and Yasuyuki appear and they heard from the lawyer that Zenzou rewrite the will. They want to know why but Zenzou tells his sons to be quiet because he has guests. After that, they left. Suddenly, Zenzou notice the ceramic pots and calls his housekeeper named Yashiro to come at once. He wants her to take them away in a big fuss. Yashiro apologizes and takes the pots away. Zenzou is now going back home but Ran, Sonoko, and Conan can stick around in the greenhouse.

Coincidentally, Daigo's call with his secretary contained terms that Reira may have misinterpreted as Daigo having a call with legal officials, leading him to believe that she was in some kind of legal trouble.

He tries to convince himself that it doesn't matter, but then he decides to tag along anyway.

summary.en: Shinichi realizes that the poison shrunk him, and after making it home, asks Professor Agasa for help. Agasa warns that to stay safely hidden from the men in black, Shinichi can tell no one else, even Ran - who coincidentally shows up, intending to check on Shinichi. Agasa convinces her to look after Shinichi, who tells her his name is Conan Edogawa. On the way to her house, Ran confides to Conan that she really likes Shinichi, but Conan's reply is interrupted by Ran's father rushing outside on the trail of a case. He brags that he's been hired to find a CEO's daughter, who was kidnapped by a "man in black". Conan sneaks along in case it is a lead, followed by Ran, who explains Conan's situation to Kogoro. Kogoro can't kick them out of a moving taxi, so simply orders them to stay out of the way.

summary.en: After realizing that Conan's parents have not contacted them (Kogoro and Ran Mouri) for a long stretch of time, Ran asks when his parents will be returning from overseas. Suddenly, a woman by the name of Fumiyo Edogawa enters the Mouri Detective Agency and admits to the group that she is Conan's mother and wishes to take Conan home. Soon after, Conan revels on the idea and absolute truth that this person is indeed not his mother, as Conan does not really exist, and begins to grow anxious. Worrying that she might harm his new found "family", he goes along with Fumiyo, planning to get away and figure out the mess he's gotten himself into. En route, Fumiyo reveals in Conan's horror that she knows Conan's identity as Shinichi Kudo, together with his family's background. Conan escapes from her car and rushes to Professor Agasa' house, but is kidnapped again by Fumiyo before he has a chance to contact him.

He was supposed to have crashed into a safety barrels, but ended up in the paper station due to Conan's intervention. That way, he looked like he was being threatened by someone. His trading company was going under, so he needed the money. He decided in secret to take out a life insurance policy for his secretary and then killed him to get the money. While he was committing the murder, a button fell from his sleeve and was later found in the car engine. He was supposed to have changed his p

motive.quote: His trading company was going under, so he needed the money.

method.quote: He was the one who manipulated his brakes just to make an alibi to himself.

evidence.quote: While he was committing the murder, a button fell from his sleeve and was later found in the car engine.

motive.zhHans: 他的贸易公司快要破产了，所以他需要钱。他暗中决定为自己的秘书投保人寿保险，然后杀了他以骗取保险金。Shioji 是替他调换面具的人，真面具被保管在羽田机场，因为他偷走假面具后要求 Richard 支付一百万日元，他知道警卫告诉 Iwami 的密码，而且没有被监控录像拍到。Kaneko 开始在他那座正被拆除的废弃大楼地下室（即员工办公室）里勒索他，用的是拍到他的所有不利照片。然而，他并不知道 Kaneko 在电脑上留了一份照片副本，以便继续勒索他，但这一举动最终帮助柯南破解了此案。由于 Kaneko 绑架柯南是为了阻止他的调查，Hosoo 便让他和摄像师一起等死，因为他可能成为证人。
motive.en: His trading company was going under, so he needed the money. He decided in secret to take out a life insurance policy for his secretary and then killed him to get the money. Shioji was the one who replaced the mask for him and the real one is secured at Haneda Airport, since he asked Richard to pay a million yen for it, after stolen the one false since he knew the code given by the security guard to Iwami and wasn't seen in the surveillance footage. Kaneko had started to blackmail him at the basement of his abandoned building being torn down, which was the staff office, using all incriminating photos he had taken of him. However, unbeknownst to him, Kaneko had kept a copy of the pictures on his computer, so that he could continue to blackmail him, but this action ultimately helped Conan to solve this case. Since Kaneko had kidnapped Conan in order to stop his investigation, Hosoo left him to die along with the cameraman because he could be a witness.

method.zhHans: 他就是那个动了刹车手脚、只为给自己制造不在场证明的人。Kaneko 开始在他那座正被拆除的废弃大楼地下室（即员工办公室）里勒索他，用的是拍到他的所有不利照片。
method.en: He was the one who manipulated his brakes just to make an alibi to himself. Kaneko had started to blackmail him at the basement of his abandoned building being torn down, which was the staff office, using all incriminating photos he had taken of him.

evidence.zhHans: 他在行凶时从袖口掉下一颗纽扣，后来在汽车发动机里被找到。他本应在 Hotel New Baker 换掉他的马球衫，却被会计秘书在工作讨论期间发现。
evidence.en: While he was committing the murder, a button fell from his sleeve and was later found in the car engine. He was supposed to have changed his polo at the Hotel New Baker, but was found by his accounting secretary during a work's discussion.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Takuya Hosoo。他就是那个动了刹车手脚、只为给自己制造不在场证明的人。他本应撞上安全隔离墩，却因柯南的干预而冲进了纸箱堆。这样一来，他看上去像是受到了什么人的威胁。他的贸易公司快要破产了，所以他需要钱。他暗中决定为自己的秘书投保人寿保险，然后杀了他以骗取保险金。他在行凶时从袖口掉下一颗纽扣，后来在汽车发动机里被找到。他本应在 Hotel New Baker 换掉他的马球衫，却被会计秘书在工作讨论期间发现。Shioji 是替他调换面具的人，真面具被保管在羽田机场，因为他偷走假面具后要求 Richard 支付一百万日元，他知道警卫告诉 Iwami 的密码，而且没有被监控录像拍到。然而，当她得知 Takahashi 遇害后，他那复仇心切的女友向 Megure 坦白了一切。Kaneko 开始在他那座正被拆除的废弃大楼地下室（即员工办公室）里勒索他，用的是拍到他的所有不利照片。他付钱给 Kaneko 买下存储卡，但最终决定杀掉摄像师让他永远闭嘴。然而，他并不知道 Kaneko 在电脑上留了一份照片副本，以便继续勒索他，但这一举动最终帮助柯南破解了此案。Iwami 被监控摄像头拍到受到 Kaneko 的威胁和勒索，Kaneko 看到他走进歌舞伎博物馆，尽管摄像师知道他并没有偷面具。由于 Kaneko 绑架柯南是为了阻止他的调查，Hosoo 便让他和摄像师一起等死，因为他可能成为证人。Hosoo 被捕后，令柯南惊讶的是，Ebizo 想让那位大侦探沉睡的小五郎出演他的下一场演出，而醒来的小五郎仍然相信自己就是犯人。
resolution.en: The culprit is Takuya Hosoo. He was the one who manipulated his brakes just to make an alibi to himself. He was supposed to have crashed into a safety barrels, but ended up in the paper station due to Conan's intervention. That way, he looked like he was being threatened by someone. His trading company was going under, so he needed the money. He decided in secret to take out a life insurance policy for his secretary and then killed him to get the money. While he was committing the murder, a button fell from his sleeve and was later found in the car engine. He was supposed to have changed his polo at the Hotel New Baker, but was found by his accounting secretary during a work's discussion. Shioji was the one who replaced the mask for him and the real one is secured at Haneda Airport, since he asked Richard to pay a million yen for it, after stolen the one false since he knew the code given by the security guard to Iwami and wasn't seen in the surveillance footage. However, when she learns Takahashi's murder, his vengeful girlfriend confesses all to Megure. Kaneko had started to blackmail him at the basement of his abandoned building being torn down, which was the staff office, using all incriminating photos he had taken of him. He payed Kaneko for the memory card, but ultimately decided to kill the cameraman to keep him quiet. However, unbeknownst to him, Kaneko had kept a copy of the pictures on his computer, so that he could continue to blackmail him, but this action ultimately helped Conan to solve this case. Iwami was seen on the surveillance camera threatened and blackmailed by Kaneko, who saw him going inside the Kabuki museum, even if the cameraman knew that he didn't steal the mask. Since Kaneko had kidnapped Conan in order to stop his investigation, Hosoo left him to die along with the cameraman because he could be a witness. After Hosoo's arrest, with Conan's surprise, Ebizo wants to put the great detective Sleeping Kogoro, who is awakened still beliving him the culprit, in his next show.

title.ja: コナン·平次の推理マジック (Konan Heiji no Suiri Majikku) 406 仕掛編

culpritSource.quote: The mystery is solved and Heiji shows that it involves how the house is built. They reveal the hallway has mirrors hidden on the door with identical rooms on the side and a white screen to cause an illusion. When modified in a certain way another hallway is created. Masakage had it built for his Christmas Tree surprise trick. The culprit is Dogo Hoshikawa.

title.ja: コナンと平次の鵺伝説 (Konan to Heiji no Nue Densetsu)

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Fumie Masuko. Fumie admits she killed the two victims. Charles Abel was actually her husband. During the accident, Tanzawa and Someji had run away without trying to help Abel. Even after all these years, they had no repercussion of their deeds and shamelessly came to unearth the treasure that had once caused their coworker's death. Charles was actually trying to write "metal" ("tetsuno" in Japanese) as he had found a metallic hairpin. As a foreigner, he had never seen one before and after writing "metal", he was trying to show the team the paper and the hairpin to ask them what

motive.quote: But since he wrote with a permanent marker, the ink bled through producing "nue" instead.

method.quote: Faking the Nue The culprit used perspective shift to simulate the enlargement of the size of the nue.

evidence.quote: Clues and Evidence Faking perspective requires the knowledge and experience of an artist.

motive.zhHans: 但由于他用的是永久性马克笔，墨水渗透开来，反而写出了"nue"。她邀请 Hajime 来看他为父亲复仇，尽管她否认 Hajime 是她和 Charles 的儿子。同样，根据一则传说，nue 实际上是 Minamoto Yorimasa 的母亲，她变成这头野兽，好让儿子将其斩杀。漫画到动画的改动 主条目：漫画与动画的差异列表 因为第872集改编了两个文件，第874集只改编了一个文件以及第961号文件的五页。
motive.en: But since he wrote with a permanent marker, the ink bled through producing "nue" instead. She invited Hajime to have him see her avenge his father though she denies that Hajime is her and Charles son. Similarly, according to one legend, the nue was actually the mother of Minamoto Yorimasa, who transformed into the beast so that her son could slay it. Manga to anime changes Main article: List of differences between the manga and anime Because episode 872 adapted two files, episode 874 was adapted from only one file and five pages from file 961.

method.zhHans: 伪装成 Nue 犯人利用透视变化来模拟 nue 体型的增大。犯人使用了一块画有酒店窗户陡峭角度的幕布，并把狗打扮成 nue 的样子。Tanzawa 同样是被下毒的，方法是把双叉毒镖装在软木塞上而不是管子上。凶器是用系在上面的线取回的。犯人很可能训练了那条狗，并在之前来酒店时种下那棵树来遮挡视线。
method.en: Faking the Nue The culprit used perspective shift to simulate the enlargement of the size of the nue. The culprit used a screen with a steep drawing of the windows in the hotel and dressed the dog as the nue. Tanzawa was similarly poisoned by attaching a twin-pronged poison dart to the cork instead of a tube. The weapon was retrieved using a string attached to it. The culprit probably trained the dog and planted the tree to obstruct the view when she came to the hotel before.

evidence.zhHans: 线索与证据 伪装透视需要艺术家的知识和经验。凶器是用系在上面的线取回的。Charles 其实是想写"metal"（日语"tetsuno"），因为他发现了一个金属发夹。
evidence.en: Clues and Evidence Faking perspective requires the knowledge and experience of an artist. The weapon was retrieved using a string attached to it. Charles was actually trying to write "metal" ("tetsuno" in Japanese) as he had found a metallic hairpin.

resolution.zhHans: 江户川柯南和服部平次解释了制造 nue 所用的手法并揭穿了犯人。（见下方"结局"）
resolution.en: Conan and Heiji explain the tricks used to create the nue and expose the culprit. (See Resolution below)

summary.en: The fact that Azusa was an imposter in The Betrayal's Stage is confirmed when Azusa says that she didn't go to the concert hall. However, only Conan and Amuro himself knows that it was actually Vermouth in disguise. Conan thinks that since Vermouth bothered to investigate, the Black Organization must really be interested in the cipher left by Kōji Haneda seventeen years ago. Azusa also reveals that she saw a strange duo in front of Mōri Detective Agency talking something about "cleaning rags".

culpritSource.quote: According to that, Conan figured out almost everything: the culprit is Naho Mimura, without a doubt. The culprit must be some one who knows Chiaki and has her phone number, otherwise Chiaki would not be able to be directly called by the culprit. Being a college classmate with Naho, Chiaki recognises very well the smell that permeated the room Tetsuya got kidnapped, in which Naho always had fancied this type of fragrance.

motive.quote: Megure, on the other hand, remarked that he did not like the culprit's plan, because he realised this: At the outset kidnappers were using fairly amateur-ish language to conduct the abduction, ever since the stage of hostage exchanging, the tone of the culprit had changed drastically.

method.quote: After the call had hanged up, everyone working in the case were rather anxious.

evidence.quote: By looking up the construction sites currently in operation online, Conan found the one located with the shortest displacement with respect to the Toto Tower.

motive.zhHans: 另一方面，目暮指出他不喜欢犯人的计划，因为他察觉到了这一点：起初绑匪在实施绑架时使用的是相当业余的语言，而自从人质交换阶段起，犯人的语气发生了剧变。由于两辆车将以指定速度行驶，犯人完全有可能实时掌握它们的位置。如果犯人已经公开了车辆的明确位置，那么金钱与人质的交换就可能是某种幌子；这样一来，犯人可能并非完全为了赎金。为了让 Sakae 继承 Mimura 公司的家业，她能做的只有杀死 Kazuo。
motive.en: Megure, on the other hand, remarked that he did not like the culprit's plan, because he realised this: At the outset kidnappers were using fairly amateur-ish language to conduct the abduction, ever since the stage of hostage exchanging, the tone of the culprit had changed drastically. Since the two vehicles will be travelling at specified speed, it would be perfectly possible for the culprit to keep track of them in real-time. If the culprit had disclosed the plain location of the vehicles, it is possible that the money-hostage exchanging is a decoy or some sort; upon that, the culprit might not after the ransom completely. For Sakae to inherit the Mimura company legacy, all she could do was to murder Kazuo.

method.zhHans: 电话挂断后，参与办案的每个人都相当焦急。另一方面，目暮指出他不喜欢犯人的计划，因为他察觉到了这一点：起初绑匪在实施绑架时使用的是相当业余的语言，而自从人质交换阶段起，犯人的语气发生了剧变。
method.en: After the call had hanged up, everyone working in the case were rather anxious. Megure, on the other hand, remarked that he did not like the culprit's plan, because he realised this: At the outset kidnappers were using fairly amateur-ish language to conduct the abduction, ever since the stage of hostage exchanging, the tone of the culprit had changed drastically.

evidence.zhHans: 通过在网上查找目前正在运营的施工工地，柯南找到了相对于 Toto Tower 位移最短的那一处。
evidence.en: By looking up the construction sites currently in operation online, Conan found the one located with the shortest displacement with respect to the Toto Tower.

Hiroaki calls Reiko Kujo and tells her to meet him and he will tell her the truth. Reiko, accompanied by Mariko, visits Hiroaki and sees him fall off his balcony to his death.
