culpritSource.quote: The real culprit was Toru Tsukano. His original plan was to steal the land deed that his late sister (Ishigaki's wife) had left him, but which Ishigaki had taken after he had caught Tsukano embezzling money from his company. Ishigaki caught him while looking through the painting and threatened to press charges, so Tsukano ended up killing him. He found the deed on the back of the painting, which Ishigaki used as a secret hiding place for his most important documents.

motive.quote: His original plan was to steal the land deed that his late sister (Ishigaki's wife) had left him, but which Ishigaki had taken after he had caught Tsukano embezzling money from his company.

method.quote: He found the deed on the back of the painting, which Ishigaki used as a secret hiding place for his most important documents.

evidence.quote: He found the deed on the back of the painting, which Ishigaki used as a secret hiding place for his most important documents.

motive.zhHans: 他原本的计划是偷走那份土地契约——那是他已故的姐姐（Ishigaki 的妻子）留给他的，但 Ishigaki 在发现 Tsukano 挪用其公司款项后把契约拿走了。当 Iwamatsu 逃离现场、听到 Iwamatsu 摔倒在地的女管家赶到案发现场时，Tsukano 决定假装自己刚刚抵达，并检查了受害者，好为手上的血找个借口。
motive.en: His original plan was to steal the land deed that his late sister (Ishigaki's wife) had left him, but which Ishigaki had taken after he had caught Tsukano embezzling money from his company. When Iwamatsu had fled the scene and the housekeeper, who had heard Iwamatsu hitting the ground, rushed to the crime scene, Tsukano decided to pretend that he had just arrived, and checked the victim so that he would have an excuse for the blood on his hands.

method.zhHans: 他在画的背面找到了那份契约，Ishigaki 平时把最重要的文件藏在这里。然而 Ishigaki 刚被杀死，Iwamatsu 就来了，于是 Tsukano 又把画挂了回去（匆忙中没注意到画已经挂反了），自己躲到门后。当 Iwamatsu 逃离现场、听到 Iwamatsu 摔倒在地的女管家赶到案发现场时，Tsukano 决定假装自己刚刚抵达，并检查了受害者，好为手上的血找个借口。
method.en: He found the deed on the back of the painting, which Ishigaki used as a secret hiding place for his most important documents. Right after Ishigaki was killed, however, Iwamatsu came, so Tsukano hung the painting up again (failing to notice in his haste that it was now upside down) and hid behind the door. When Iwamatsu had fled the scene and the housekeeper, who had heard Iwamatsu hitting the ground, rushed to the crime scene, Tsukano decided to pretend that he had just arrived, and checked the victim so that he would have an excuse for the blood on his hands.

evidence.zhHans: 他在画的背面找到了那份契约，Ishigaki 平时把最重要的文件藏在这里。但在把凶器从花瓶里取出来时，他在里面留下了带血的指纹，这成为指认他就是凶手的关键证据。
evidence.en: He found the deed on the back of the painting, which Ishigaki used as a secret hiding place for his most important documents. But while removing the murder weapon from the vase, he left blooded fingerprints inside, which became the crucial evidence about him being the culprit.

resolution.zhHans: 真正的凶手是 Toru Tsukano。他原本的计划是偷走那份土地契约——那是他已故的姐姐（Ishigaki 的妻子）留给他的，但 Ishigaki 在发现 Tsukano 挪用其公司款项后把契约拿走了。Ishigaki 在翻看那幅画时撞见了他，并威胁要起诉，于是 Tsukano 最终杀死了他。他在画的背面找到了那份契约，Ishigaki 平时把最重要的文件藏在这里。
resolution.en: The real culprit was Toru Tsukano. His original plan was to steal the land deed that his late sister (Ishigaki's wife) had left him, but which Ishigaki had taken after he had caught Tsukano embezzling money from his company. Ishigaki caught him while looking through the painting and threatened to press charges, so Tsukano ended up killing him. He found the deed on the back of the painting, which Ishigaki used as a secret hiding place for his most important documents.

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Hatsuho Toba. She killed Akaza by applying the poison on the back of her spoon when trying the cheese so the poison would get on all but the section of cheese that she tasted. Then she switched out the spoon when she wiped away the dropped cheese on Jisaburou's clothing. She stabbed Moyono Mibu (who previously tried to kill Jisaburou to inherit his fortune) with an iron skewer when her guard was down. She proceeded to stab Jisaburou with two iron skewers connected together to make the wound look like a chisel. She wrote the letter to Mouri so he could prove her innocence. Hatsuh

motive.quote: She stabbed Moyono Mibu (who previously tried to kill Jisaburou to inherit his fortune) with an iron skewer when her guard was down.

method.quote: She killed Akaza by applying the poison on the back of her spoon when trying the cheese so the poison would get on all but the section of cheese that she tasted.

evidence.quote: She wrote the letter to Mouri so he could prove her innocence.

motive.zhHans: Hatsuho 愤愤地供认，她恨 Moyono——她以 Jisaburou 情人的身份过着奢华日子，而自己和母亲却要受苦；恨 Akaza——他试图引诱她；也恨 Jisaburou 本人——他暗中变卖她父亲的能面，连同整座博物馆一起卖掉。
motive.en: Hatsuho annoyingly confesses that she loathes Moyono for living in luxury as Jisaburou's lover while she has her mother had to suffer, Akaza for his attempts to seduce her, and Jisaburou himself for secretly selling her father's Noh Masks, as well as the entire museum itself.

resolution.en: The culprit is Hatsuho Toba. She killed Akaza by applying the poison on the back of her spoon when trying the cheese so the poison would get on all but the section of cheese that she tasted. Then she switched out the spoon when she wiped away the dropped cheese on Jisaburou's clothing. She stabbed Moyono Mibu (who previously tried to kill Jisaburou to inherit his fortune) with an iron skewer when her guard was down. She proceeded to stab Jisaburou with two iron skewers connected together to make the wound look like a chisel. She wrote the letter to Mouri so he could prove her innocence. Hatsuho annoyingly confesses that she loathes Moyono for living in luxury as Jisaburou's lover while she has her mother had to suffer, Akaza for his attempts to seduce her, and Jisaburou himself for secretly selling her father's Noh Masks, as well as the entire museum itself. Nevertheless, she failed to finish off Jisaburou due to Conan indirectly telling him to protect himself from stab wound just in case.

motive.zhHans: 在 Otaro 车里发现的 Kyujiro 的头发，只是犯人为了嫁祸 Otaro 而设下的诡计，因为用敞篷车运送尸体是不可能的，而且我们也无法确定 Otaro 如果犯案会使用哪辆车。房间里发现开瓶器也是很正常的，因为有那么多啤酒。随后 Hiroko 指控 Masanari 杀害了 Otaro，因为他说自己当时在玩磁铁、喝啤酒。Kyujiro 知道他就是犯人，因为他在 Ohara 的房间里装了窃听器，知道这件事。他犯下的错误之一是带了开瓶器，因为 Otaro 描述的通往幸福的钥匙，其实就是他自己的特制开瓶器。房间被翻得乱七八糟，是因为 Ohara 需要取回牛磁铁，所以他在房间里制造混乱，以掩盖自己曾去寻找牛磁铁的事实。证据就是 Ohara 弄坏了自己的手表，这一点得到证实，因为他先前看的是墙上的挂钟而不是自己的手表。事实上，他是在掩饰自己杀害 Otaro 时受的伤，因为 Otaro 推了他，他撞到了一个瓶盖上。他随后声称自己杀害 Otaro 是因为 Otaro 想杀 Miona，但这只是他捏造的。

It would then be normal if a bottle opener was found in the room since there were so much beers. One of the mistakes he did was to bring a bottle opener since the key to happiness Otaro described was in fact his own personnalized beer opener. The room was ransacked since Ohara needed to retrieve the cow magnet so he put a mess in the room to hide the fact he went searching for the cow magnet. The proof is that Ohara broke his watch and it is proven since he looked at the clock wall earlier instead of looking his watch. In fact, he was trying to hide the fact he got an injury when he killed Otaro since Otaro pushed him and he bumped onto a bottle cap. He then said he killed Otaro since Otaro wanted to kill Miona but it was just made up by him.

resolution.zhHans: 所有客人都被叫到 Otaro 的房间里，小五郎事先已被躲在墙后的柯南弄晕。当他决定揭露案件真相时，所有人都激动起来。首先，Otaro 并没有杀害 Kyujiro。在 Otaro 车里发现的 Kyujiro 的头发，只是犯人为了嫁祸 Otaro 而设下的诡计，因为用敞篷车运送尸体是不可能的，而且我们也无法确定 Otaro 如果犯案会使用哪辆车。犯人还误算了一点：Otaro 会用自己的新车去杀人。接着，众人问他密室是怎么做的，小五郎让柯南做了演示。他先在门闩上放了一个开瓶器，然后在门的另一面固定了一个牛磁铁，用磁铁移动开瓶器，使门闩扣上，用两个门闩把房间锁住。然后他取下磁铁，摇晃门让开瓶器掉落。房间里发现开瓶器也是很正常的，因为有那么多啤酒。随后 Hiroko 指控 Masanari 杀害了 Otaro，因为他说自己当时在玩磁铁、喝啤酒。小五郎随后反驳，证明他说错了。他留下的死亡讯息并不是假面彗星 Byun 的标志，而实际上是反过来的。那个圆圈代表 O，那两条线代表片假名的 Ha，因此犯人就是 Shinsuke Ohara。他实际上就是七年前那起案件的另一名犯人。Kyujiro 知道他就是犯人，因为他在 Ohara 的房间里装了窃听器，知道这件事。他还带来了 Byun 的卡片来威胁他。他先在面包车里用自来水将 Kyujiro 溺死，然后把尸体弃在湖边。接着他杀害了 Otaro 来嫁祸他。他犯下的错误之一是带了开瓶器，因为 Otaro 描述的通往幸福的钥匙，其实就是他自己的特制开瓶器。Ohara 没有找到，便匆匆赶回厨房去拿。房间被翻得乱七八糟，是因为 Ohara 需要取回牛磁铁，所以他在房间里制造混乱，以掩盖自己曾去寻找牛磁铁的事实。证据就是 Ohara 弄坏了自己的手表，这一点得到证实，因为他先前看的是墙上的挂钟而不是自己的手表。原因在于，当他翻乱房间时，Fujiyoshi 发现了房间，他不得不从客房逃走并爬了三……。牛磁铁的磁力弄坏了手表。另一条线索是他平时把手表放在口袋里，但当时手表戴在手腕上。事实上，他是在掩饰自己杀害 Otaro 时受的伤，因为 Otaro 推了他，他撞到了一个瓶盖上。最终证据是那个瓶盖的形状与众不同，而与之对应的瓶盖会指认 Ohara 就是犯人。他随后声称自己杀害 Otaro 是因为 Otaro 想杀 Miona，但这只是他捏造的。Miona 随后回想起记忆，想起曾见过 Otaro 和 Ohara 的脸，并说出就是他。他随后被逮捕。
resolution.en: All the guests were called in Otaro's room where Kogoro had been knocked out beforehand by Conan who's hiding behind the wall. Everybody then got excited when he decided to reveal the truth of the case. First, Otaro didn't kill Kyujiro. The hair of Kyujiro found in Otaro's car was only a trick put by the culprit to frame Otaro since it wouldn't be possible to carry a body in a convertible and that we couldn't be sure which car Otaro would have used if he committed the crime. The culprit also miscalculated that Otaro would use his new car to kill someone. Then, people asked him how he did the locked room and Kogoro asked Conan to make a demonstration. He first put a bottle opener on the bolt and then fixed a cow magnet on the other side of the door and used the magnet to move the bottle opener which would close the bolt and lock the room with both bolts. He then removed the magnet and shook the door to make the opener fall. It would then be normal if a bottle opener was found in the room since there were so much beers. Hiroko then accused Masanari of having killed Otaro since he said he was playing with a magnet and drinking beer. Kogoro then replied by proving him wrong. The dying message he put wasn't the Masked Comet Byun's symbol but it was in fact backwards. The circle represented O and the two lines represented the katakana for Ha and so, the culprit was Shinsuke Ohara. He was in fact the other culprit in the seven years ago crime. Kyujiro knew he was the culprit since he planted bugs in Ohara's room and knew that. He also brought the Byun card to threathen him. He first drowned Kyujiro with tap water inside the van and dumped the body near the lake. He then killed Otaro to frame him. One of the mistakes he did was to bring a bottle opener since the key to happiness Otaro described was in fact his own personnalized beer opener. Ohara didn't find any so he hurried back to the kitchen to get one. The room was ransacked since Ohara needed to retrieve the cow magnet so he put a mess in the room to hide the fact he went searching for the cow magnet. The proof is that Ohara broke his watch and it is proven since he looked at the clock wall earlier instead of looking his watch. title.ja: トイレに隠した秘密 (Toire ni Kakushita Himitsu)

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Tetsuo Imai. Sohei Dejima as suspected was poisoned in design office's bathroom. The poison was lathered onto an empty toilet paper roll that the president touched by changing it with a new one. The poison found in his hamburger and hands were merely trace markings. To guarantee the president went to the bathroom when his trap was set, Imai served Dejima's morning coffee with laxatives.

motive.quote: Akemi's short visit, as well as her promise to return with Shiho, would've sooth him of his revenge.

method.quote: Sohei Dejima as suspected was poisoned in design office's bathroom.

evidence.quote: The poison found in his hamburger and hands were merely trace markings.

motive.zhHans: 明美这次短暂的来访，以及她承诺会带着志保一起回来的保证，本该能平息他的复仇之心。
motive.en: Akemi's short visit, as well as her promise to return with Shiho, would've sooth him of his revenge.

method.zhHans: 正如所料，出岛壮平是在设计事务所的洗手间里中毒的。毒被涂在一卷用完的卫生纸筒上，社长在换新纸时碰到了它。在他汉堡和手上验出的毒只是微量痕迹。当有人提出最后使用洗手间的是财津、他也可能中毒时，推断出的理由是：Imai 知道这位同事只会小便，因为几乎听不到冲水声（大楼因据称遭黑衣组织破坏而缺水），而且他注意到财津喝了很多水。装毒用的袋子是从大楼水槽最脏的地方找到的。
method.en: Sohei Dejima as suspected was poisoned in design office's bathroom. The poison was lathered onto an empty toilet paper roll that the president touched by changing it with a new one. The poison found in his hamburger and hands were merely trace markings. When it was brought up that Zaitsu could be poisoned as he used the restroom last, it is reasoned that Imai knew his colleague would only urinate as there was hardly a sound of water being flushed (there was a water shortage in the building due to supposed tampering from the Black Organization) and the fact that he noticed him drinking a lot. The bag used to contain the poison was retrieved from the dirtiest part of the building's sink.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Tetsuo Imai。正如所料，出岛壮平是在设计事务所的洗手间里中毒的。毒被涂在一卷用完的卫生纸筒上，社长在换新纸时碰到了它。在他汉堡和手上验出的毒只是微量痕迹。为确保社长在陷阱设好时去洗手间，Imai 在给岛上的早晨咖啡里下了泻药。当有人提出最后使用洗手间的是财津、他也可能中毒时，推断出的理由是：Imai 知道这位同事只会小便，因为几乎听不到冲水声（大楼因据称遭黑衣组织破坏而缺水），而且他注意到财津喝了很多水。装毒用的袋子是从大楼水槽最脏的地方找到的。
resolution.en: The culprit is Tetsuo Imai. Sohei Dejima as suspected was poisoned in design office's bathroom. The poison was lathered onto an empty toilet paper roll that the president touched by changing it with a new one. The poison found in his hamburger and hands were merely trace markings. To guarantee the president went to the bathroom when his trap was set, Imai served Dejima's morning coffee with laxatives. When it was brought up that Zaitsu could be poisoned as he used the restroom last, it is reasoned that Imai knew his colleague would only urinate as there was hardly a sound of water being flushed (there was a water shortage in the building due to supposed tampering from the Black Organization) and the fact that he noticed him drinking a lot. The bag used to contain the poison was retrieved from the dirtiest part of the building's sink.

summary.en: A small three-story house is put up for rent in the neighborhood and the Detective Boys decide to pass by it on the way home from school. Haibara tricks the real estate agent into giving them a tour of the inside and Conan notices that he could see Kogoro's detective agency from the third floor window. The next day, they discover the house has been sold to an old couple and Conan finds them suspicious. He follows the old man to China town and into an antique shop. The old man is talking with an old Chinese man. Conan is discovered and flees from the scene. Later that day, Conan notices that the house has a camera directed towards the Mouri detective agency and deduces the old couples are people using a disguise.

Akano's misdeed caused the younger Oba's skull to be indented, resulting in his death three days later. Upon reading his brother's blog comments, Oba confronted Akano and thus confirmed him as his twin brother's killer because when Akano (who did not know about the existence of the twin brothers) reacted with a snide comment at Oba's apparent surviva

title.ja: 屋形船 釣りショック (Yakatabune Tsuri Shokku)

culpritSource.quote: Conan investigates and realizes it's a murder. After tranquilizing Kogoro, he reveals the culprit is Kazuyuki Kawai. He tells that when Kawai and Yamazaki were alone on the deck, while Yamazaki wasn't looking, Kawai attached the cutter knife-edge. Then, he attached the hook on the hull, and pretended that a big fish was pulling hard on the rod. Asking Yamazaki for help, he had Yamazaki grab onto his fishing rod, and used the cutter knife-edge to cut the line. He made the fishing rod to touch the electric wire, killing Yamazaki.

motive.quote: Kawai confesses and revealed Yamazaki loaned him money with high interest, and tried to take over his company.

method.quote: Then, he attached the hook on the hull, and pretended that a big fish was pulling hard on the rod.

evidence.quote: Kawai continues to say that he's not the culprit and demands solid evidence.

motive.zhHans: Kawai 供认，并揭示山崎以高利借钱给他，还企图吞掉他的公司。此外，由于山崎是这笔债务的担保人，Kawai 不得不把他指定为自己寿险的受益人，赔付额很高。
motive.en: Kawai confesses and revealed Yamazaki loaned him money with high interest, and tried to take over his company. In addition, as Yamazaki was the guarantor for this debt, Kawai had to make him the beneficiary of his life insurance with a large payout.

method.zhHans: 接着，他把钩子挂在船身上，装作有大鱼在猛烈拉扯鱼竿。他叫山崎帮忙，让山崎抓住自己的鱼竿，再用美工刀的刀刃割断鱼线。拿这些东西来钓鱼看起来很不寻常，但 Kawai 声称自己只是把它们带在身上，并说那仍然是意外。事情发生时他正在烧电线：他用打火机熔化橡胶外皮，让电线裸露出来，结果乙烯树脂落到了灯芯上。随后他保持跌落的姿态，脱下靴子扔掉，把橡胶手套藏进口袋，装作昏迷。
method.en: Then, he attached the hook on the hull, and pretended that a big fish was pulling hard on the rod. Asking Yamazaki for help, he had Yamazaki grab onto his fishing rod, and used the cutter knife-edge to cut the line. Using those for fishing seems pretty unusual, but Kawai claims he only had them in his, and that the death was still an accident. It happened when he was burning the electric wire: he used the lighter to melt the rubber coating leaving the electric wire exposed, causing the vinyl to fall onto the wick. Then, by keeping a falling pose, he took the boots off and threw them away, hid the rubber gloves in his pocket, and pretended to be unconscious.

evidence.zhHans: Kawai 仍坚持说自己不是犯人，并要求拿出确凿证据。小五郎解释说，确凿证据就是 Kawai 的打火机。Kawai 供认，并揭示山崎以高利借钱给他，还企图吞掉他的公司。
evidence.en: Kawai continues to say that he's not the culprit and demands solid evidence. Kogoro explains that the solid evidence is Kawai's lighter. Kawai confesses and revealed Yamazaki loaned him money with high interest, and tried to take over his company.

resolution.zhHans: 柯南调查后意识到这是一起谋杀。麻醉小五郎之后，他指出犯人是 Kazuyuki Kawai。他说，当 Kawai 和山崎两人单独在甲板上时，趁山崎没注意，Kawai 装上了美工刀的刀刃。接着，他把钩子挂在船身上，装作有大鱼在猛烈拉扯鱼竿。他叫山崎帮忙，让山崎抓住自己的鱼竿，再用美工刀的刀刃割断鱼线。他让鱼竿碰到电线，电死了山崎。Kawai 试图否认，声称那样他自己也会死。小五郎说，如果他像山崎一样徒手赤脚，确实会。随后他要求查看 Kawai 的口袋，里面是肤色的橡胶手套。拿这些东西来钓鱼看起来很不寻常，但 Kawai 声称自己只是把它们带在身上，并说那仍然是意外。
resolution.en: Conan investigates and realizes it's a murder. After tranquilizing Kogoro, he reveals the culprit is Kazuyuki Kawai. He tells that when Kawai and Yamazaki were alone on the deck, while Yamazaki wasn't looking, Kawai attached the cutter knife-edge. Then, he attached the hook on the hull, and pretended that a big fish was pulling hard on the rod. Asking Yamazaki for help, he had Yamazaki grab onto his fishing rod, and used the cutter knife-edge to cut the line. He made the fishing rod to touch the electric wire, killing Yamazaki. Kawai tries to deny it, claiming that he would have died too. Kogoro says, he would have, if he was bare handed and bare footed like Yamazaki. Then he ask to show what's inside in his pocket and it was skin colored rubber gloves. Using those for fishing seems pretty unusual, but Kawai claims he only had them in his, and that the death was still an accident.

summary.en: One of Kogoro's clients, Hiroaki Sanada, requested Kogoro to cease the detective service he entrusted the minute they first met as the pre-agreed schuedle. This exceptional behaviour striked Kogoro odd, and asked him the reason behind it deeply. After countless urgings, Sanada explained the logic: three mornings ago, an extotionist Jiro Inumaru kept blackmailing Sanada to expose some not-so-pleasant matters he had done working as a real estate agency manager to his company. But afterwards, Sanada's friend, Daigo Kawakatsu dropped in and manefisted his anger; as a result, he told Sanada to inform him in advance the next time the extortionist Inumaru bothers him. And yesterday morning... Inumaru came to Sanada's house and was about to grab him by the neck, but Sanada pushed him back with appreciable strength, which, unfortunately, led to a tragedy of murdering Inumaru as his head hit the corner of a table; Kawakatsu then arrived there after being informed by Sanada and saw teh scenario, he examined the corpse and confirmed Sanada to be dead.

Oikawa confesses and reveals that he had only planned a set of three but his father scammed the customers into buying the third painting into paying extra so that he would make a fourth painting. Conan reveals that Oikawa's father had been practicing on imitating Oikawa's style and had the fourth painting finished and his plan was to give Oikawa his painting. Oikawa then laments over the death of his father due to a misunderstanding. Later on, Takagi is revealed to be Kid and leaves the mansion upon helping with the investigation and having his name cleared.

resolution.en: The culprit is Norifumi Saku who originally planned to form a suicide case but that was hindered due to Kogoro's presence during that event. He was tricked onto entering a room, where he believes belongs to the victim's and began his contradictions of him being the murderer. The DND (Do Not Disturb) sign was hung on the door knob was evident that he was unaware that the victim had arranged a meeting with a lawyer named Hayashi at 2 o'clock and mistook the note with 'Hayashi, 2' as a memo for a order on Hayashi rice for 2, due to a menu that was lying next to the note. The other note on the door with 'Pay later'-message was referring to the non-existing order. After strangling his victim, he placed Kogoro's cellphone near the door so when they everyone arrives and calls, Kogoro could become the primary suspect. The motive for the killer was to end the victims' own devious intentions of "torturing villages" and gaining reputation by overruling Eri as the lawyer. The scandal had affected his birth town, and he wanted the responsible punished. He wouldn't have killed her, if she 'just' did her job, but he was further enraged when he discovered that she attempted to make Kogoro appear to have an affair while being under the influence of sleeping drugs, a plan that would create the biggest scandal to defame Eri of her popularity. He swears that after the case, victim was working on, was done, he would have turned himself in and hand over the evidence. Afterwards, Kogoro tries to ask Eri to return home with him, since he's getting bored of Ran's cooking. Eri pretends not to hear and later at her office, listens again to the recording of Kogoro's plead for her return and she not ready to forgive him yet.

summary.en: This special Christmas episode of "Detective Conan" is introduced by Heiji Hattori, Conan Edogawa, Ran Mouri, and Kazuha Toyama. Heiji won the bet in the previous episode to go see a baseball game and so it's decided that they're all going to the high school baseball finals in Koshien Stadium. But there is a mysterious guy willing to commit a suicide bombing there. This incident just puts more stress on Conan and Heiji, even though they came to a ball game for amusement and relaxation. The unknown person gives them a chance to stop him, however. Heiji and Conan are both struggling to crack the codes, sent by the mysterious man, before the bomb goes off. Earlier, Conan and Heiji witnessed the person walk by them and they thought he dropped his cell phone, when he purposely left it there to "play the inevitable game" with them, consisting of cryptic text messages. In order to solve this case and save countless lives, Heiji and Conan would need a lot a background information dealing with America's favorite pastime, baseball.

motive.zhHans: 一直跟踪光彦的犯人开口并出现在光彦身后：“原来藏在那儿啊”。犯人也相当好奇，因为他同样没有找到珠宝的藏匿地点，于是问光彦是怎么知道的。显然，Izumiya递给Kimishima的不是装满食物的手提包，而是装满钱的手提包。柯南还告诉光彦不要着急，因为他已经报警了，Izumiya大概很快就会被逮捕。
motive.en: The culprit who was stalking Mitsuhiko spoke and shwoed up behind Mitsuhiko: "So that's where it was hidden". The culprit also got fairly curious, because he also did not find the location of the jewels, so he asked Mitsuhiko how he knew it. Obviously, the purse Izumiya handed to Kimishima was not a purse filled with food but instead a purse filled with money. Conan also told Mitsuhiko not to be anxious since he had already informed the police about it and Izumiya would probably be arrested soon.

method.zhHans: 在这个案子里，大概是为了换取Kimishima用鸽子偷来的珠宝。他很担心犯人会检查袋子里的东西，所以用鸽子把他吓跑。而事实上，Izumiya被几名警察按倒在地，当他意识到自己从光彦那里拿到的只是弹珠时，他惊呼自己被“那个小鬼”骗了。
method.en: In this case, it was probably to trade for the jewels Kimishima stole using the pigeons. He was quite worried that the culprit would verify the content in the bag, so he used the pigeon to scare him away. And in fact, Izumiya was being held down by several police on the ground, and when he realised the bag he got from Mitsuhiko was just some marbles, he exclaimed that he got tricked by "that brat".

evidence.zhHans: 他拉开了鸟屋底部的小抽屉，发现了一个袋子里装着一个盒子。另外，之前那名公园游客穿的是皮靴，和小屋外的脚印一样，这意味着他是唯一的嫌疑人。而且根据犯罪现场，他没有发现任何迹象表明犯人找到了珠宝。怒火中烧的Izumiya从失物招领箱里（原本有两根）拿起其中一根球棒，敲击Kimishima的头部。
evidence.en: He pulled out the little drawer at the bottom of the birdhouse, and he found a bag that contained a box. Also, the park visitor from before was wearing leather boots, just like the footprints outside the shed, meaning that he is the only possible culprit. And according to the crime scene, he did not find any traits that show the culprit found the jewels. Along with his anger, Izumiya took one of the bats placed in the lost-and-found box (there were two initially) and struck Kimishima's head.

resolution.zhHans: 沿着自己的推理，光彦来到公园小屋，走向鸟屋。“果然没错。”光彦说道。他拉开了鸟屋底部的小抽屉，发现了一个袋子里装着一个盒子。他打开它，里面显然是Kimishima偷来的珠宝。一直跟踪光彦的犯人开口并出现在光彦身后：“原来藏在那儿啊”。当光彦回头时，他意识到犯人就是Hayato Izumiya，也就是今天早上“用手提包喂鸟食”的那个人。另外，之前那名公园游客穿的是皮靴，和小屋外的脚印一样，这意味着他是唯一的嫌疑人。
resolution.en: Persuing his own deduction, Mitsuhiko went to the park shed, and he headed towards the birdhouse. "Just as I thought," Mitsuhiko uttered. He pulled out the little drawer at the bottom of the birdhouse, and he found a bag that contained a box. When he opened it, it was clearly the jewellery Kimishima stole. The culprit who was stalking Mitsuhiko spoke and shwoed up behind Mitsuhiko: "So that's where it was hidden". When Mitsuhiko turned his head backwards, he realised that the culprit was Hayato Izumiya, the person who was "giving bird food in a purse" this morning. Also, the park visitor from before was wearing leather boots, just like the footprints outside the shed, meaning that he is the only possible culprit.

summary.en: After a long day of helping to clean and tidy the birdhouses at the park shed, the Detective Boys inquired of the park warden, Satoshi Kimishima, if he had more work to deploy to them. Fearing that he would not trust their abilities, they introduced themselves. After that, Kimishima finally asked them if they could find the owner of a hat that had stayed in the lost-and-found box for so long that it was time to dispose of it. After the Detective Boys had accepted the offer, the park warden walked towards another man, Hayato Izumiya, who was handing Kimishima a big purse filled with stuff. According to the park warden, there are many visitors that give the birds food, so it must be a bag full of food.

title.ja: 円谷光彦の探偵ノート3(スリー) (Tsuburaya Mitsuhiko no Tantei Nōto Surī)

summary.en: Mitsuhiko, Ayumi, and Genta happen to witness a quarrel taking place in front of an elderly actor selection venue, where two retired brothers, named Makio Yuida and Kozo Yuida respectively, were involved. To ascertain further details, the three Detective Boys visit Kozo and learn that Kozo was chosen to be the elderly actor immediately, which aroused Mitsuhiko to share some Sherlock Holmes "canon". He tells Kozo about the short story titled The Red-Headed League. Accordingly, he suspects Kozo might be drawn into a gigantic fraud, which is similar to the Sherlock Holmes story. However, as they arrived at Kozo's home, nothing out of the ordinary was noticed. Kozo mentioned that he and his brother each had a teapot inherited from their father. Recently he received a letter expressing his desire to purchase both their teapots. Soon, Mitsuhiko noticed something odd in the letter: even though the return address was written to be in Kyoto, the post stamp was clearly from Tokyo.

It takes much longer than usual for the police to know the corpse belongs to Daiki Fujinai.

summary.en: Heiji takes Kazuha, Kogoro, Ran, and Conan to East Okuho after receiving a letter from Makoto Okuda addressed to Shinichi; The letter tells Shinichi to meet with him so he could explain Shinichi's mistake in his deduction from his investigation one year ago. Upon arrival, the group learns that Makoto has been missing for over a year; Conan sneaks away from the group and heads to the meeting location disclosed in the letter and is subsequently trapped inside a shed by an unknown culprit. Conan realizes that he mistakenly took the antidote to the APTX 4869 in place of his cold medicine; He escapes through a window and falls into the river before becoming Shinichi again. Heiji and the others find an amnesic Shinichi by the shore; the villagers believe that the Shiragami, a deity living in the forest, cursed Shinichi resulting in his amnesia. Haibara tells Heiji that the antidote would wear off in 24 hours and if Shinichi still retains his amnesia even after reverting back to Conan, his identity would be exposed. Heiji learns that Shinichi was called to investigate the murder of the mayor and his wife which was concluded to be a forced double suicide. A journalist named Misato Kawauchi threatens to reveal Shinichi's secret if he does not confess to faking his amnesia. The following day, Kawauchi is found with a knife wound with Shinichi beside her holding a knife covered in her blood.

Conan found the micro SD last night and it is a concrete evidence. The only person who could've had the strap with Tatsumi's fingerprints was none other than Sazanami. It is revealed that Futaba has feelings for Tatsumi.

resolution.zhHans: 毛利小五郎要推理出此前几起袭击 Sakota 和 Sazanami 的事件是谁干的。剧组工作人员问，造成的那些事端不就是 Tatsumi 招来的吗，况且指纹是在属于他的背带上面发现的。毛利小五郎认为那条背带不过是凶手设下的陷阱。他指认 Kyounosuke Sasahara 就是凶手。这次的工作人员，名字里大多带有数字。Kyounosuke 里的「Kyo」可以读作 Kei，意思是金额。写在剧本里的死亡讯息同样是一个数字。Sasahara 问那又怎样，毛利小五郎认为原因是拍戏期间他多次给某人打电话。而且他总在与人争执。毛利小五郎认为与他争执的人就是 Tatsumi。Sasahara 告诉毛利小五郎他弄错了。真相是他争执的对象是经纪公司。他已经结婚并育有一个孩子。这件事被一位周刊记者抓到了。他对公司说：「我保持单身形象更有人气，替我保密。」随后 Sasahara 出示了他的手机通话记录，显示他一直在和 TMS Production 通话。毛利小五郎不知情，判断失误。于是他突然问 Yamashita 在袭击 Sazanami 那起事件发生时在哪里。柯南指出她当时正在吃土耳其饭。Yamashita 说没错，真相是她正为下一份工作减肥。但一遇到长崎著名的土耳其饭，她就忍不住了。
resolution.en: Kogoro is going to deduce who caused the previous incidents in which the culprit attacked Sakota and Sazanami. The tv workers asks wasn't it Tatsumi who was responsible for the incidents he caused and plus, the fingerprints were found on his strap which belonged to him. Kogoro thinks the strap was just a trap laid by the culprit. He accuses Kyounosuke Sasahara as the culprit. This time's staffs, most of them have numbers in their names. The "Kyo" in Kyounosuke can be read as Kei and that means amount. The dying message written in the script was also a number. Sasahara asks what about it and Kogoro thinks it's because during the drama, he's been calling somebody numerous times. Furthermore, he was always disputing. The person who was disputing with was Tatsumi is what Kogoro thinks. Sasahara tells Kogoro that's he wrong. The real truth is that he was disputing with the firm. He has a wife and a child. He was caught by a weekly newspaper journalist about it. He told them, "I'm more popular single, so keep it a secret," to the firm. Sasahara then shows his cellphone call log that he's been talking to the TMS Production. Kogoro didn't know that and he made a mistake. So he suddenly asks Yamashita where was she at the time of the incident of attacking Sazanami. Conan reveals she was eating at the Turkish Rice place. Yamashita says it's correct and the truth is she's on a diet for her next business. But when it comes to Nagasaki's famous Turkish Rice, she couldn't endure it.

summary.en: Everything began with a company called "Tsukuba Corporation", where it had an arrogant president, Shunichi Tsukuba, who always called himself "invincible and immortal"; he has been taking care of this company for five years already, succeeding his father's position as president (it was originally a furniture manufacturing firm founded by Tsukuba's grandfather and was passed over to Tsukuba's father and expanded in size; after the death of his father, Tsukuba became the lead and began to handle a variety of businesses rather than specialising in furniture production). It is just this kind of young president who has decisive strategies and bold ambitions and who wants to give his company a change. He has recently come across some assaults that would take his life... This was already the second time he encountered the attack incident. He liaised with the company staff members for urgent meetings, informing them regarding the situation. The responses he got from the staff members were suggestions to contact the police, as Tsukuba might be on the verge of losing his life. However, Tsukuba sneered and denied this proposal, as he sees himself as "an immortal man" so he would not back down in this matter, and even boasted that he would take down the attacker next time he saw him. After his haughty remark, the meeting room was filled with an atmosphere of unconvincingness. Notwithstanding that, all of them knew that it was no way to make Tsukuba change his decision, as he barely listened to any of the company staff members. He has his own mission; he has his own way of making decisions; he has his own manner... The only person he would listen to must be his aunt though, named Sadako Machigawa. Despite all of the staff members looked fairly worried concerning their president's situation, his relentless way of dealing with company matters was bound to receive grudges from certain people; hatred, dubiousness, and malice were covertly lurking among the company without the knowledge of Tsukuba...

motive.zhHans: 为了不让血溅到自己身上，他用卫生纸缠住手臂，并把卫生纸卷套在刀上，以限制飞溅的血量，再把刀指向服部平次和柯南，所以他们身上才沾到了血。此事被保密，因为一旦曝光，就会给由衣的父亲——一名国会议员——带来断送其政治生涯的灾难，因为他有了私生子。服部平次之所以查明真相，是因为 Momiji 命令 Iori 透露的提示，而且她在 Anzai 被刺时还听到了窥视孔上胶带的刮擦声。
motive.en: To avoid getting blood on himself, he wrapped his arm around toilet paper and put the toilet paper's roll around the knife to limit the quantity of blood to splatter and directed the knife towards Heiji and Conan so that was why they got blood on themselves. This was kept a secret because it would cause a career-ending disaster for Yui's father, who is a dietman, for having fathered a lovechild. Heiji found the truth because of the hint Momiji ordered Iori to reveal and she also heard a scratch of the tape on the peephole when Anzai was stabbed.

method.zhHans: 他出于嫉妒对方与自己女朋友走得太近而刺杀了被害人。他透过窥视孔看的诀窍是在窥视孔上贴胶带，把磨砂玻璃的表面压平以便看清。他还在自己家里、在戏剧社的活动室里练习在黑暗中刺击，甚至在笔记本上画下了波洛咖啡馆现场的草图。服部平次之所以查明真相，是因为 Momiji 命令 Iori 透露的提示，而且她在 Anzai 被刺时还听到了窥视孔上胶带的刮擦声。由衣揭露真相后，Ozumi 放声大哭，并接到了 Anzai 打来的电话，对方告诉他被刺的时候很痛。在漫画中，高木涉告诉目暮警部，最近的一起案件中犯人用萝卜让血迹消失了。
method.en: He stabbed the victim out of jealously that he was too close to his girlfriend. The trick he used to see through the peephole was to put tape on it to flatten the surface of the frosted glass to see. He also practiced himself in his house to stab in the dark at his drama club's room and even drew sketches of the setting in cafe Poirot in his notebook. Heiji found the truth because of the hint Momiji ordered Iori to reveal and she also heard a scratch of the tape on the peephole when Anzai was stabbed. After Yui revealed the truth, Ozumi bursts into tears and receives a phone call from Anzai that told him that it hurt when he stabbed him. In the manga, Takagi tells Inspector Megure that, in a recent case, the culprit had used daikon to make blood disappear.

evidence.zhHans: 服部平次之所以查明真相，是因为 Momiji 命令 Iori 透露的提示，而且她在 Anzai 被刺时还听到了窥视孔上胶带的刮擦声。由衣揭露真相后，Ozumi 放声大哭，并接到了 Anzai 打来的电话，对方告诉他被刺的时候很痛。后续：「Shinichi Wada」其实是 Momiji Ooka 家的管家 Muga Iori。他对 Momiji 提到，虽然服部平次对另一个女孩感兴趣，但这不会给 Momiji 造成问题。
evidence.en: Heiji found the truth because of the hint Momiji ordered Iori to reveal and she also heard a scratch of the tape on the peephole when Anzai was stabbed. After Yui revealed the truth, Ozumi bursts into tears and receives a phone call from Anzai that told him that it hurt when he stabbed him. Aftermath It's revealed that 'Shinichi Wada' is actually Muga Iori, the butler of Momiji Ooka's family. He mentions to Momiji that while Heiji is interested in another girl, it shouldn't prove a problem for Momiji.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Meisuke Ozumi。他出于嫉妒对方与自己女朋友走得太近而刺杀了被害人。他透过窥视孔看的诀窍是在窥视孔上贴胶带，把磨砂玻璃的表面压平以便看清。他还在自己家里、在戏剧社的活动室里练习在黑暗中刺击，甚至在笔记本上画下了波洛咖啡馆现场的草图。为了不让血溅到自己身上，他用卫生纸缠住手臂，并把卫生纸卷套在刀上，以限制飞溅的血量，再把刀指向服部平次和柯南，所以他们身上才沾到了血。开灯之前，他把卫生纸冲掉，把纸卷放回原处，并取下窥视孔上的胶带。Amuro 说那个卫生纸卷有点奇怪，像是被强行装上去过。真相是 Tengo 其实是 Ozumi 的女朋友由衣同父异母的兄弟姐妹。被害人 Tengo 甚至录下了给 Ozumi 的生日祝福，说明了他与由衣关系的真相。此事被保密，因为一旦曝光，就会给由衣的父亲——一名国会议员——带来断送其政治生涯的灾难，因为他有了私生子。服部平次之所以查明真相，是因为 Momiji 命令 Iori 透露的提示，而且她在 Anzai 被刺时还听到了窥视孔上胶带的刮擦声。由衣揭露真相后，Ozumi 放声大哭，并接到了 Anzai 打来的电话，对方告诉他被刺的时候很痛。
resolution.en: The culprit is Meisuke Ozumi. He stabbed the victim out of jealously that he was too close to his girlfriend. The trick he used to see through the peephole was to put tape on it to flatten the surface of the frosted glass to see. He also practiced himself in his house to stab in the dark at his drama club's room and even drew sketches of the setting in cafe Poirot in his notebook. To avoid getting blood on himself, he wrapped his arm around toilet paper and put the toilet paper's roll around the knife to limit the quantity of blood to splatter and directed the knife towards Heiji and Conan so that was why they got blood on themselves. Before the lights opened, he flushed the toilet paper, put the roll to its place back and retrieved the tape on the peephole. Amuro remarked that the toilet paper roll was a bit odd and seemed to have been forced. The truth is that Tengo is actually the half-sibling of Ozumi's girlfriend Yui. The victim, Tengo, even recorded a birthday message for Ozumi telling the truth about his relationship with Yui. This was kept a secret because it would cause a career-ending disaster for Yui's father, who is a dietman, for having fathered a lovechild. Heiji found the truth because of the hint Momiji ordered Iori to reveal and she also heard a scratch of the tape on the peephole when Anzai was stabbed. After Yui revealed the truth, Ozumi bursts into tears and receives a phone call from Anzai that told him that it hurt when he stabbed him.

motive.zhHans: Matsuo 把 Suwa 叫了出来，因为他骗 Suwa 以为自己想自杀。当时人在储藏室上一层房间的 Matsuo，从窗户朝正下方开枪——因为 Suwa 已经探身窗外足够远。由于那扇窗可以沿水平中轴翻转，翻回来时把被害人推回了房间内，于是看起来就像凶手是从房间门内开枪，而不是从窗户上方开的枪。
motive.en: Matsuo called Suwa, because he tricked him into thinking that he wanted to kill himself. Matsuo, who has been in a floor above the storage room had, from the window shot his gun vertically below because Suwa has leaned far enough out of the window. Because the window can be tilted along a horizontal central axis, it returned the victim back in to the room, making it look as if the offender had shot him from inside the room from the door and not from above the window in the room.

method.zhHans: Matsuo 把 Suwa 叫了出来，因为他骗 Suwa 以为自己想自杀。同时他把作案用的枪丢下，让枪和被害人一同落进房间。柯南通过模拟自己从窗口坠落的方式，还原了整个作案过程。
method.en: Matsuo called Suwa, because he tricked him into thinking that he wanted to kill himself. At the same time he dropped the gun he used, allowing it fall into the room along with the victim. Conan reconstructed the crime by pretending to fall out the window.

evidence.zhHans: 证据是手机上的通话记录：按下他手机的重拨键就会拨通 Suwa，这说明他在作案期间给 Suwa 打过电话。
evidence.en: The call log on the phone is the proof, hitting the redial on his phone would call Suwa which meant that he had called Suwa during the crime.

resolution.zhHans: 柯南把小五郎 骗进储藏室，用手表型麻醉枪让他睡着，借来一把彩弹枪，让熟睡的小五郎出现在电视画面上，与警方演出了一场「现场直播」。
resolution.en: Conan deceives Kogoro, gets him in the storage room, puts him to sleep with his stun gun wristwatch, borrows a paint gun, and stages a "Live Show" with the sleeping Kogoro appearing before the police on a television screen.

summary.en: The TV presenter Takashi Matsuo calls his colleague, Michihiko Suwa, and tells him that he wants to meet him after the show in the conference room. Matsuo hangs a photo of himself and Suwa, throws it across the room, and shoots it with a gun.

title.ja: 太閤恋する名人戦 (Taikō Koisuru Meijin-sen)
太閤名人の将棋盤 (Taikō Meijin no Shōgi-ban)

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Kosuke Hishinuma. He used the mixer to make lukewarm water, then used it to make some coffee. While waiting for the mixer, he killed Genda. Before that, he killed Kishimoto and placed the shogi board with three missing legs to confuse the order of the murders. He also set the AC temperature high, so that the body would be found with a high rectal temperature delaying the time of death.

motive.quote: He also set the AC temperature high, so that the body would be found with a high rectal temperature delaying the time of death.

method.quote: He used the mixer to make lukewarm water, then used it to make some coffee.

evidence.quote: He also set the AC temperature high, so that the body would be found with a high rectal temperature delaying the time of death.

motive.zhHans: 他还将空调温度调高，以便尸体被发现时直肠温度较高，从而推迟死亡时间推定。随后赤井鸣响汽车喇叭，让秀吉知道他和柯南是来救他的。当他把这件事告诉其他人时，其他人让他遵守沉默规则，即如果他们当中有人面临暴露的危险，他要保守团队的秘密并自杀以保护其他人。在得知还有另外两人参与这个作弊团伙后，他也决定将他们一并杀死，以为他最好的朋友Kinji报仇。
motive.en: He also set the AC temperature high, so that the body would be found with a high rectal temperature delaying the time of death. Akai then honks the car horn so that Shukichi knows that he and Conan are there to rescue him. When he told the others, they told him to follow the rule of silence, which means that if any of them were in danger of being exposed, he would keep the group's secret and kill himself to protect the others. After learning that two others were involved in this cheating circle, he decided to kill them as well in order to avenge his best friend Kinji.

method.zhHans: 他用搅拌机制作温水，然后用它冲了一些咖啡。秀吉通过盲棋向柯南和赤井说出他被绑架的房间。柯南用手机找到了秀吉的确切位置。在原版漫画中，Kishimoto的死因不明，而在第1035集的回忆片段中则显示他死于被刺。
method.en: He used the mixer to make lukewarm water, then used it to make some coffee. Using blind shogi, Shukichi tells Conan and Akai the room where he is abducted. Using his phone, Conan finds Shukichi’s exact location. In the original manga version, Kishimoto's cause of death is unknown, whereas it is shown that he died from being stabbed in a flashback from episode 1035.

evidence.zhHans: 他还将空调温度调高，以便尸体被发现时直肠温度较高，从而推迟死亡时间推定。Hishinuma认为自杀可疑，追踪到该团伙成员之一Nishikido，强迫他交代一切后将其杀死。
evidence.en: He also set the AC temperature high, so that the body would be found with a high rectal temperature delaying the time of death. Hishinuma, who found the suicide suspicious, tracked down one of the members of the group Nishikido and forced him to confess everything before killing him.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是Kosuke Hishinuma。他用搅拌机制作温水，然后用它冲了一些咖啡。在等待搅拌机的期间，他杀死了Genda。在此之前，他杀死了Kishimoto，并放置了缺了三条腿的将棋盘以扰乱杀人顺序。他还将空调温度调高，以便尸体被发现时直肠温度较高，从而推迟死亡时间推定。他们最终抵达了秀吉被绑架并带往的公寓。随后赤井鸣响汽车喇叭，让秀吉知道他和柯南是来救他的。秀吉通过盲棋向柯南和赤井说出他被绑架的房间。然而，为了做到这一点，秀吉不得不故意走出一步坏棋。Hishinuma察觉了这一点，随后发现了手机并将其砸碎。他威胁秀吉说会杀了他。
resolution.en: The culprit is Kosuke Hishinuma. He used the mixer to make lukewarm water, then used it to make some coffee. While waiting for the mixer, he killed Genda. Before that, he killed Kishimoto and placed the shogi board with three missing legs to confuse the order of the murders. He also set the AC temperature high, so that the body would be found with a high rectal temperature delaying the time of death. They finally arrived at the apartment where Shukichi was abducted and taken to. Akai then honks the car horn so that Shukichi knows that he and Conan are there to rescue him. Using blind shogi, Shukichi tells Conan and Akai the room where he is abducted. However, to do that, Shukichi had to intentionally make a bad move. Hishinuma realizes it, then discovers the phone and smashes it. He threatens Shukichi saying that he will kill him.

title.ja: 堤無津川凧揚げ事件 (Teimuzu-gawa Tako-age Jiken)

culpritSource.quote: This case is an attempted murder. The culprit is Takeshi Yatsukoshi. He uses a thread telephone made from bottles and a thread to direct the victim to the fences with no rope in order to make him fall into the river. The evidence that he is the culprit is Conan's cellphone which recorded his speech "Go to hell" to the victim.

title.ja: 帝丹高校学校怪談 (Teitan Kōkō Gakkō Kaidan)

culpritSource.quote: Conan, using Sonoko, solves the case and reveals the culprit was Kunishige Seko, a close friend to the dead student Hideaki Hosaka. Kunishige reveals that he found his friend's desk in the storage room with a name on it, thinking he was bullied and then murdered. Masao Monobe reveals the true story of events, Hosaka died saving him from falling backwards down the stairs while holding a heavy sculpture. The sculpture crushed Hosaka. Kazumi Tsukamoto explains that Hosaka's desk was put in the storage room so that it could be brought out for graduation in memory of Hosaka and was not to hide evid

motive.quote: Kazumi Tsukamoto explains that Hosaka's desk was put in the storage room so that it could be brought out for graduation in memory of Hosaka and was not to hide evidence.

method.quote: Conan, using Sonoko, solves the case and reveals the culprit was Kunishige Seko, a close friend to the dead student Hideaki Hosaka.

evidence.quote: Kunishige reveals that he found his friend's desk in the storage room with a name on it, thinking he was bullied and then murdered.

motive.zhHans: 冢本和美解释说，保坂的桌子之所以放进储藏室，是为了在毕业时搬出来纪念保坂，并不是为了藏匿证据。最先赶到现场的校医新出编了一套善意的谎话，说保坂临终时说自己并无怨恨，为的是安慰三年级的学生。新出说事情办得很顺利，但他问 Jodie：Vermouth 真的是恶人吗——因为所有学生和老师对那位化装成他的 Vermouth 的亲切与体贴都只有称赞。
motive.en: Kazumi Tsukamoto explains that Hosaka's desk was put in the storage room so that it could be brought out for graduation in memory of Hosaka and was not to hide evidence. Araide, who was the first doctor on the scene, concocts a white lie about Hosaka's last words to say held no grudges when he died in order to soothe the third years. Araide says it went smoothly but asks Jodie if Vermouth was really an evil person because all the students and teachers had nothing but praise for the disguised Vermouth's kindness and compassion.

method.zhHans: 柯南借园子之口解开案件，指出犯人是 Kunishige Seko——死者保坂英明的挚友。新出说事情办得很顺利，但他问 Jodie：Vermouth 真的是恶人吗——因为所有学生和老师对那位化装成他的 Vermouth 的亲切与体贴都只有称赞。
method.en: Conan, using Sonoko, solves the case and reveals the culprit was Kunishige Seko, a close friend to the dead student Hideaki Hosaka. Araide says it went smoothly but asks Jodie if Vermouth was really an evil person because all the students and teachers had nothing but praise for the disguised Vermouth's kindness and compassion.

evidence.zhHans: Kunishige 透露，他在储藏室发现朋友的桌子上写着名字，便以为朋友是被欺凌、然后被杀害的。冢本和美解释说，保坂的桌子之所以放进储藏室，是为了在毕业时搬出来纪念保坂，并不是为了藏匿证据。
evidence.en: Kunishige reveals that he found his friend's desk in the storage room with a name on it, thinking he was bullied and then murdered. Kazumi Tsukamoto explains that Hosaka's desk was put in the storage room so that it could be brought out for graduation in memory of Hosaka and was not to hide evidence.

resolution.zhHans: 柯南借园子之口解开案件，指出犯人是 Kunishige Seko——死者保坂英明的挚友。Kunishige 透露，他在储藏室发现朋友的桌子上写着名字，便以为朋友是被欺凌、然后被杀害的。物部雅夫道出事情的真相：保坂是为了救他而死的——当时他抱着一件沉重的雕塑往后跌下楼梯，雕塑压在了保坂身上。冢本和美解释说，保坂的桌子之所以放进储藏室，是为了在毕业时搬出来纪念保坂，并不是为了藏匿证据。最先赶到现场的校医新出编了一套善意的谎话，说保坂临终时说自己并无怨恨，为的是安慰三年级的学生。案件结束后，新出接到 Jodie 的电话，询问他重返帝丹高中的情况。新出说事情办得很顺利，但他问 Jodie：Vermouth 真的是恶人吗——因为所有学生和老师对那位化装成他的 Vermouth 的亲切与体贴都只有称赞。Jodie 生气地吼道：「一个人要是能笑着杀人，她怎么可能善良！？」随后挂断了电话。
resolution.en: Conan, using Sonoko, solves the case and reveals the culprit was Kunishige Seko, a close friend to the dead student Hideaki Hosaka. Kunishige reveals that he found his friend's desk in the storage room with a name on it, thinking he was bullied and then murdered. Masao Monobe reveals the true story of events, Hosaka died saving him from falling backwards down the stairs while holding a heavy sculpture. The sculpture crushed Hosaka. Kazumi Tsukamoto explains that Hosaka's desk was put in the storage room so that it could be brought out for graduation in memory of Hosaka and was not to hide evidence. Dr. Araide, who was the first doctor on the scene, concocts a white lie about Hosaka's last words to say held no grudges when he died in order to soothe the third years. After the case, Dr. Araide receives a call from Jodie who is checking on his reintegration into Teitan High. Dr. Araide says it went smoothly but asks Jodie if Vermouth was really an evil person because all the students and teachers had nothing but praise for the disguised Vermouth's kindness and compassion. Jodie angrily hangs up on Araide after yelling, "How in the world can someone be kind if she kills people with a smile!?"

title.ja: 天下一夜祭殺人事件 (Tenkaichi Yomatsuri Satsujin Jiken)
title.zhHans: 天下第一夜祭杀人事件

summary.en: During the night of the Tenkaichi Festival at the Okeyama Hotel, an author named Satoru Imatake is brushing his teeth in the bathroom, and his friend, Norikazu Sasai is making a mess. When he checks on Sasai, he is confused about Sasai being dressed up weird, and sees that the hotel room was a big mess. Sasai raises his gun to aim at Imatake's forehead and shoots him. He also takes his money from his wallet.

First, he added codes in the verses that you recited, the seventh word from the seventh verse, ninth word from the ninth verse and the eleventh word from the eleventh verse. It says "I am the culprit". And then, you recited provoking verses while subconsciously confessing that it was Ryosuke Shiina. Adding his message in your verses, ridiculing both Kogoro and the police, chuckling away. Judging from that part of your personality, Kogoro thought that with the appropriate conditions, you would definitely recite the verse stolen from Ushikubo, as his own. With the

motive.quote: Ryosuke confesses and reveals Ushikubo is tricking them out of their money, he couldn't forgive him.

method.quote: He can know something like that easily by setting up some video cameras, that was under the hedge, Conan found some tripod marks, he had gone to Teien Art Museum in the morning, and set up a video camera by the pond.

motive.zhHans: Ryosuke 供认，并揭示 Ushikubo 一直在骗他们的钱，他无法原谅他。
motive.en: Ryosuke confesses and reveals Ushikubo is tricking them out of their money, he couldn't forgive him.

method.zhHans: 要知道那种事轻而易举：只要装几台摄像机——在树篱底下，柯南发现了三脚架的痕迹；他早上去了庭园美术馆，在池边架了一台摄像机。他当时操控了抽签，让 Ushikubo 抽到容易下手的地点，而给自己最远、最容易制造不在场证明的地方。
method.en: He can know something like that easily by setting up some video cameras, that was under the hedge, Conan found some tripod marks, he had gone to Teien Art Museum in the morning, and set up a video camera by the pond. He manipulated the lots at that time for Ushikubo to pick an easy place to be murdered and gave himself the furthest location where you could create your alibi easily.

evidence.zhHans: 证据是 Ryosuke 说过的一句话：「我喜欢有情感的句子，比如父亲对女儿的爱。」要知道那种事轻而易举：只要装几台摄像机——在树篱底下，柯南发现了三脚架的痕迹；他早上去了庭园美术馆，在池边架了一台摄像机。之后，你把八木泽的眼药放在 Ushikubo 的手指旁，再把雨衣和凶器扔到月照寺，取回庭园美术馆的录像，若无其事地回到旅馆。证据是 Ushikubo 的临终留言——那既不是指向竹子，也不是指向武士宅邸。
evidence.en: The proof is Ryosuke said, "I like verses with emotions, like the love of a father for his daughter". He can know something like that easily by setting up some video cameras, that was under the hedge, Conan found some tripod marks, he had gone to Teien Art Museum in the morning, and set up a video camera by the pond. After that, you placed Yagisawa's eye medication near Ushikubo's finger, then threw the raincoat and the murder weapon at Gesshoji, retrieved the video from Teien Art Museum and nonchalantly you returned to the hotel. The proof is Ushikubo's dying message, that wasn't pointing to the bamboo nor to the samurai's mansion.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Ryosuke Shiina。首先，他在你们吟诵的句子里埋了暗号：第七句的第七个字、第九句的第九个字、第十一句的第十一个字，连起来读是「我就是犯人」。接着，他一边吟诵挑衅的句子，一边在潜意识里认罪说那就是 Ryosuke Shiina 所为。把自己的讯息嵌进你的句子里，把 小五郎 和警方都嘲弄了一番，暗自窃笑。小五郎从他的这种性格判断：只要条件合适，他一定会把从 Ushikubo 那里偷来的句子当作自己的作品吟出来——理由很简单，因为他真的很喜欢那句。证据是 Ryosuke 说过的一句话：「我喜欢有情感的句子，比如父亲对女儿的爱。」而所需的条件是：先把八木泽当作嫌疑人拘押，再让上一句末尾的「花」以接龙方式与第十三句相连。正如小五郎借柯南之口预测的那样，他把从 Ushikubo 那里偷来的句子吟了出来，仿佛亲自展示自己的胜利。要知道那种事轻而易举：只要装几台摄像机——在树篱底下，柯南发现了三脚架的痕迹；他早上去了庭园美术馆，在池边架了一台摄像机。他用偷来的 Ushikubo 备用手机给八木泽发了一条短信，于是八木泽去了松江城并杀死了 Ushikubo。之后，他把八木泽的眼药放在 Ushikubo 的手指旁，再把雨衣和凶器扔到月照寺，取回庭园美术馆的录像，若无其事地回到旅馆。证据是 Ushikubo 的临终留言——那既不是指向竹子，也不是指向武士宅邸。那个留言是数字「1」，指的是连歌的第一句「发句」。随后，椿刑警被问到，他观察的结果是 Ryosuke 的鞋：左脚、最上方的鞋钩上，确认留有 Ushikubo 伸出的、带血食指的指纹。换句话说，他的临终留言指的就是你鞋上的鞋钩。他的心大概已被 Ushikubo 笔记本里的句子夺走，没注意到对方碰到了你鞋上的鞋钩。小五郎最初怀疑 Ryosuke 的最后一个依据，是前一晚抽签时的情形：通常制作签的人最后才抽，但他第二个就抽了，还说「接下来按年龄排，轮到我了」。他当时操控了抽签，让 Ushikubo 抽到容易下手的地点，而给自己最远、最容易制造不在场证明的地方。Ryosuke 供认，并揭示 Ushikubo 一直在骗他们的钱，他无法原谅他。
resolution.en: The culprit is Ryosuke Shiina. First, he added codes in the verses that you recited, the seventh word from the seventh verse, ninth word from the ninth verse and the eleventh word from the eleventh verse. It says "I am the culprit". And then, you recited provoking verses while subconsciously confessing that it was Ryosuke Shiina. Adding his message in your verses, ridiculing both Kogoro and the police, chuckling away. Judging from that part of your personality, Kogoro thought that with the appropriate conditions, you would definitely recite the verse stolen from Ushikubo, as his own. With the simple reason that you really like this verse. The proof is Ryosuke said, "I like verses with emotions, like the love of a father for his daughter". And the required conditions were, having Yagisawa taken into custody as the suspect, and connecting the thirteenth verse on flowers from the verse prior to it in shiritori manner. Just as Kogoro via Conan had predicted, you read the verse you stole from Ushikubo, as if to personally display your victory. He can know something like that easily by setting up some video cameras, that was under the hedge, Conan found some tripod marks, he had gone to Teien Art Museum in the morning, and set up a video camera by the pond. With, Ushikubo's spare cellphone that he had stolen, you sent a text message to Yagisawa, then he went to Matsue Castle and murdered Ushikubo. After that, you placed Yagisawa's eye medication near Ushikubo's finger, then threw the raincoat and the murder weapon at Gesshoji, retrieved the video from Teien Art Museum and nonchalantly you returned to the hotel. The proof is Ushikubo's dying message, that wasn't pointing to the bamboo nor to the samurai's mansion. The message was the number, '1'. That means the first verse of linked verse called Hokku. Then, asked Detective Tsubaki, the result of his observation is the shoes of Ryosuke, on the left foot, topmost left hook, they confirmed Ushikubo's stretched bloody index finger fingerprints. In other words, his dying message was the hook on your shoe. His heart was probably taken in by the verse in Ushikubo's notebook and didn't notice him touching the hook on your shoe. The final evidence why Kogoro suspect Ryosuke was his first suspicion were when he was drawing a lots last night. Normally, the one who created the lots would draw last. But, he went on the second draw, he said "Next, according to age line up, will be my turn". He manipulated the lots at that time for Ushikubo to pick an easy place to be murdered and gave himself the furthest location where you could create your alibi easily. Ryosuke confesses and reveals Ushikubo is tricking them out of their money, he couldn't forgive him.

title.ja: 17(じゅうなな)年前の真相 (Jūnana-nen Mae no Shinsō) 1164 血染めの騎士(ナイト) (Chizome no Naito ?)

culpritSource.quote: Rumi Wakasa is the culprit of the robbery at the nearby firearm store for a weapon to fight back those who are attempting to kill her. She purposely broke Kobayashi's parachute so she could suggest using her own parachute. The purpose was that when Kobayashi and others are out, Korn and Chianti, the snipers would then see Kobayashi as the target and shoot her, which will reveal the place where they are standing so she can shoot them with the gun stolen from the firearm store.
culpritSource.cleanNote: 原文 'Rumi Wakasa is the culprit of the robbery at the nearby firearm store...'，去掉作案对象后为人名

motive.quote: Rumi, having felt the imminent danger, robbed a gun shop nearby and used Kobayashi as bait so that she could find the location of the snipers trying to take her down.

method.quote: She purposely broke Kobayashi's parachute so she could suggest using her own parachute.

evidence.quote: Shootout Location: Unknown building Victim: Chianti Age: Unknown Injury: Gunshot wound to the left shoulder Culprit: Rumi Wakasa Rumi Wakasa is the culprit of the robbery at the nearby firearm store for a weapon to fight back those who are attempting to kill her.

motive.zhHans: Rumi 感受到迫在眉睫的危险，抢劫了附近的一家枪店，并利用 Kobayashi 作诱饵，以便找出那些试图杀掉她的狙击手的位置。例如 Amanda 要求 Rum 说日语、以便他能在下属面前不必端着架子的那些台词，以及 Rum 向 Kohji 询问 Asaka 下落时 Kohji 的几句愤怒台词。
motive.en: Rumi, having felt the imminent danger, robbed a gun shop nearby and used Kobayashi as bait so that she could find the location of the snipers trying to take her down. For example, the lines when Amanda asks Rum to speak Japanese so that they can talk without putting on airs in front of his subordinate, and some of Kohji's angry lines when Rum asked him about Asaka whereabouts.

method.en: She purposely broke Kobayashi's parachute so she could suggest using her own parachute. Rumi, having felt the imminent danger, robbed a gun shop nearby and used Kobayashi as bait so that she could find the location of the snipers trying to take her down.

Rumi Wakasa is revealed to be the missing bodyguard of Amanda Hughes.

title.ja: 36マスの完全犯罪(パーフェクトゲーム) (Sanjūroku Masu no Pāfekuto Gēmu)

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Sumiya Nishino. He planned to commit suicide and frame Raito Fujide for his death as well as the others. He made Wada go to the toilet by making Wada to write his name on the paper which have four torn edges. Nishino also made him and Kawasaki the ones to investigate the noise by hiding a full mint case inside his sleeve while shaking the empty one. Kogoro deduces that the noise is made by Nishino himself using another phone. He also poured honey on Kawasaki's phone and made him touch the screen by sending a message. Since Kawasaki is a clean freak, he will head to the toilet to

motive.quote: Since Kawasaki is a clean freak, he will head to the toilet to wash his hands.

method.quote: Suddenly, Nishino starts screaming and tries to consume a pill containing poison, only to be stopped be Kogoro.

evidence.quote: The code Kogoro received reads "It's time to play ball." The code stuck to the chapel door reads "One out in the toilet." The code found in the rooms reads "Two outs in the bath." The code found next to Kawasaki's body reads "Three outs in the study." The code handed to Fujide reads "Perfect game." Motive Nishino found out that his highschool baseball team lost a game against another highschool attached to Shinano University on purpose while he is injured.

motive.zhHans: 由于 Kawasaki 有洁癖，他会前往洗手间洗手。Nishino 因为自己当时不在场、没能阻止球队故意输球而感到沮丧。由于 Nichihara 在短时间内投了 42 局、约 1000 球，他的肩膀已到了极限。Wada 建议故意输球，因为 Nichihara 坚持要投到最后。“一分钟都不该浪费。”随后，在心里，Komei 说道：“正如俗话所说，时间就是金钱。”漫画与动画的差异主条目：漫画与动画差异列表 Ikue 的头发在漫画中是黑色的，在动画中改为金色，而 Raito 原本的金色头发则改为深棕色。
motive.en: Since Kawasaki is a clean freak, he will head to the toilet to wash his hands. Nishino was frustated because he was not there to stop the team losing on purpose. Because Nichihara played 42 innings and threw roughly 1000 pitches in a short amount of time, his shoulder was at its limit. Wada suggested to lose on purpose because Nichihara insisted on pitching until the end otherwise. Not a moment should be wasted." After that, in his thoughts, Komei says "As they say, time is money." Manga to anime changes Main article: List of differences between the manga and anime Ikue's hair is black in the manga, when in the anime is changed to blonde, while Raito's originally blonde hair is changed to dark brown.

method.zhHans: 突然，Nishino 开始尖叫，并试图吞下一枚装有毒药的药丸，结果被毛利小五郎阻止。自杀未遂地点：长野县一座废弃教堂受害者：Sumiya Nishino 年龄：28 岁时间：夜间作案手法：水瓶中的毒药犯人是 Sumiya Nishino。毛利小五郎推断出那个声音是 Nishino 本人用另一部手机制造的。Nishino 还在 Kawasaki 的手帕上涂了毒药。江户川柯南注意到 Kawasaki 洗手时会咬住手帕，因此毒药很容易沾到他的嘴唇上，毒药是在他喝水时被吞下的。Kawasaki 死亡的场景在动画中更长，因为我们看到了他慢慢死于毒药发作的过程，而漫画只显示了他的尸体。
method.en: Suddenly, Nishino starts screaming and tries to consume a pill containing poison, only to be stopped be Kogoro. Attempted Suicide Location: Abandoned church in Nagano Prefecture Victim: Sumiya Nishino Age: 28 years old Time: At night Modus operandi: Poison from water bottle The culprit is Sumiya Nishino. Kogoro deduces that the noise is made by Nishino himself using another phone. Nishino also applied poison to Kawasaki's handkerchief. Conan noticed that Kawasaki bites his handkerchief while washing his hand, so the poison can easily get onto his lips, and the poison was swallowed while he was drinking. The scene where Kawasaki dies is longer in the anime, as we see the process of him slowly dying from the effects of the poison, whereas the manga only shows his corpse.

evidence.zhHans: 毛利小五郎收到的暗号写着：“该打球了。”贴在教堂门上的暗号写着：“厕所一人出局。”在房间里发现的暗号写着：“浴室两人出局。”在 Kawasaki 的尸体旁发现的暗号写着：“书房三人出局。”交给 Fujide 的暗号写着：“完全比赛。”动机 Nishino 得知，在他受伤期间，他的高中棒球队故意输掉了与信州大学附属高中的一场比赛。和叶晃平的尸体在漫画中被发现时眼睛是睁开的，而动画版该场景中他的眼睛是闭着的。
evidence.en: The code Kogoro received reads "It's time to play ball." The code stuck to the chapel door reads "One out in the toilet." The code found in the rooms reads "Two outs in the bath." The code found next to Kawasaki's body reads "Three outs in the study." The code handed to Fujide reads "Perfect game." Motive Nishino found out that his highschool baseball team lost a game against another highschool attached to Shinano University on purpose while he is injured. Kouhei Wada's eyes are open when his body is found in the manga, but the anime version of the scene has his eyes closed.

resolution.zhHans: Fujide 突然收到 Nishino 发来的一条讯息，Nishino 声称他知道犯人是谁，并要求 Fujide 在无人察觉的情况下前往书房。进入房间后，Nishino 递给他另一张暗号纸。突然，Nishino 开始尖叫，并试图吞下一枚装有毒药的药丸，结果被毛利小五郎阻止。自杀未遂
resolution.en: Fujide suddenly receives a message from Nishino, claiming that he knows who the culprit is, and asks Fujide to come to the study room without anyone noticing. After arriving inside the room, Nishino gives him another code sheet. Suddenly, Nishino starts screaming and tries to consume a pill containing poison, only to be stopped be Kogoro. Attempted Suicide

title.ja: 大阪“3つのK”事件 (Ōsaka "Mittsu no K" Jiken)

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Ray Curtis. Instead of performing the deduction in front of everyone, Conan has Heiji call him out to the crime scene alone because he wants to confront Ray by himself, claiming that "his greatest fan" is waiting for him.

motive.quote: Instead of performing the deduction in front of everyone, Conan has Heiji call him out to the crime scene alone because he wants to confront Ray by himself, claiming that "his greatest fan" is waiting for him.

method.quote: Ray set up a mechanism at the rightmost bottom room in advance with a mop and a closet's door.

evidence.quote: The conclusive piece of evidence is the gunpowder on his shoes after firing the revolver.

motive.zhHans: 柯南没有当着众人的面推理，而是让平次单独把他叫到案发现场，因为他想亲自面对 Ray，声称「他最忠实的粉丝」正在等他。为了在那么短的时间内杀死 McCay，Ray 先打开了他负责的几层共四个房间的所有灯，再去敲 McCay 的房门。这样一来，警方就不会怀疑他是凶手，因为「在开完灯后跑到被害人房间、开枪打死 McCay、再冲回最右下角的房间」时间根本不够。由于 McCay 的房间在二楼，Ricardo 和 Mike 都不可能在不被 Ray 察觉的情况下作案，于是 Ray 本人成了唯一有可能作案的嫌疑人。然而 Ray 接不住那颗球，因为吸毒导致他关节疼痛。【动机】Ray 作案的动机是复仇：McCay 那篇诬指他吸毒的文章，害得他妻子自杀。为了把 McCay 引出来，Ray 真的用了毒品；但那终究也是他用来承受丧妻之痛的方式。
motive.en: Instead of performing the deduction in front of everyone, Conan has Heiji call him out to the crime scene alone because he wants to confront Ray by himself, claiming that "his greatest fan" is waiting for him. In order to murder McCay in such a small time frame, Ray first turned on all the lights in the four rooms on the floors he was managing and knocked on the door of McCay's room. Because of that, the police wouldn't suspect him to be the murderer as he didn't have enough time to "run to the victim's room after turning on the lights, shoot and kill McCay, and rush back to the rightmost bottom room". Because McCay’s room was on the second floor, neither Ricardo or Mike were capable of committing the crime without Ray noticing, making Ray himself the only possible suspect capable of committing the murder. However Ray is unable to catch his ball because drug use caused joint pain. Motive Ray's motive for committing the crime was for revenge, as McCay's article which falsely accused him of being a drug addict caused his wife to commit suicide. In order to lure McCay out, Ray used drugs for real, but ultimately, it was also a way for him to cope with the pain of losing his wife.

method.zhHans: Ray 事先在最右下角的房间里用一把拖把和一扇柜门设下了机关，让他能在案发时为自己制造不在场证明。用上述手法并让兰确认了他的不在场证明之后，他冲到 McCay 所在的房间杀了他，随即跑下楼到最右下角的房间，让所有人都以为他一直待在那里。开枪打死 McCay 后，他先穿回外套才露面，并利用警方赶到前的时间把衣服翻面、洗掉手上和脸上残留的火药。为了那个接球的手法，Ray 必须穿着鞋，而且作案后没有洗鞋。不过 Ray 纠正了这一说法，指出他是在案子在法庭上审结之后才开始吸毒的。为了把 McCay 引出来，Ray 真的用了毒品；但那终究也是他用来承受丧妻之痛的方式。
method.en: Ray set up a mechanism at the rightmost bottom room in advance with a mop and a closet's door. Allowing him to create an alibi for himself at the time of murder. After utilizing the trick above and having Ran confirm his alibi, he rushed to the room McCay was in and killed him, and immediately ran downstairs to the rightmost bottom room to make everyone think that he was there all along. After shooting McCay, he put his jacket back on before showing his face to the crowd and used the remaining time before the police arrived to flip his clothes inside out, and washed away any remaining gunpowder on his hands and face. Ray had to be wearing shoes for the ball trick and didn't wash his shoes after the crime. However, Ray corrects his claim and reveals that he started using after the case was settled in the court. In order to lure McCay out, Ray used drugs for real, but ultimately, it was also a way for him to cope with the pain of losing his wife.

evidence.zhHans: 决定性的证据是他开过左轮手枪后鞋上留下的火药。警方一旦在他鞋上查出火药残留，就毫无疑问能证明他是凶手。听到柯南的推理后，Ray 决定去把鞋擦干净，「除掉把自己和案件联系起来的最后一件证据」，却被柯南拦下——柯南用增强威力鞋踢出一记足球打中了他。
evidence.en: The conclusive piece of evidence is the gunpowder on his shoes after firing the revolver. Once the police discover the gunpowder residue on them, it will prove without a doubt that he is the murderer. Hearing Conan's deduction, Ray decides to go clean his shoes to "remove the last piece of evidence connecting him to the crime", but is stopped by Conan who kicks a soccer ball at him via super kick shoes.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Ray Curtis。柯南没有当着众人的面推理，而是让平次单独把他叫到案发现场，因为他想亲自面对 Ray，声称「他最忠实的粉丝」正在等他。Ray 事先在最右下角的房间里用一把拖把和一扇柜门设下了机关。他站在与 McCay 所在房间同层的楼梯顶端踢出一球撞开拖把，从而能在三秒内开灯并射杀 McCay，让他得以在案发时为自己制造不在场证明。
resolution.en: The culprit is Ray Curtis. Instead of performing the deduction in front of everyone, Conan has Heiji call him out to the crime scene alone because he wants to confront Ray by himself, claiming that "his greatest fan" is waiting for him. Ray set up a mechanism at the rightmost bottom room in advance with a mop and a closet's door. By kicking a ball from the top of the stairs on the same floor as the room McCay was in to knock away the mop, Ray was able to turn on the lights and shoot McCay within three seconds. Allowing him to create an alibi for himself at the time of murder.

title.en: The Actress Blogger's Locked Room Case
title.ja: ブログ女優の密室事件 (Burogu Joyū no Misshitsu Jiken?)
title.zhHans: 女演员博主的密室事件

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Saya Kitami, who is actually 29 years old. She used a recording of Sakurako to lure Kyona into opening the door for her. The murder weapon was Kyona Shono's selfie stick, which Saya took to her own apartment. She used her toy helicopter in order to close Kyona's apartment door and leave the card inside.

motive.quote: She used her toy helicopter in order to close Kyona's apartment door and leave the card inside.

method.quote: She used a recording of Sakurako to lure Kyona into opening the door for her.

evidence.quote: The murder weapon was Kyona Shono's selfie stick, which Saya took to her own apartment.

motive.zhHans: 她用玩具直升机关上Kyona公寓的门并把卡片留在里面。这个不幸的误会起因是Saya在照片里看到一套漫画，标题为《爱的肇事逃逸》，她以为Kyona指的是《肇事逃逸》（Hit and Run），这在英文里意为用车引发事故后逃离现场。之后Hyoue Kuroda警视长来到犯罪现场并宣布，由于Kiyonaga Matsumoto警视长已晋升为警视厅的高级警视长，他将接替其职位。
motive.en: She used her toy helicopter in order to close Kyona's apartment door and leave the card inside. The unhappy misunderstanding happened because Saya saw a manga series in the picture with the title 'The hit and run of love' and thought that Kyona was referring to 'Hit and Run' which in English means to cause an accident with a car and flee the scene. Afterwards, Superintendent Hyoue Kuroda arrives on the crime scene and announces that since Superintendent Kiyonaga Matsumoto has been promoted as Senior Superintendent of the Tokyo Metropolitan Police Department, he will be taking his place.

method.zhHans: 她用Sakurako的录音引诱Kyona为她开门。她用玩具直升机关上Kyona公寓的门并把卡片留在里面。那套漫画被布置成：把数字用简单的数字密码换成平假名后，会组成句子「Saya 29岁」。这一揭示让Saya崩溃落泪，因为她毫无理由地杀害了Kyona。
method.en: She used a recording of Sakurako to lure Kyona into opening the door for her. She used her toy helicopter in order to close Kyona's apartment door and leave the card inside. The manga series was set up so the numbers when replaced with hiragana in a simple number code would form the sentence 'Saya is 29 years old.' With this revelation, Saya breaks down in tears as she had murdered Kyona for no reason at all.

evidence.zhHans: 凶器是Kyona Shono的自拍杆，Saya把它带回了自己的公寓。
evidence.en: The murder weapon was Kyona Shono's selfie stick, which Saya took to her own apartment.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是Saya Kitami，她实际上29岁。她用Sakurako的录音引诱Kyona为她开门。凶器是Kyona Shono的自拍杆，Saya把它带回了自己的公寓。她用玩具直升机关上Kyona公寓的门并把卡片留在里面。她的动机是她以为Kyona知道她曾在车祸中意外撞死一名老人并逃离了犯罪现场，但Conan揭露Kyona所知道的唯一秘密是Saya实际上比她自称的年龄大五岁。这个不幸的误会起因是Saya在照片里看到一套漫画，标题为《爱的肇事逃逸》，她以为Kyona指的是《肇事逃逸》（Hit and Run），这在英文里意为用车引发事故后逃离现场。Hit and Run（过去）
resolution.en: The culprit is Saya Kitami, who is actually 29 years old. She used a recording of Sakurako to lure Kyona into opening the door for her. The murder weapon was Kyona Shono's selfie stick, which Saya took to her own apartment. She used her toy helicopter in order to close Kyona's apartment door and leave the card inside. Her motive was that she thought Kyona knew she had accidentally killed an old man in a car accident and fled the crime scene, but Conan reveals that the only secret Kyona knew was that Saya was actually five years older than she claimed to be. The unhappy misunderstanding happened because Saya saw a manga series in the picture with the title 'The hit and run of love' and thought that Kyona was referring to 'Hit and Run' which in English means to cause an accident with a car and flee the scene. Hit and Run (Past)

It turns out the dying message can also be read as "akabeko", that in Fukuoka dialect means loincloth. Sonoko asks the suspects to remove their pants, to discover that the three are using loincloths, except that Fukumoto's is much longer that the other ones, and like that the murder weapon is discovered. Conan was certain this w

motive.quote: It turns out that Akabeko were originally children's toys to not get the smallpox disease nad protect them.

method.quote: Sonoko asks the suspects to remove their pants, to discover that the three are using loincloths, except that Fukumoto's is much longer that the other ones, and like that the murder weapon is discovered.

evidence.quote: Sonoko asks the suspects to remove their pants, to discover that the three are using loincloths, except that Fukumoto's is much longer that the other ones, and like that the murder weapon is discovered.

motive.zhHans: 原来Akabeko原本是儿童玩具，用来防止感染天花疾病并保护他们。
motive.en: It turns out that Akabeko were originally children's toys to not get the smallpox disease nad protect them.

method.zhHans: Sonoko 要求嫌疑人脱下裤子，发现这三人都穿着兜裆布，只是 Fukumoto 的比其他人的长得多，就这样凶器被发现了。Conan 在追着他到卫生间时，确定这就是被用作凶器的东西，他听到 Fukumoto 进去的那个隔间里有沙沙作响的声音，那是他摩擦兜裆布的声音。面对她时，Motoko 回答说Akabeko的艺术是她的，Fukumoto 应该感激没有被赶走；Fukumoto 暴怒，终于崩溃并将她勒死。
method.en: Sonoko asks the suspects to remove their pants, to discover that the three are using loincloths, except that Fukumoto's is much longer that the other ones, and like that the murder weapon is discovered. Conan was certain this was used as the murder weapon when he came after him to the bathroom, and he heard rustling sounds inside the compartment that Fukumoto went, and it was the sound of him rubbing the loincloth. As he confronted her, Motoko replied that Akabeko art was hers, and that Fukumoto should be grateful of not being kicked out; Fukumoto was enraged and finally snapped and strangled her to death.

evidence.zhHans: Sonoko 要求嫌疑人脱下裤子，发现这三人都穿着兜裆布，只是 Fukumoto 的比其他人的长得多，就这样凶器被发现了。Conan 在追着他到卫生间时，确定这就是被用作凶器的东西，他听到 Fukumoto 进去的那个隔间里有沙沙作响的声音，那是他摩擦兜裆布的声音。Fukumoto 试图为自己辩护，但决定性的证据是他兜裆布上的一处血迹，那是行凶时留下的。直到 Fukumoto 发现她签署了一份不含他的新生意合同。
evidence.en: Sonoko asks the suspects to remove their pants, to discover that the three are using loincloths, except that Fukumoto's is much longer that the other ones, and like that the murder weapon is discovered. Conan was certain this was used as the murder weapon when he came after him to the bathroom, and he heard rustling sounds inside the compartment that Fukumoto went, and it was the sound of him rubbing the loincloth. Fukumoto tries to defend himself, but the decisive proof is a bloodstain on his loincloth that got there during the murder. Until Fukumoto discovered that she had signed a contract to start a new business without him.

resolution.zhHans: Conan 让 Sonoko 镇静下来，开始了推理。
resolution.en: Conan tranquillizes Sonoko and begins the deduction.

summary.en: Conan, Ran, and Sonoko visited an exhibition by an up-and-coming artist, Motoko Bekobe. Motoko has been releasing avant-garde works that combine traditional akabe with modern art, and are evidently attracting further attention across the globe. The three of them first saw a ceremony in the New Beika Modern Art Museum, there were several men dancing, wearing loincloths, cheering up for the big day. They constantly uttered the peculiar motto "Akabeko Bekoe", hinting everyone about Bekobe's success.

suspects: Junya Fukui, Toshiharu Fukumoto and Hajime Fukura
suspectsZh: 福井纯也、福本俊治与福良一

Upon entering the building, they are asked to call his sectional number, 423. After getting in contact with him on the phone, they witness the employee Fujihiko Takahata, fall from the building to his death.

victims.name: Fujihiko Takahata
victims.causeOfDeath: Fell from the sixth floor of the building

title.en: The Alibi of the Soothing Forest
title.ja: 癒しの森のアリバイ (Iyashi no Mori no Aribai)

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan visit a small house in Shinano village, Nagano Prefecture, that is surrounded by a beautiful forest called the "Soothing Forest". There, they meet a group of people who sell things and use ledgers, led by a village head. motive.quote: Conan then deduces that there is no way the culprit is Chono or Sakamaki because they would’ve made a sound when they lifted the spear and would have been heard by Nishitsu.

method.quote: Subaru reveals his tray would have been enough to cover that cost because the other two trays aren't fakes, but studies.

evidence.quote: Feeling that it would be discovered, he painted the entire dish with similar colored oil paint, but in the end, he got found out and got a severe scolding.

motive.zhHans: 江户川柯南随后推断，犯人不可能是 Chono 或 Sakamaki，因为他们在抬起长矛时会发出声响，并会被 Nishitsu 听到。他的动机是他身患重病的女儿，治疗需要花费巨额金钱。Subaru 透露，他的那个托盘的价值足以支付这笔费用，因为另外两个托盘不是赝品，而是习作。漫画与动画的差异 主条目：漫画与动画的差异列表 由于这三集改编自四章漫画，出现了一些漫画中没有的额外场景：回忆《替身演员》中的 Makoto Kyogoku，当时真纯询问了兰和园子关于灰原的事。
motive.en: Conan then deduces that there is no way the culprit is Chono or Sakamaki because they would’ve made a sound when they lifted the spear and would have been heard by Nishitsu. His motive was his daughter who has a serious illness that costs a huge amount of money to treat. Subaru reveals his tray would have been enough to cover that cost because the other two trays aren't fakes, but studies. Manga to anime changes Main article: List of differences between the manga and anime Because these three epiosdes were adapted from four manga chapters, there are some additional scenes that were not in the manga: Flashback to Makoto Kyogoku the Understudy, where Sera asked Ran and Sonoko about Haibara.

method.zhHans: Subaru 透露，他的那个托盘的价值足以支付这笔费用，因为另外两个托盘不是赝品，而是习作。油漆可能是 Nishitsu 用溶剂去除油漆时剥落的。玛丽说那是来自 Tsutomu 的东西，后来 Shuichi 也捡到并经常使用。
method.en: Subaru reveals his tray would have been enough to cover that cost because the other two trays aren't fakes, but studies. The paint might have peeled off when Nishitsu used a solvent to remove the paint. Mary says that it comes from Tsutomu, which later Shuichi also picked up and often used.

evidence.zhHans: 他觉得会被发现，于是用相近颜色的油画颜料涂满了整个盘子，但最终还是被发现并遭到了严厉的训斥。在动画中，助听器是由鉴识人员发现的，随后由千叶把它带到犯罪现场。在漫画中，助听器仍在犯罪现场，是高木踩到它之后才发现的。
evidence.en: Feeling that it would be discovered, he painted the entire dish with similar colored oil paint, but in the end, he got found out and got a severe scolding. In the anime, the hearing aid is discovered by the forensics, then it is brought to the crime scene by Chiba. In the manga, the hearing aid was still on the crime scene, it was discovered by Takagi after he stepped on it.

resolution.zhHans: 世良推断，血迹和鹤的喙不可能出现在同一个位置，除非它们位于盘子的顶部。在阿笠博士翻转托盘之前，血迹指向东北方，而鹤的喙指向西北方。托盘被翻转之后，鹤的喙最终就会指向东北方。结果犯人就是 Motoyuki Tojima。江户川柯南随后推断，犯人不可能是 Chono 或 Sakamaki，因为他们在抬起长矛时会发出声响，并会被 Nishitsu 听到。Tojima 随即说他的助听器出了故障，所以他不可能听到。然而，在此之前他不可能知道助听器的事，除非 Nishitsu 告诉了他，这意味着凶案发生时 Tojima 和 Nishitsu 在一起。
resolution.en: Sera deduces that there is no way the blood and the crane's beak could be at the same spot unless it is at the top of the dish. Before Agasa flipped the tray, the blood was pointing northeast, while the crane's beak was pointing northwest. When it was flipped, then the crane's beak would end up pointing northeast. As a result the culprit is Motoyuki Tojima. Conan then deduces that there is no way the culprit is Chono or Sakamaki because they would’ve made a sound when they lifted the spear and would have been heard by Nishitsu. Tojima then says that his hearing aid had malfunctioned, so he couldn't have heard it. However, there was no way for him to know about the hearing aid before, unless Nishitsu told him, which means Tojima was with Nishitsu when the murder happened.

Conan reveals that Shimizu was the one playing Bito's avatar in order disguise the fact Bito was already dead during the final game.
