motive.quote: Instead of claiming a decisive victory at the finish, Shimizu purposefully caused the match to end in a draw so that his screen would not display that he was the winner and Bito was the loser.

method.quote: Conan reveals that Shimizu was the one playing Bito's avatar in order disguise the fact Bito was already dead during the final game.

evidence.quote: To dispose of the murder weapon, Conan explains Shimizu hid the poisoned needle tip inside a cigarette, and placed the cigarette on a gum wrapper with a piece of chewed gum sandwiched in between.

motive.zhHans: 在收尾时，Shimizu 没有选择干脆取胜，而是故意让比赛打成平手，这样他的屏幕上就不会显示他是赢家、Bito 是输家。由于 Bito 已经死了，Shimizu 只能自己往 Bito 的机器里投币，好开始他们最后一场对局。【动机】Bito 是个常年欠债的赌徒，而 Shimizu 的姐姐一直不停地做工替他还债。Shimizu 与 Bito 约定：只要他在格斗游戏里用 Haido Lucas 打赢 Bito，Bito 就离开他姐姐，并说自己后悔这么做，因为他再也没有机会赢过他。
motive.en: Instead of claiming a decisive victory at the finish, Shimizu purposefully caused the match to end in a draw so that his screen would not display that he was the winner and Bito was the loser. Since Bito was dead, Shimizu himself had to put a coin in Bito's machine in order to start their final match. Motive Bito was a gambler habitually in debt, and Shimizu's sister had worked endlessly trying to pay it off. Shimizu made a deal with Bito that if he beat him in the fighting game as Haido Lucas then Bito would leave his sister and say that he regret doing it since he never get a chance to beat him.

method.zhHans: 柯南指出，在最后那场对局里，操纵 Bito 那个角色的其实是 Shimizu，目的是掩盖 Bito 早已死亡的事实。至于处理凶器，柯南解释说 Shimizu 把涂了毒的针尖藏进一支香烟里，再把那支烟放在一张口香糖包装纸上，中间夹着一块嚼过的口香糖。
method.en: Conan reveals that Shimizu was the one playing Bito's avatar in order disguise the fact Bito was already dead during the final game. To dispose of the murder weapon, Conan explains Shimizu hid the poisoned needle tip inside a cigarette, and placed the cigarette on a gum wrapper with a piece of chewed gum sandwiched in between.

evidence.zhHans: 至于处理凶器，柯南解释说 Shimizu 把涂了毒的针尖藏进一支香烟里，再把那支烟放在一张口香糖包装纸上，中间夹着一块嚼过的口香糖。碰巧是 Dejima 的人会不小心踩到那张纸，把凶器带离现场。决定性证据是 Bito 的游戏机上那枚留有 Shimizu 指纹的硬币。
evidence.en: To dispose of the murder weapon, Conan explains Shimizu hid the poisoned needle tip inside a cigarette, and placed the cigarette on a gum wrapper with a piece of chewed gum sandwiched in between. Someone, who by coincidence happened to be Dejima, would accidentally step on the paper and transport the murder weapon away. The decisive evidence that Shimizu is the culprit is a coin in Bito's arcade machine with Shimizu's fingerprints.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Takayasu Shimizu。在那场对局里，男性角色彻底压制了女性角色，让所有人都以为是高木赢了兰。事实恰恰相反：高木戴上领带当眼罩、套在游戏头盔底下，操作的其实是女性角色。柯南指出，在最后那场对局里，操纵 Bito 那个角色的其实是 Shimizu，目的是掩盖 Bito 早已死亡的事实。在收尾时，Shimizu 没有选择干脆取胜，而是故意让比赛打成平手，这样他的屏幕上就不会显示他是赢家、Bito 是输家。
resolution.en: The culprit is Takayasu Shimizu. In their game, the male character completely overpowers the female character causing everyone to think Takagi had beaten Ran. Instead it was the opposite; Takagi was playing the female character while wearing his tie as a blindfold underneath the game helmet. Conan reveals that Shimizu was the one playing Bito's avatar in order disguise the fact Bito was already dead during the final game. Instead of claiming a decisive victory at the finish, Shimizu purposefully caused the match to end in a draw so that his screen would not display that he was the winner and Bito was the loser.

resolution.en: The culprit is Takuzo Kinbara. On June 10, he and his wife were going to the temple at Wakabadai to attend the second anniversary death of Katsuhiro Doigaki, Tae's younger brother. At the same time, he saw Akira Kisugi. He demanded an apology from Kisugi, as he was responsible for indirectly killing Kisugi for conning him out of his money. The two struggled with each other however Takuzo was distracted after noticing that Esaka had witnessed the two of them. Takuzo immediately recognized Esaka, but he got dragged off by Kisugi into a alleyway. He managed to free himself from Kisugi, but in the process, he pushed Kisugi too hard into a wall. Causing Kisugi to die from receiving a blow to the back of his head. Takuzo later buried his body, thinking that he didn't need to worry about Esaka witnessing him. He was even more relieved when Esaka suddenly disappeared from his neighborhood.

title.zhHans: 群马与长野县交界处的尸体

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Yumi Nakata. Yumi had used a trick to make it look like she was still in her apartment when in reality, she was in the parking lot beating Kazuki Tsukishima to death. Yumi set up a towel on a Ring light and tied a rubber band on the top to mimic her hair bun, she then placed the Ring light on top of a luggage case to match her height.

motive.quote: Kyouko and Senta ask why she killed Kazuki and she reveals that she did it in revenge for him causing the death of Chizu’s mother and for putting Chizu into a coma.

method.quote: Yumi had used a trick to make it look like she was still in her apartment when in reality, she was in the parking lot beating Kazuki Tsukishima to death.

evidence.quote: While a photo revealed that Yumi’s hair was shoulder length, which meant that she did not have enough hair to tie it into a bun.

motive.zhHans: Kyouko 和 Senta 问她为什么杀了 Kazuki，她透露自己这么做是为了报复——他造成了 Chizu 母亲的死亡，并使 Chizu 陷入昏迷。Yumi 得知真相后，故意邀请 Kazuki、Senta 和 Kyouko 到酒店，为复仇而杀死 Kazuki。最终，Taka'aki 没有向 Yamamura 透露他兄弟的死讯，因为毕竟 Hiro 是 Yamamura 的挚友，他希望保留两人目前都在伸张正义的希望。
motive.en: Kyouko and Senta ask why she killed Kazuki and she reveals that she did it in revenge for him causing the death of Chizu’s mother and for putting Chizu into a coma. After Yumi learned the truth, she intentionally invited Kazuki, Senta, and Kyouko to the hotel to kill Kazuki in revenge. In the end, Taka’aki hasn't revealed his brother’s death to Yamamura because, after all, Hiro was a dear friend of Yamamura, and he wants to keep his hope that both of them are currently serving justice.

method.zhHans: Yumi 用了某种手法，让自己看起来仍待在自己的公寓里，而实际上她正在停车场把 Kazuki Tsukishima 打死。Yumi 在环形灯上搭了一条毛巾，并在顶部绑了一根橡皮筋来模仿自己的发髻，然后她把环形灯放在一个行李箱上，以匹配自己的身高。Yumi 用 blackjack 杀死了 Kazuki，做法是把重物放进袜子里，以足以致人死亡的力量挥动它。她用了 Kazuki 的袜子和自己的一个物件来制作 blackjack。柯南问小五郎他对这个手法的解释是否正确。
method.en: Yumi had used a trick to make it look like she was still in her apartment when in reality, she was in the parking lot beating Kazuki Tsukishima to death. Yumi set up a towel on a Ring light and tied a rubber band on the top to mimic her hair bun, she then placed the Ring light on top of a luggage case to match her height. Yumi used a blackjack to kill Kazuki, it involves placing a heavy object into a sock and swinging it with enough force to kill someone. She used Kazuki’s sock and an object of her own to create a blackjack. Conan asking Kogoro if his explanation about the trick is right.

evidence.zhHans: 而一张照片显示 Yumi 的头发是齐肩长度，这意味着她没有足够的头发把它扎成发髻。动机 Uehara 警探问她为什么不干脆丢弃证据，但她狠不下心，因为那个腕部负重是 Chizu Yuba 送给她的。然而，Yumi 觉得奇怪，因为她知道他们有时间救下两个人，却还是失败了。多年后她得知了真相：Chizu 翻看了 Kazuki 的笔记本电脑，发现了他录下的那决定命运的一天的视频。
evidence.en: While a photo revealed that Yumi’s hair was shoulder length, which meant that she did not have enough hair to tie it into a bun. Motive Detective Uehara asks why she didn’t just discard the evidence, but she didn’t have the heart to as the wrist weight was given to her by Chizu Yuba. However, Yumi found it strange as she knew they had enough time to save both of them and yet they failed. Years later she learned the truth, Chizu had been looking around Kazuki’s laptop and found a video that he recorded of that fateful day.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Yumi Nakata。Yumi 用了某种手法，让自己看起来仍待在自己的公寓里，而实际上她正在停车场把 Kazuki Tsukishima 打死。Yumi 在环形灯上搭了一条毛巾，并在顶部绑了一根橡皮筋来模仿自己的发髻，然后她把环形灯放在一个行李箱上，以匹配自己的身高。然后她把一根连着窗帘的绳子系好，把另一端系在她的第一部手机上，并把它放在窗边桌子的边缘。杀害 Kazuki 之后，她用自己的第二部手机拨打第一部手机的号码，这使手机从桌上掉落，把窗帘拉开。这制造了她拉开窗帘向外张望的假象，而这一幕也被监控摄像头拍了下来。
resolution.en: The culprit is Yumi Nakata. Yumi had used a trick to make it look like she was still in her apartment when in reality, she was in the parking lot beating Kazuki Tsukishima to death. Yumi set up a towel on a Ring light and tied a rubber band on the top to mimic her hair bun, she then placed the Ring light on top of a luggage case to match her height. She then tied a string connected to her curtain and attached the other end to her first cellphone and set it on the edge of a table next to the window. After she murdered Kazuki, she dialed the number of her first cellphone with her second one, which caused the phone to fall off the table pulling the curtain open. This gave the illusion that she had opened her curtain to peer outside, which was also captured on the surveillance camera.

title.en: The Boiled Fugu Mystery Tour Showdown
title.ja: てっちり対決ミステリーツアー (Tetchiri Taiketsu Misuterī Tsuā)
title.zhHans: 河豚火锅推理之旅对决

motive.en: He knew that Kobayashi didn't have an alibi on the day of the crime, and anticipated that Kobayashi will probably fabricate an alibi himself since he is on probation, he came up with this plan to make Kobayashi the biggest suspect. Kogoro starts his deductions, told by Conan, he first excludes Kobayashi because he was accused of faking his alibi and was utilized by the culprit. He then precludes Keisuke Ban out of the suspect list because Ban lied, he was actually stalking Kaede so persistently that he was arrested by the police. He tried to attack Kaede but Kaede went to a boxing gym to learn self-defense because of Ban so she defended herself from him and said she should have done it right from the start. The mystery of Kanmon Channel In order to get to Honshu, and implement the crime, the culprit has to go across the Kanmon Channel. Evidences According to Daiehara's medical certificate, it has been two months and fifteen days ever since he broke his leg. Since it is cooked using their heirloom pot, the food must be steeped in the umami flavor, that the Izumiya restaurant owner will recognize.

method.en: He knew that Kobayashi didn't have an alibi on the day of the crime, and anticipated that Kobayashi will probably fabricate an alibi himself since he is on probation, he came up with this plan to make Kobayashi the biggest suspect. Kogoro starts his deductions, told by Conan, he first excludes Kobayashi because he was accused of faking his alibi and was utilized by the culprit. Conan pointed out that from the photo Daiehara sent to Kogoro for his alibi, he was wearing a dive computer on his wrist rather than a normal watch. Since it is cooked using their heirloom pot, the food must be steeped in the umami flavor, that the Izumiya restaurant owner will recognize. And both of them insisted that the dish was cooked using that pot.

evidence.zhHans: 因此，Daiehara 的诊断书可能并非有力的证明。看到真相被揭露，Daiehara 坦白了罪行，并决定毁掉那口锅。
evidence.en: Therefore, Daiehara's medical certificate may not be a vigorous proof. Seeing the truth being revealed, Daiehara confesses and decides to destroy the pot.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Satoru Daiehara。他教唆 Yasushi Kobayashi 在两年前实施了那起盗窃，这样一来，就会给他提供一个合适的动机。他知道 Kobayashi 在案发当天没有不在场证明，并预料到 Kobayashi 因为在缓刑期间，很可能会自己编造一个不在场证明，于是他想出了这个计划，让 Kobayashi 成为最大的嫌疑人。小五郎开始推理，在柯南的提示下，他首先排除了 Kobayashi，因为他被指控伪造不在场证明，并被犯人所利用。然后他把 Keisuke Ban 排除在嫌疑人名单之外，因为 Ban 撒了谎，他实际上一直在纠缠 Kaede，纠缠得太厉害以至于被警察逮捕。Ban 利用了 Kaede 的善良，没有把事情闹到警察那里。他试图袭击 Kaede，但 Kaede 因为 Ban 的缘故去了拳击馆学习防身术，所以她自卫成功，并说早该这么做了。
resolution.en: The culprit is Satoru Daiehara. He instigated Yasushi Kobayashi to commit the theft two years ago, this way, it will offer him a suitable motive. He knew that Kobayashi didn't have an alibi on the day of the crime, and anticipated that Kobayashi will probably fabricate an alibi himself since he is on probation, he came up with this plan to make Kobayashi the biggest suspect. Kogoro starts his deductions, told by Conan, he first excludes Kobayashi because he was accused of faking his alibi and was utilized by the culprit. He then precludes Keisuke Ban out of the suspect list because Ban lied, he was actually stalking Kaede so persistently that he was arrested by the police. Ban took advantage of Kaede kindness not turn it into a police matter. He tried to attack Kaede but Kaede went to a boxing gym to learn self-defense because of Ban so she defended herself from him and said she should have done it right from the start.

title.en: The Bride of Huis ten Bosch
title.ja: ハウステンボスの花嫁 (Hausu Ten Bosu no Hanayome)

summary.en: Sonoko invites Ran and Conan to attend a wedding between Shinya Ooga and Akane Katori at the Huis Ten Bosch, Sasebo, Nagasaki Prefecture. On the way there, the three meet a glass artisan named Junichi Takahashi who accompanies them to the Huis Ten Bosch to the glass museum. Shinya's grandmother, Tae Ooga, impressed by Takahashi's knowledge on glass invites him to dinner with the Ooga family. That night, Shinya's parents offer Akane a heirloom wedding room for the wedding and invite Takahashi to attend the wedding. Before the wedding begins, the ring is found missing and in its place is a picture of Akane with Hydrangea Otakusas in the background.

title.ja: 割れた金魚鉢 (Wareta Kingyobachi)

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Nozomi Makimura. She first killed Kajiura, then killed Tsuchida to hide her murder. Her motive was that Kajiura stopped being nice to her, even though she did a lot for him.

summary.en:
Kogoro was hired by Yoshihiro Tsuchida to protect him, but failed because he is murdered.

Location: Goldfish Investments company

Victim: Yoshihiro Tsuchida

title.ja: 砕けたホロスコープ (Kudaketa Horosucōpu)

He made it a locked room, because he believed that Yuuka had a spare key and wanted her to pin the crime on her by making it appear that she was the only one who could have locked the room.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Kensuke Katsuragi。柯南揭示，Katsuragi 在 Shijo 的房间里与她见面并杀了她。做完这些之后，他拿走她房间的钥匙、把门锁上，再从外面爬到 Shijo 房间顶上，敲裂一小块天花板，把钥匙丢进房里。他把现场弄成密室，是因为他以为 Yuuka 有一把备用钥匙，想借此把罪名栽给她——让一切看起来只有她才能把房间锁上。作为证据，柯南指出：尽管钥匙混在一堆别的钥匙里，Katsuragi 却在第一次就找出了能开那扇门的那把。Katsuragi 回答说，他知道那把挂着蓝宝石钥匙圈的就是这扇门的；柯南揭示，那把钥匙原本挂着一个钻石钥匙圈，而那个钥匙圈现在在小兰手里。这意味着 Katsuragi 是 Shijo 死前最后一个见到她的人。Katsuragi 供认，并揭示丽华曾要求他偿还她的全部投资。警方逮捕 Katsuragi 之后，柯南问小兰想让 Shijo 替她占卜什么，小兰回答：新一现在在哪儿。
resolution.en: The culprit is Kensuke Katsuragi. Conan reveals that Katsuragi met with Shijo in her room and murdered her. After doing so, he took the key to her rooms, locked it, and climbed from the outside to the top of Shijo's room, cracked a small piece of the ceiling, and dropped the keys into the room. He made it a locked room, because he believed that Yuuka had a spare key and wanted her to pin the crime on her by making it appear that she was the only one who could have locked the room. As evidence, Conan reveals that despite the key being mixed in a pile of other keys, Katsuragi was able to find out which key opened the door in his first try. Katsuragi replies that he knew the key with the sapphire keychain was the one for the door; Conan reveals that the key was originally connected to a diamond keychain which is now in Ran's possession. This means that Katsuragi was the last person to meet Shijo before her death. Katsuragi confesses and revealing that Reika was demanded which he repay all of her investments. After the police arrest Katsuragi, Conan asks Ran what she wanted Shijo to read for her to which she replies Shinichi's current whereabouts.

summary.en: Kogoro is invited by Reika Shijo, a famous fortune teller, for an interview. Ran asks Shijo to read her fortune. Shijo tells her she will read it later and gives Ran her room key's diamond keychain as compensation. Later that evening, Shijo's guests realize she has been in her room for far too long. Unable to open her door, they see her through the outside window dead.

suspects: Kensuke Katsuragi, Machio Tamura, Yuuka Shiraishi, and Kurara Midorikawa
suspectsZh: 葛城健介、田村真千夫、白石优香与绿川库拉拉

title.ja: 灰原を狙うカメラ (Haibara o Nerau Kamera)

summary.en: Conan and Haibara were invited to Beika Department Store by the Detective Boys. The aim is the first prize of the lottery held at the bargain venue "Hachijo-jima Whale Watching Tour". Haibara is asked by the doctor to withdraw some cash while she's at it, and heads to the bank's ATM branch. However, just before that, Kogoro's cash card was swallowed by the machine and did not return. When he is about to go to another branch, he sees a suspicious man in a black suit. The man who noticed Haibara had a surprised expression on his face.

title.en: The Candy House the Witch Lives In
title.ja: 魔女の棲むお菓子の家 (Majo no Sumu Okashi no Ie)

summary.en: Sonoko take Ran and Conan to the "Candy House" in the Ecriture. In there, Conan meets a group of three masters who make pastries and puddings: Tsuyoshi Maeda the "Iron Pastry" Chief, Yasuo Fujino the "Prince of Pastries", and Yumi Morimoto the "Candy Magician". They taste the sweets that the three chefs made, which are very delicious. Later, they suddenly hear a scream.

suspects: Tsuyoshi Maeda, Yasuo Fujino, and Yumi Morimoto
suspectsZh: 前田刚、藤野康夫与森本由美

title.ja: 極限のカースタント (Kyokugen no Kā Sutanto)

summary.en: The Detective Boys visit a Kamen Yaiba stunt show. The director, Shinji Fukamachi, and assistant director, Hidehiko Nakasato, scold the stunt driver, Kengo Rikiishi, for doing such a dangerous stunt with the car, a blue 1997 Chevrolet Camaro RS. Kengo blows off their words and has cameraman Daisaku Kijima retake his next shot later. The directors tell Rikiishi that he was to wait for a remote control car identical to his own to do the off the roof scene, which angers Rikiishi and thinks the crew don't respect his skills as a driver. Fukamichi sees the mechanical technician, Masao Nishiwaki, about the readiness of the cars for a retake. The kids go and meet with the crew, and Mitsuhiko and Genta go see the cars. Genta places a sticker on the remote control car to make it look cooler, but the technician comes to take it to the roof. The kids are having fun until they hear a fight. Rikiishi has had enough of the director telling him not to do the stunt again so he does it again in a blind rage, which is caught on film by Kijima. As he makes it to the top, Rikiishi doesn't get out and the car flies off the roof.

suspects: Shinji Fukamachi, Hidehiko Nakasato, Daisaku Kijima, and Masao Nishiwaki
locationsZh: 假面骑士ヤイバ特技秀
suspectsZh: 深町真司、中里秀彦、木岛大作与西胁正夫

title.en: The Case On the Opposite Shore
title.ja: 対岸の事件 (Taigan no Jiken)

summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are watching birds, but Conan proposes another game to them called "human watching". While teaching the Detective Boys how the game works, trying to determine people's jobs and occupations by watching them, they stumble upon detectives Takagi and Chiba apparently on a stakeout.

title.en: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary
title.ja: 歩美の絵日記事件簿 (Ayumi no Enikki Jiken-bo)

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Yuji Fujioka. He digs an underground tunnel from Ogino's shop while Masako and her family are having holiday at Hawaii. The digging sound is hidden by renovation sound at Cafe Haronbo. After five days, he managed to steal the watch, but then got caught by Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys. Later, he is arrested by Takagi.

summary.en: One day, Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are walking to school, when they notice Sadaharu Nishimura, Masako Ogino, and Yuji Fujioka admiring an expensive watch displayed at Kaneko Jewelry Store. The watch itself is only one of five produced around the world.

suspects: Keita Kaneko, Sadaharu Nishimura, Masako Ogino, Yuji Fujioka, and Kumazawa Construction employees
suspectsZh: 金子圭太、西村贞治、荻野雅子、藤冈勇二与熊泽建设员工

title.en: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 2
title.ja: 歩美の絵日記事件簿2(ツー) (Ayumi no Enikki Jiken-bo Tsū)

summary.en: Conan, Agasa, and the Detective Boys are on the way home, when Ayumi notice a crowd surrounding a building. There is a light flashing repeatedly from the building, making a morse code for "SOS". They then decide to look inside the building.

title.en: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 3
title.ja: 歩美の絵日記事件簿3(スリー) (Ayumi no Enikki Jiken-bo Surī)

summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys went shopping, and suddenly, they heard a scream from the "Tanning Salon Kurosawa". This is how Ayumi's third illustrated diary began. Everyone sallied forth into the salon, and they saw Yasuo Tsunoda, who was in a panic. When Conan enquired him what the matter was, he pointed out that one of the customers of this salon, Shin Nishitani, was dead inside room number nine, which was the third room from the back.

suspects: Yasuo Tsunoda, Masaru Ozawa, and Takeshi Nagano
suspectsZh: 角田康夫、小泽胜与永野武

title.en: The Case of Ayumi's Illustrated Diary 4
title.ja: 歩美の絵日記事件簿4(フォー) (Ayumi no Enikki Jiken-Bo Fō)

summary.en:
In Ayumi's illustrated diary, the events that took place were recorded as follows:

On May 29, the Detective Boys, Conan, and Haibara played cops and robbers in the cloudy weather.

On May 30, the professor took the Detective Boys to visit the aquarium in the cloudy weather.

The person's name is Kaoru Sasamori and she fell down a flight of stone stairways. It happened three months ago when four people were at the funeral of Kaoru Sasamori. The four people were Takashi Sasamori (Kaoru's older brother), Hikari Tsuge (Kaoru's ex-lover), Mariko Noguchi (Tsuge's manager), and Kazumi Ishikura (Kaoru's friend). It started when Takashi angrily accused Tsuge to be the murderer who pushed Kaoru down the stairs, claiming that he saw him do it. Tsuge denied every word what Takashi said, he claiming that he did not kill Kaoru. Noguchi tried to stop the argument, saying that he police already investigated and determined that it was a misunderstanding. Back in the present, Kogoro is going to Tsuge's house because this morning, Tsuge contacted to Kogoro saying that he would reveal who really killed Kaoru.

When they got there to examine the circumstances, they saw a security guard lying on the pavement, struggling with weak vitality but still alive. Apparently, he fell off the big staircase that was above him. His motive is that years ago, Inspector Yamato and his companions's mistakes led to a serial killer terrorizing Nagano before being shot dead, and one of his victims was Detective Akiyama's beloved middle school-aged sister, Tsuyako Aburakawa, who was his only relative. His chosen name Bishamonten was his selfperception as a punisher of evildoers.

motive.en: In order to complete this inner circle, they were looking for new members; hence they also attempted to recruit Inspector Yamato, whose name as akin to Shingen's general Yamamoto Kansuke. The reason why Detective Akiyama targeted the Takeda Squad for extermination was that the Squad/Society members seized and sold confiscated guns to criminal elements in order to line their pockets, and it was one of these guns which killed Tsuyako. Detective Akiyama targeted Inspector Yamato because it was his drug-addicted friend who fired the fatal shot. Attempted Murder Location: Place of the hideout of the wanted robber Victim: Kansuke Yamato Attack types: Shooting Culprit: Shinsuke Akiyama While he was caught, he fired three bullets at him, but he used a riot shield to protect himself.

method.zhHans: 他用Takeda警部毫无生气的尸体（他先将其勒死，随后斩首）作诱饵伪造自己的死亡，并且还打算杀死Saegusa警部和Yamato警部。杀人未遂地点：被通缉强盗的藏身处；被害人：Kansuke Yamato；攻击方式：枪击；犯人：Shinsuke Akiyama。在他被抓住时，他朝他开了三枪，但他用防暴盾保护了自己。他在与Yamato对峙时被捕，因为事实证明Kuroda早已对Akiyama起疑，而他下达的命令（把Yamato标记为最大嫌疑人）是假的，意在迷惑Akiyama并把他引出来。
method.en: He faked his own death using Inspector Takeda's lifeless body (whom he first strangled, then he decapitated) as a decoy, and was aiming to kill Inspectors Saegusa and Yamato too. She explains that a male budgerigar's cere is blue while a female's is brown, yet Chichi's became brown. Yuka also notes Chichi looks smaller than usual. Haibara reveals that Sakaguchi bought a substitute pet for Yuka since Chichi is missing. The next day, the Detective Boys question Sakaguchi on Chichi's whereabouts. Sakaguchi explains that he found Chichi dead in its cage, so he replaced the bird as not to sadden Yuka about its death.

They were welcomed by Saburo and Yoshimoto, the maid. They were then informed about the head of the family, Otaguro, who have had early encounters of a ghost that appeared like a yellow glowing light. Just after, the mysterious glowing light in question appeared and frightened the Detective Boys and it was interrupted by the arrival of Hideto Amemiya who led them visit his lab and explained them the past accident of the late Mrs. Otaguro.

summary.en: Conan, Haibara, the Detective Boys and the married couple Akari Haga and Akito Haga are fixing the traditional house when Akari notices the strange stains at the wall near her husband, so he decides to touch it with his trowel, breaking it easily for some reason. This catches the attention of the kids as the Detective Boys assume there must be a treasure inside the wall. However, to everyone’s horror, the content inside the wall is the corpse of a woman. While the police are investigating, Conan notices that the corpse was wearing pajamas before she died, so he and his friends begin asking the couple about the house but it yields no result since nothing much about the former owner is revealed.

summary.en: Kogoro and Conan this time encountered a client named Kanoko Kon. Whereupon they visited her residence with a great extent of curiosity. After entering the house, Kogoro scrutinised the interior and noticed a row of trophies aligned side-by-side. Beside the rightmost trophy there was also a photo of Sakurada Sakura, who is an idol jockey that belonged to Kon Corporation, the company which Kanoko's husband owned. Instinctually, Kogoro fiddled with the heavy trophies but then stopped his behaviour after hearing Kanoko's voice kicking in upstairs. After some customary greetings, Kanoko praised the refinement of Kogoro's new suit; Kogoro boasted that he had just purchased it yesterday at the Beika Department Store.

He peeks into the room and see's a man named Takao Goto and a woman named Yuka Tsuchida arguing. Apparently Yuka is angry that Goto invited Sonoko as she thinks he wants to ditch her for Sonoko. As he apparently fixes everything up with her he leaves. She starts kicking the lockers saying, "Don't you dare leave me!" Meanwhile, Ran is looking for Conan where she meets one of the spectators named Fumihiro Azuma, who tells her he went to the restroom. Goto collapses in the middle of the match due to poisoning and is rushed to the hospital. Who is the culprit?

She had admired Misuzu as an actress and always tried to please her, but despite everything she did, it was never enough. The last straw was when she overheard the victim planning to take her out of the will.

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are watching the ending of an old movie staring retired actress Misuzu Shirakawa at her home. As the trio tour the home with the actress, her three children, and the maid, they are surprised to witness consistent quarreling in the household with Misuzu Shirakawa being the unpleasant one. As the afternoon draws close, the actress retires to her bedroom for an afternoon nap. Soon after, a car accident occurs outside, and then smoke emerges from the bedroom.

At the same time, a serial arsonist has been spotted near the areas of the camp. While at the camp, the students disappear with their puppets, leaving the Detective Boys alone. Mitsuhiko assumes that their teacher is the serial arsonist. After they disappear, even Conan is caught too, only Mitsuhiko remains alone.

summary.en: The Detective Boys are walking to a beauty salon, because Ayumi wants to get a haircut from her favorite hairdresser. However, they see her hairdresser, Mika Mitsui, arguing with the owner of the salon, Midori Goto, an argument that gets heated. Mitsui wants to leave the salon, and join a different one. However, the owner keeps begging for her to stay, because she believes that the hairdresser is the best one in the salon. Mitsui tells Ayumi that even though she is leaving the salon, that she can still get her hair done anytime she wants. She tells Ayumi to visit her apartment on Saturday morning, to get her hair done. The next Saturday, the Detective Boys go to the hairdresser's apartment, but find that she has been murdered.

title.ja: 残念でやさしい宇宙人 (Zannen de Yasashii Uchūjin?)
title.zhHans: 令人失望又善良的外星人

summary.en: One night, two office workers named Arisa Nakashima and Susanne Trümpelmann are on their way home when they suddenly meet what appears to be an alien appearing at the lower end of a set of stairs leading down from an abandoned temple. The two women are frightened, but then the alien announces, "We are extraterrestrials", while tapping its throat, and asks them to take a picture of him and publicize it. Amused by this proposition, the two women cheerfully agree to this and pose for a picture and even a video clip with Nakashima's smartphone. Suddenly, they hear a man yelling in fear, "It's an alien!", and then the body of a man comes tumbling down the stairs from above. As it comes to rest at the bottom and the frightened women and their extraterrestrial friend gather around it, the "alien" reveals himself to be a costumed man.

Conan asked Kazuma's neighbor, Takashi Kiyose if he noticed something strange about Kazuma and at the same time, another neighbor named Akio Nashida suddenly burst out after hearing noise and claimed that he didn't know. When Conan got back to the house, he felt that someone is watching them and asked Funako if the notebook was the reason why she couldn't go to the police. Funako then gave the notebook to Conan and he immediately read what was inside the notebook. It was titled "Crime Plan", containing an article about how to rob a particular place.

On the way there, they learn from Shizuka Kamiyama, a nun in a local temple and a very vocal opponent to the ropeway project, that everyone angering or disrespecting the goddess through the centuries has paid an enormous price, and that Eizo's company will not be an exception. Her words are not taken with complete seriousness, but during the ride through the ropeway right after the opening ceremony, Domoto disappears from the ropeway cart, and is later found dead on the goddess' hand.

When the group plus Ran, Conan and Naoko's father, Katsuhiko Takei, approach the van, however, the kidnapper panics and drives the van into the sea itself, killing both Naoko and themself. It turns out Naoko was a classmate of Shinichi and Ran, and as Megure asks Ran about her, Conan thinks of how she was an awkward and quiet "lonely rich kid".

title.en: The Fearful Legend of the Snowy Night
title.ja: 雪の夜の恐怖伝説 (Yuki no Yoru no Kyōfu Densetsu)

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Hatsuho Hojo. After that, he shows a picture that shows Hatsuho, when she was a graduated highschool student in sailor suit, and her father, who is revealed to be Keiichi Saegusa, the president of Saegusa industries who committed suicide.

motive.quote: Since she couldn't see the katana from her position, it means that the culprit is left-handed.

method.quote: When they first saw it, they jumped to the conclusion that it was used only as a weapon.

evidence.quote: Conan stuns Kogoro and said that on Genichiro's murder, the culprit attempt to cover his tracks with the footprint technique he explained earlier, but in that case anyone other than Tatsuko, who saw the armor could have done it.

motive.zhHans: 由于从她的位置看不到那把刀，说明犯人是左撇子。她本打算第二天再处理掉，因为那时没有别人会用厨房；但小兰最后进来帮她冲咖啡，那个机会就没了。他一向笑着接下大門工业提出的无理要求，因为双方是多年的生意伙伴。社长卖掉了铠甲来筹钱给员工发薪。在东京工作时，她改了名字，并住进源一郎的家，这样既能替父亲了却遗憾，也能在父亲忌日这天完成复仇。
motive.en: Since she couldn't see the katana from her position, it means that the culprit is left-handed. She intended to dispose of them the next day, since no one else would be using the kitchen, but Ran ended up coming in to help her with the coffee, so the opportunity to do so was lost. He accepted unreasonable orders from Daimon Industries with a smile, since they had been trading partners for ages. The CEO sold the armor to raise money to pay his employees. When she was working in Tokyo, she changed her name and began to live on Genichiro's house so that she could absolve her father of his regret and so that she could have her revenge on the anniversary of her father's death.

method.zhHans: 他们第一次看到它时，就直接断定它只是被当作武器使用。它还有一个特别阴险的用途：把音响室变成密室。犯人杀死一树之后，给他穿上铠甲，再把刀插进门边的墙里。接着，他们把刀的另一端搭在门把上，然后缓慢而稳妥地退出房间，不让刀倒下，并借门关上的力量让刀把门闩推上——密室就这样完成了。他们知道没人有力气打开上了死闩的门，也知道硬把门撞开会令刀掉到地上、暴露手法——至少犯人是这么想的。她本打算第二天再处理掉，因为那时没有别人会用厨房；但小兰最后进来帮她冲咖啡，那个机会就没了。
method.en: When they first saw it, they jumped to the conclusion that it was used only as a weapon. It had another particularly sneaky purpose: to turn the audio room into a locked room. After the culprit killed Kazuki, they dressed him in the armor, then stabbed the katana into the wall near the door. Then, with the other end of the katana they rested it upon the door handle, then slowly but surely exited the room without letting the katana fall and used the force of the closing door to make the katana bolt the lock with this the sealed room was complete. They knew that no one would have the strength to open the dead-bolted door and they also knew that trying to break the door down would cause the katana to fall to the floor, leaving the trick would unexposed or so the culprit thought. She intended to dispose of them the next day, since no one else would be using the kitchen, but Ran ended up coming in to help her with the coffee, so the opportunity to do so was lost.

evidence.zhHans: 柯南麻醉了小五郎，指出在源一郎那起命案中，犯人试图用他先前讲过的足迹手法掩盖行踪；但若真如此，除见过铠甲的辰子之外，其他人也都有可能作案。他们第一次看到它时，就直接断定它只是被当作武器使用。然而那把刀并不只是一种武器。犯人利用了传说，留下那些巨大的脚印，让人以为唯一的嫌疑人只有那位铠甲武士，从而骗他们相信是一树杀了源一郎、随后自杀。
evidence.en: Conan stuns Kogoro and said that on Genichiro's murder, the culprit attempt to cover his tracks with the footprint technique he explained earlier, but in that case anyone other than Tatsuko, who saw the armor could have done it. When they first saw it, they jumped to the conclusion that it was used only as a weapon. However, the katana wasn't just a weapon. The culprit took advantage of the legend and left those large footprints to make it seem as though the only possible culprit was the armored warrior, and fool them into believing Kazuki killed Genichiro and committed suicide shortly thereafter.

resolution.zhHans: 柯南麻醉了小五郎，指出在源一郎那起命案中，犯人试图用他先前讲过的足迹手法掩盖行踪；但若真如此，除见过铠甲的辰子之外，其他人也都有可能作案。最可能的情况是：杀死源一郎之后，犯人身上溅到了血。然而铠甲和一树的衣服上都没有血迹。犯人杀死源一郎之后，又进到音响室杀了一树。
resolution.en: Conan stuns Kogoro and said that on Genichiro's murder, the culprit attempt to cover his tracks with the footprint technique he explained earlier, but in that case anyone other than Tatsuko, who saw the armor could have done it. Most likely, after killing Genichiro, the culprit was splattered with blood. However, neither the armor nor Kazuki's clothes have been stained. After the culprit killed Genichiro, they came into the audio room and killed Kazuki.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Shunichi Morishita。证据就是他衬衫上的颜料污渍。他衬衫上污渍的颜色，与他用在立体模型上的机器人颜色并不相符，那些机器人用的是非常鲜艳的颜色。但污渍的颜色却与展出的立体模型的颜色相符。Morishita 透露，Kitajima 强迫 Morishita 为他制作模型。他的母亲生了病，他向 Kitajima 借了钱。但由于 Kitajima 高得离谱的利息，Morishita 的债务不断膨胀，无力偿还。至于凶器，是一把事先涂成自然浅绿色的刀，被藏在房间里的花束中。他所使用的颜料就在他的颜料盒里。
resolution.en: The culprit is Shunichi Morishita. The proof was the paint smudges on his shirt. The colors of the smudges on his shirt didn't match the colors of his robots used in the diorama, which used very vivid colors. But it did match the colors of the diorama on display. Morishita reveals that Kitajima forced Morishita to make models for him. His mother was sick, and he borrowed money from Kitajima. But because of Kitajima's outrageous interest, Morishita's debt inflated and he couldn't repay it. As for the weapon, it was a knife painted in natural light green he had prepared in advance, and hidden in a bouquet in the room. The color paint he had used was in his paint case.

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Minoru Furuhashi. He used the projector to create his alibi. First, he asked Yuriko to buy tea for him so she wouldn’t be there at the time of the murder. Then, he adjusted the air conditioner so that the corpse would be swinging as if he had just died.

motive.quote: Then, he adjusted the air conditioner so that the corpse would be swinging as if he had just died.

method.quote: He used the projector to create his alibi.

evidence.quote: The evidence is in Toshiyuki‘s camera.

method.zhHans: 他利用放映机为自己制造不在场证明。之后，他开始实施镜面错觉的诡计：他用镜子把原本从左窗射入的光（他吊起被害人的那扇窗）改为从右窗投射出去。布置好这套镜面错觉后，他下到放映厅杀死 Seiji，趁影片正从另一扇窗放映时把尸体吊在左窗之前。这样一来，即使影子出现，他也会和 Yuriko 待在同一间房里，从而保住自己的不在场证明。
method.en: He used the projector to create his alibi. After that, he began the mirror illusion trick. He used mirrors so that the light coming from the left window, which was where he hung the victim, would instead be projected from the right window. After setting that mirror illusion, he went down to the theater, killed Seiji, and hung him in front of the left window while the movie was playing from the other window. That way, even when the shadow appeared, he and Yuriko would be in the same room together and would sustain his alibi.

evidence.zhHans: 证据在 Toshiyuki 的相机里。
evidence.en: The evidence is in Toshiyuki‘s camera.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Minoru Furuhashi。他利用放映机为自己制造不在场证明。首先，他请 Yuriko 去替他买茶，好让她在案发时不在场。接着，他调整空调，使尸体看起来像刚断气那样摇晃。
resolution.en: The culprit is Minoru Furuhashi. He used the projector to create his alibi. First, he asked Yuriko to buy tea for him so she wouldn’t be there at the time of the murder. Then, he adjusted the air conditioner so that the corpse would be swinging as if he had just died.

resolution.en: Nagisa is first shown to be 35 years old, and not 25. Through Kogoro, Conan then reveals that this is a murder case disguised as an accident; the culprit is Kaishiro Imaoka. The proof is Nagisa's half-finished pedicure, indicating she hadn't planned to surf, and the strangle mark under her wetsuit: she wore the suit after her death. Kaishiro protests that a corpse lacks the strength to wear a wetsuit (due to the suit's tightness), and Kogoro (Conan's voice) has the police demonstrate the trick with plastic bags on a volunteer's feet. He explains that the bags reduce friction, making it easy to slip on a wetsuit. Ran then brings forth a box containing two similar bags with stains matching Nagisa's pedicure. Conan goes on to explain that after killing his wife, Kaishiro buried her in the sand, later bringing her to the edge of the waves with cardboard 'treads': cardboard stuck together at the ends he used much like a hamster's wheel, allowing him to leave no tracks as he carried Nagisa's corpse. summary.en: The sun sets, filling the sky with a beautiful array of colors. Everything begins from a refrigerated warehouse. Kenzo Aizawa, the president of the company "Aizawa Foods" is inspecting the products inside the warehouse as usual. Simultaneously, a person, who is wearing a yellow hoodie, and possesses a peculiar hairstyle, surreptitiously enters the warehouse, moving cautiously towards the front door. He opens the door accordingly, a bright light with a rather strong intensity kicks in, illuminating the dim warehouse. Kenzo subconsciously covers his eye, he is absolutely gobsmacked. The mysterious man approaches him closer and closer, Kenzo suddenly collapses, and slumps to the ground.

summary.en: On an idly day, near the pavement located next to a shrine, the stick repeatedly danced upon the drum, which created a sound reverberating around the whole street, lacing with a melancholy melody that came out of a clarinet. The Detective Boys were deeply attracted by the graceful music and followed behind the three music players. The three folks led them towards a newly opened candy shop nearby, and they seemed to be the staff responsible for celebrating it. The emaciated man, wearing a purple kimono decided to hand the Detective Boys a plum for each of them, in order to commemorate this jubilant day. Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko all claimed that they had never seen anything like this plum before. After the three of them tasted it, they were all astonished by the luscious flavour of it. While Conan did not impersonate the others, he gazed at the plum in his hand, and looked rather dejected. Genta then questioned Conan about whether he was looking down at candies, yet Conan denied it, and remarked mercilessly, "It's just that candy for kids." then just put the plum inside his pockets. Genta got fairly piqued after hearing Conan's thoughts, and told Conan that he ought not pretend to be a grownup. Mitsuhiko also echoed, stating that people like Conan are being classified as arrogant. Although Conan kept declining being arrogant, Genta started a quarrel with Conan about it. Finally, suppressing his anger, Conan walked off.

motive.zhHans: 他是唯一有可能犯下这起谋杀的人，因为凶手是有段位的剑道选手，故意把裙甲反过来穿，让人以为是不懂剑道的人所为，而这正符合 Norimura 的特征。实际上，“cutter”这个词是关西腔，意思是衬衫。真相揭晓：Nukitani 正在和妻子通电话，让她再送一件衬衫过来，因为他那件已经染血了——因为在先前 Okita 参加的一场比赛中，对手把 Nukitani 推得太用力，导致他流了鼻血。服部平次（Heiji）取笑江户川柯南（Conan），因为破案的人是他。Norimura 使用竹刀，是因为他想用儿子的刀为儿子复仇。结果他被取消资格，输掉了比赛。他深感内疚，觉得自己仅仅因为一个小小的失误就让整所学校失望了。尽管心烦意乱，他起初认为那起自杀没有什么可怨恨裁判 Nukitani 的，但是，在比赛中，他看到 Nukitani 无视了东都身心高中（Tohto Senshin High School）一名学生做出的胜利姿势。他随后上前与他交谈，发现他因为两人都来自关西而有所偏袒，这让他产生了杀死 Nukitani 的念头。
motive.en: He is the only one who could've committed the murder since the culprit was a ranked swordsman who deliberately put the skirt backwards to make people think it was someone who didn't know kendo and it matched Norimura's description. In fact, the word "cutter" was in Kansai Dialect and it meant a dress shirt, it is revealed that Nukitani was talking to his wife on the phone and asking her to bring him another dress shirt since his' was bloody because, in a previous match where Okita was participating, his opponent pushed Nukitani so hard his nose bled. Heiji laughs at Conan since he was the one who solved it. Norimura used a bamboo sword because he wanted to use his son's sword to avenge him. As a result he was disqualified and lost the match, he felt such guilt because he had felt like he had let his entire school down all because of one simple mistake. Although distraught, He first thought that his suicide was not anything to have a grudge against the referee, Nukitani, but, In the tournament, he saw that Nukitani ignored the victory pose done by a student of Tohto Senshin High School. He then went to talk with him and he had showed favoritism since they were both from Kansai which made him want to kill Nukitani.

method.en: The weapon was in fact his bamboo sword in which he used to make a sharp weapon by taking a single piece of bamboo and sharpened it and then swung it horizontally so the centrifugal force could cut someone's throat. Norimura used a bamboo sword because he wanted to use his son's sword to avenge him.

evidence.zhHans: 实际上，“cutter”这个词是关西腔，意思是衬衫。真相揭晓：Nukitani 正在和妻子通电话，让她再送一件衬衫过来，因为他那件已经染血了——因为在先前 Okita 参加的一场比赛中，对手把 Nukitani 推得太用力，导致他流了鼻血。凶器其实是他的竹刀。他取一节竹子，将其削尖，做成一件锋利的武器，然后水平挥动，利用离心力割开他人的喉咙。人们在洗手间听到的声音，其实是 Norimura 在墙上把刀尖磨钝，这意味着证据（血迹）很容易被发现卡在他刀袋的内侧。

The weapon was in fact his bamboo sword in which he used to make a sharp weapon by taking a single piece of bamboo and sharpened it and then swung it horizontally so the centrifugal force could cut someone's throat. The sound people heard in the bathroom was in fact Norimura dulling the tip against the wall which meant that the proof (blood) will be easily found stuck in the inside of his sword bag.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Nenji Norimura。他是唯一有可能犯下这起谋杀的人，因为凶手是有段位的剑道选手，故意把裙甲反过来穿，让人以为是不懂剑道的人所为，而这正符合 Norimura 的特征。就在服部平次（Heiji）讲解自己的推理时，远山和叶（Kazuha）和大阪的学校队伍正设法寻找平次，于是她打电话给毛利兰（Ran），好让她们在比赛开始前赶回去，但兰没有接电话。
resolution.en: The culprit is Nenji Norimura. He is the only one who could've committed the murder since the culprit was a ranked swordsman who deliberately put the skirt backwards to make people think it was someone who didn't know kendo and it matched Norimura's description. As Heiji explains his deduction, Kazuha and the Osaka school's team try to find Heiji so she tries to call Ran so they can return before the match begins but Ran skips the call.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Junko Hirose。作案前，她在七点去拜访 Atsuro，八点离开，为自己制造不在场证明，随后杀害了 Masaru。在作案时间，她匆忙赶往 Tonkoro 实施犯罪。真正的作案时间是 9:00。她把时间重设为 8:00，好让人以为他是在那个时间被杀的。按原计划，本应由 Katsui 杀死 Hirose，但未能得手。她布置好了局面，使得自己在最初被捕时能让 Atsuro 为她提供不在场证明，因为她曾去过他的家。她知道他不会出面指证，而且由于日本刑法相对宽松，加上这是她的初次犯罪，她只会服相当短的刑期。刑满出狱后，她就能当着他妻子的面与他对质，责怪他让她替罪，这会把他暴露成妻子面前一个说谎的懦夫。这本会是她给那个为了别的女人而抛弃她的男人的残酷的“最后的礼物”。具有讽刺意味的是，正如柯南所指出的，最终结果是一样的，因为一旦媒体揭露此事，Atsuro 的未婚妻和她的父亲就会得知真相，了解他那真正无耻、贪图钱财的本性。
resolution.en: The culprit is Junko Hirose. Before the crime, she visited Atsuro at seven and left at eight to make an alibi before killing Masaru. In the time of the crime, she hurriedly goes to Tonkoro to commit the crime. The time of the crime was really 9:00. She reset the time to 8:00, to make it look that he was killed at that time. Supposedly, Katsui was supposed to kill Hirose, but failed. She set up the situation so that Atsuro could've given her an alibi upon her initial arrest, considering that she had gone to his home. She knew that he wouldn't come forward, and because of Japan's relatively lax penal code and the fact that it was her first offense she would serve a fairly short sentence. After she got out, she'd be able to confront him in front of his wife for letting her take the fall, which would've exposed him as a lying coward in front of his wife. This would've been her cruel "last gift" to the man who abandoned her for another woman. Ironically, as noted by Conan, the end result was the same, as once the press revealed the story, Atsuro's fiancé and her father would learn truth about his true shameless and gold-digging nature.

resolution.en: The culprit is Masayo Aoshima. She killed her little sister and roommate Mina after, for several years, she copied and imitated her in everything; at first she found it cute and funny, but later she thought it was disturbing, and then she snapped when Mina told her she and Kenji, her ex boyfriend, were dating, and she said it in a tone that was the last straw. At first, Masayo's plan was to lock Mina in a makeshift poisoned/locked room with a poured bathroom cleaner as the improvised 'weapon', expecting Mina to die of asphixiation. The cleaner was too soft, however; therefore Masayo knocked her victim out, filled the tub with water and slit Mina's wrist, placing her injured arm inside the water so she'd bleed out faster. Then she left Mina's corpse and got ready to leave to the Yoko concert, using Kogoro as her alibi.

method.en: The Kanbayashis merely pretended to be happily married, but their life together has long since gone to shambles, and they have become interested in different partners. While on the works to provide his alibi for his wife's murder, however, Seiko (with the intention to carry out her own murder plan) arrived early, spotted Chosaku behaving strangely, and realised what he was up to. Seiko returned later and pretended - with the doorman of Chosaku's office building as her alibi witness - to be the first discoverer.

summary.en: Kogoro is invited by the manager of a theater to investigate strange occurrences. While Conan goes off to investigate on his own, he overhears Hiroshi Komazuka, one of the main actors, plan on switching a fake rapier with a real one to murder Robert Banno, another main actor, in the sword fight scene of the play. As they have breakfast, an issue seems to be happening with Amuro's cake. Last night when he prepared it, it was perfect but this morning it has melted. The Detective Boys call Conan using the Detective Badge informing him of Agasa's latest invention, a drone. While the communication is taking place, the rotors of the drone suddenly start spinning and it flies and crashes into the roof causing Agasa to be disappointed. He goes inside to fix the drone. The Detective Boys search for him until they go to the loading deck and see Genta in a van gagged and attached by two mysterious kidnappers. They run after it and just got by Yumi and Naeko's mini-patrol car and tell them to follow the truck since Genta is inside and has been kidnapped. Luckily, they are able to follow the truck with Conan's criminal tracking glasses and Genta's detective boys' badge. They were almost at the car's location when they found out it was stuck in a traffic jam. Yumi decides to use her megaphone to make all the cars move and then yells from her location to the kidnappers who understand they were followed and run away with the van with the mini-car chasing after not far away but, at a railway crossing, they get separated from the van so Conan uses his badge to contact Genta who had taken off the tape covering his mouth but, the kidnappers heard their conversation and break Genta's badge.

According to Takako, they have been married for four years, and she described her husband as an earnest man. Takako brought a box with her husband's belongings to the detective agency to serve as clues. There were some business cards of Hiroshi's, three framed photos, and a computer he used. The first photo was taken during their honeymoon; the second photo was taken when Hiroshi went diving some time ago; the third photo was taken within the family. As Takako explained in her note, the man who was standing beside her husband when diving was his coworker, Nishimura. And the man who appeared in the family photo was his younger brother, Ryu. When Kogoro opened Hiroshi's computer, he saw that the background wallpaper was a bunch of sharks. And when he went through the browser history, what he found were an online cruiser store, luxury cars, luxury watches, and cottages with an aquarium. After knowing some information related to Hiroshi, Kogoro decided to start the investigation at least.

Suddenly he hears a woman shrieking at the sight of someone falling off the top of a roof, directly down towards a man standing in a street at the building's side. Reacting quickly, Conan uses his Power Shoes and Ball Dispenser Belt to kick the falling man off his downward path, right into a nearby dumpster, where he makes a soft landing. However, the man is totally intoxicated and unconscious, so he remains completely unaware of what has happened to him. Due to the account of a witness, the man - by the name of Sadao Fukurokoji - evidently wanted to commit suicide because in his drunken state he had babbled out that things were not going according to his desires at his company.

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are waiting for their reservation at Riyu Stream Restaurant, a highly popular traditional Japanese restaurant of Blowfish Milt. While Kogoro is frustrated of waiting and being hungry, Conan looks around and sees computer controlled, miniature boats carrying food along a waterway. Anzai, the restaurant cashier, tells Conan that after the boats reach the guests' rooms, they push a button and the boat returns automatically. Kaneda and Arai, faculty of Joumon University, enter the restaurant to celebrate Kaneda's new employment as assistant professor of physics. Anzai knows that a person called Kaneda reserved room #8, which Kaneda denies after Arai asks him about it. Their professor, Iwama, comes out to meet them and remarks on how late they are. Arai wants Kaneda to apologize for delaying them since Iwama planned this event. Kaneda brushes this off rudely and Arai is offended, to which Kaneda tells Arai to address him formally: as assistant professor. They leave for the room Iwama made the reservation in, which is room #3, after Kaneda orders the most expensive thing on the menu: blowfish milt. Conan, Ran, and Kogoro go to room #2 when the time for their reservation comes and Conan notices Kaneda leaving room #3. During their meal, Kogoro enjoys his wine and Conan is pleased with the food, but the dinner is interrupted when they hear a woman scream. They rush to the scene to see Anzai terrified by Kaneda's body with a knife in his chest.

method.en: With the help of string with a loop and a bit of cellotape, the culprit can create a locked room murder. The string is pulled outside and the room, because the door at the entrance was also locked, is assumed to be a locked room. Heiji told them that Sakuraba ran away using the balcony. He get down to the next floor using it. He can also climb a tree with ease so it would be easy for him to ran away using the balcony. Heiji and Conan fake him out by stating Sakuraba is the criminal, and have Kikuhito recover the bundle of murder discovered by Heiji and Conan eairlier. The trick explained earlier was not really used. Actually, there were no tricks used, since, in reality, Kikuhito was there in the room all the time. He also switched the lights off and dragged the body from one room to another, leaving a bloody trail. After that, Kikuhito came out from behind the curtains and joined the people who had gathered at the scene while pretending to be innocent. He put the cat in the room so as to make Sakuraba's alibi fragile.

resolution.zhHans: 平次和柯南开始推理。他们指出犯人就是 Sakuraba。借助一根带环的绳子和一点透明胶带，犯人就能制造出密室杀人。Sakuraba 打 Kikuhito 时，打碎了尸体后方窗户上的玻璃。那扇窗上还有一个小孔。首先，他把绳环固定在窗锁上，把碎玻璃片装回去，再把绳子从孔里穿出。接着，他带着未上锁的窗户走到阳台，轻轻拉绳，让锁稍微向左滑动，把窗户锁上。然后他加大力气拉，使绳子从胶带上脱落。绳子是从屋外拉动的，而由于入口的门也锁着，这间房便被认为是密室。Sakuraba 打 Kikuhito，是为了让他撞上窗户、打碎玻璃，好让证据消失。平次告诉大家，Sakuraba 是从阳台逃走的。他利用阳台下到下一层。Mikio 腿上有伤，做不到这一点；Kaede 和 Yurie 穿的衣服也不适合这么做；至于 Kikuhito，他极度怕高。只剩一个人，那就是 Sakuraba。他还能轻松地爬上树，所以借阳台逃走对他并不困难。平次随后指出，Sakuraba 和 Kaede 其实是一对秘密恋人。他还揭示，Sakuraba 无法原谅 Shigematsu 安排 Kaede 与 Kikuhito 的婚事，因此杀了他。至于证据，平次找到了一件沾满血迹的衬衫，那件衬衫是 Sakuraba 的。Sakuraba 很快被捕。不过凶器至今下落不明。
resolution.en: Heiji and Conan start their deduction. They revealed that the culprit is Sakuraba. With the help of string with a loop and a bit of cellotape, the culprit can create a locked room murder. When Sakuraba hit Kikuhito, he broke some glass off the window behind the body. The window has also a small hole. First, he fastened the loop to the window's lock, put the broken piece back, and pull the string through it. Then, he went to the balcony with the window unlocked and pulled the string gently so the lock slides to the left slightly and locking the window. Then, he pulled the string harder so the string is undone from the tape. The string is pulled outside and the room, because the door at the entrance was also locked, is assumed to be a locked room. Sakuraba hit Kikuhito so that he would hit the window and break the glass so the evidence would disappear. Heiji told them that Sakuraba ran away using the balcony. He get down to the next floor using it. It is impossible for Mikio to do that because he has a hurt leg. Kaede and Yurie wear unsuitable clothes so it would be impossible for them either. As for Kikuhito, he has a terrible fear of heights. Only one person remains and that is Sakuraba. He can also climb a tree with ease so it would be easy for him to ran away using the balcony. Heiji then points out that Sakuraba and Kaede were secretly lovers. He also reveals that Sakuraba couldn't forgive Shigematsu for arranging the marriage between Kaede and Kikuhito so he killed him. As for evidence, Heiji found a shirt covered in blood to which Sakuraba belongs to. Sakuraba is soon arrested. However, the murder weapon is still missing.

resolution.zhHans: 案件告破：袭击妻子的那个神秘男子，其实是用钓竿吊在阳台外的一尊雕像。犯人被揭示为 Misaki Kana。在遇见 Yoshinori 之前，她其实已在夏威夷与 Gerard Tenma 订婚。Tenma 发现自己被抛弃、被背叛后，用《红色夜想曲》的手稿威胁 Misaki——那首歌词里嵌着代表背叛与憎恨的花朵。她感到性命受威胁，便把 Gerard 叫到悬崖边推了下去，以为他死了。后来发现他活了下来，而且正与她丈夫的公司建立关系，她担心 Gerard Tenma 会威胁揭发自己那次杀人未遂、并杀了她。她因此主动配合这场“勒索”，包括上演贝多芬雕像的那出戏、并请毛利小五郎来帮忙，只为维持自己是受害者的印象。她把自己的丈夫栽成杀害 Tenma 的凶手，是为了保护他不被 Masayo 诱惑、以致拱手让出公司：他在狱中就能摆脱她的影响，而 Misaki 会一直经营、守住公司直到他出狱。悲剧的是，随后又揭示 Gerard 原谅了她——因为他看到是自己把她变成了杀人犯，而他本来真心想改善她丈夫的公司。他甚至重写了《红色夜想曲》的歌词来表达对她的哀伤。Misaki 泪流满面。之后，柯南送花给兰，兰把那些花解读成“无敌”的意思，于是对柯南发起火来。
resolution.en: The case is solved, the mysterious man who attacked the wife is revealed to be a statue hung off of the balcony by a fishing rod. The culprit is revealed to be Misaki Kana. Before meeting Yoshinori, she was actually engaged to Gerard Tenma in Hawaii. Tenma, discovering how he was dumped and betrayed, threatens Misaki with the original manuscript of the Red Nocturne containing flowers in the lyrics whose representation were emotions of betrayal and hatred. Feeling threatened for her life, Misaki calls Gerard to a cliff and pushes him to his supposed death. Discovering that he survived and that he was forming connections with the company owned by her husband, she fears that Gerard Tenma will threaten to expose her attempted murder and kill her. She thereby self imposes blackmail, including the Beethoven statue stunt and calling in the help of Mouri Kogoro, to keep up the impression that she is a victim. She frames her own husband for Tenma's murder, to protect him from being seduced by Masayo into giving up his company. He would be free from her influence while in jail and Misaki would run and protect the company until his release. Tragically, it is then revealed that Gerard forgave her, after seeing that he turned her into a murderer, and was genuinely trying to improve her husband's company. He had even rewritten the lyrics to Red Nocturne to express his feelings of sorrow for her. Misaki breaks down in tears. Afterwards, Conan gives Ran flowers, and Ran interprets the flowers to mean "invincible" and gets angry at Conan.

motive.en: He chose to operate in the tunnel in the middle of the night because he didn't want people off the train to see the corpse hanging off. Kaetsu left the gang and planned to avenge both Asuma for forcing his girlfriend to over consume drugs and Izumo for selling his girlfriend drugs.

method.zhHans: 优作及时现身，向这位曾崇拜他作品的犯人揭示了手法与自己的身份。Kaetsu 化装成 Asama，用他的钓鱼装备让人以为 Asama 跳下了火车。他先将 Asama 击中头部致死，再用装了消音器的枪打碎车窗。接着，他把钓鱼线穿过对方裤子后侧的皮带环，将人吊在窗外。他把钓鱼线的一端系在滑轮上，另一端系在屋外固定物上。最后，他又用另一根钓鱼线，一端做成环，穿上一片胶带。他用这套手法把 Izumo 被杀的罪名栽到 Asama 头上。犯人作案时穿的那件衬衫，在他的行李里和化装衣物一起被找到了。
method.en: Yusaku appears just in time and reveals the trick and his own identity to the criminal, who had idolized his work. Kaetsu dressed like Asama and made people believe that he jump off the train by using his fishing equipment. First, he hit Asama in the head until he died and broke the window using silenced gun. Then, he put the fishing line through the belt loop on the back of his pants and hung him outside the window. He tied the side of the fishing line to the pulley and the other to something stable outside the room. Lastly, he used another fishing line, looped one end, and put a piece of tape through it. He used this trick to framed Asama on the murder of Izumo. The shirt the criminal used is found on his luggage together with the disguise outfit.

It is a play based on The Phantom of the Opera. Things start to mimic the play. There are requests for a heroine change, sightings of a phantom, and a deliberate attempt on the heroine, just like Phantom of the Opera. The chief of the stage setting is killed, and the chairman and the sponsor are arrested by circumstantial evidence.

The arsonist tries to throw the torch at the oil, but Conan, with his soccer ball, knocks the torch out the window and reveals to everyone that the culprit is Harue Yatabe. She is the only one who could have driven that van to the factory.

Victim: Takuji Hirukawa Age: 38 years old Injury: Explosion culprit: Hiroyuki Tomonaga Hiroyuki tried to make the police think the culprit commit suicide by killing Takuji via explosion and take the rest of the money but Takuji was saved at time by Conan. Hiroyuki Tomonaga attempted to flee with the remaining stolen money but was caught by Conan (via Kogoro). Then Ran said Tomonaga doesn't have the right to because despite being a copy Tomonaga used that wonderful picture book to commit crimes and the author must be crying in heaven now for what Tomonaga did.

method.zhHans: 作为证据，虽然炸弹装有定时器，但它们被改装成可用遥控器控制。随后 Ran 说 Tomonaga 没有这个资格，因为尽管是复制品，Tomonaga 却用那本精彩的立体书来犯罪，作者此刻一定在天堂为 Tomonaga 的所作所为而哭泣。

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Hiroyuki Tomonaga。作为证据，虽然炸弹装有定时器，但它们被改装成可用遥控器控制。据鉴定科称，这样只能在30米的范围内起作用。因此，犯人必须靠近炸弹才能加快定时器的速度。此外，犯人还必须把 incoming 的短信与 Kogoro 的动作协调一致。Tomonaga 自愿随警方前往以达成这一目的。他怂恿 Takuji Hirukawa 去袭击运载钞票的运输车，同时把自己伪装成在为哥哥报仇的样子。爆炸/杀人未遂地点：Haido/米花市？

summary.en: Conan, Ran, and Kogoro are staking out a door on the fifth floor of an apartment with a package in front of it in search of a package thief. The group gets distracted by a sudden draft of wind that places a leaf inside of Kogoro's clothing which Ran mistakes as a bug. While Kogoro and Ran are trying to get rid of the leaf, Conan notices the package thief running past with the package in hand trying to leave by elevator. The elevator shows the thief stops on the fourth floor and Conan gives chase via the stairs but eventually loses the thief when Conan reaches the fourth floor. Given that the entrance to the apartment building locks automatically and the thief was wearing sandals, the trio concludes the culprit most likely is a resident of the apartment building.

The only way to find him is by reading his text messages. The boy only knows how to send, but does not know how to receive. Conan must combine the clues he's given to find out his location.

title.ja: 女王様の天気予報 (Joō-sama no Tenkiyohō)

culpritSource.quote: Yasumi was checking the stage and fell for the trap, which was only meant to frighten her. However, she was so shocked that she staggered to the railing and fell through it to her death. The detective found a strip of duct tape stuck on the tensil and declares that the culprit is Hiroko Shinohara, who has a roll of that same kind of tape. Also, the TV producer overheard her conversation in the kitchen yesterday, declaring she would embarrass Yasumi with that trap. She admits to devising that trap because she hated Yasumi for her selfishness and arrogance. Though she admits that she never thoug

motive.quote: She admits to devising that trap because she hated Yasumi for her selfishness and arrogance.

method.quote: Someone set up a trap to kill Yasumi.

evidence.quote: The detective found a strip of duct tape stuck on the tensil and declares that the culprit is Hiroko Shinohara, who has a roll of that same kind of tape.

motive.zhHans: 她承认设下那个陷阱，是因为她厌恶Yasumi的自私与傲慢。尽管Yasumi说过不会去查看舞台，但她还是去了，因为真凶把Hiroko的陷阱告诉了她。本质上，真凶把自己的陷阱设在Hiroko的陷阱之后，是为了让她当替罪羊来替罪，从而逃避嫌疑。Yukio今天早上擦了他的棕色皮鞋，但因为下着毛毛雨、湿度很高，鞋油没有干。由于Yasumi坠落时他和其他人在一起，烟雾机必须是遥控操作的。Yukio坦白，承认是他杀了Yasumi，因为她知道他在挪用节目的经费。
motive.en: She admits to devising that trap because she hated Yasumi for her selfishness and arrogance. Even though Yasumi said she would not check the stage, she went there anyway because the true culprit told her about Hiroko's trap. Essentially, the culprit put his trap behind Hiroko's so that he could use her as a scapegoat for the crime to avoid suspicion. Yukio polished his brown shoes this morning, but because it was drizzling and humid, the shoe polish did not dry. Since he was with everyone else during Yasumi's fall, the smoke machine had to be controlled wirelessly. Yukio confesses revealing that he killed Yasumi because she knew he was embezzling the program's funds.

method.zhHans: 有人设下陷阱要杀死Yasumi。她完全照他所说弄破了气球，却意外触发了真凶设下的第二个陷阱。第二件证据是他一直携带的、用来启动烟雾机的遥控器。然而，柯南用Yasumi留下的死前讯息反驳了他的说法：Yasumi在坠落时、在摔到地面上之前就意识到Yukio骗了她，因此在死前，她画下了一个在天气预报中代表雪的符号。
method.en: Someone set up a trap to kill Yasumi. She did exactly what he told her and popped the balloon, which unexpectedly activated a second trap the culprit set up. The second piece of evidence is the remote control he was carrying the whole time to activate the smoke machine. However, Conan counters his claim with the dying message Yasumi had left: as Yasumi was falling she had realized that Yukio had tricked her before she fell onto the floor, so before she died, she drew a symbol that represents snow in weather forecasting.

evidence.zhHans: 侦探发现一条胶带粘在金属彩带上，并断言犯人是Hiroko Shinohara，她有一卷同样种类的胶带。小五郎的推理虽然并非全错，但无法解释为什么会有气体喷出的声音、为什么只有Yasumi头发的左侧被缠住，以及为什么她的发饰被发现靠近墙边。证明他是犯人的第一件证据，是烟雾机喷口上褐色的污迹。第二件证据是他一直携带的、用来启动烟雾机的遥控器。
evidence.en: The detective found a strip of duct tape stuck on the tensil and declares that the culprit is Hiroko Shinohara, who has a roll of that same kind of tape. Kogoro's deduction, while not entirely wrong, does not explain why there was the sound of gas spraying, why only the left side of Yasumi's hair was tangled, and why her hair accessory was found near the wall. The first piece of evidence that he is culprit is the brown smudge on the smoke machine's funnel. The second piece of evidence is the remote control he was carrying the whole time to activate the smoke machine.

resolution.zhHans: 小五郎告诉大家，这不是意外。有人设下陷阱要杀死Yasumi。要制造这个陷阱，把金属彩带的一端绑在舞台的一个支撑物上，另一端绑到对面；之后，把一个气球绑在彩带的另一端。当有人走下舞台时，脚会把金属彩带挑起来，将气球推向玫瑰的刺，使气球破裂。
resolution.en: Kogoro tells everyone that this was not an accident. Someone set up a trap to kill Yasumi. To create the trap, tie one end of a tinsel to one of the stage's supports and the other end to the opposite side; after that, tie a balloon to other end of the tinsel. When a person walks down the stage, his or her foot scoops up the tinsel, pushing the balloon towards the roses' thorns and causing it to pop.

summary.en: Kogoro is at Nichiuri TV office, filming "Detective VS Weather Reporter" with Yasumi Sekine while Conan and Ran watch at the sidelines with Yukio Kodama, Takuya Yamaguchi, and Hiroko Shinohara. After the filming, Kogoro and Ran rest in a room while Conan goes to a vending machine to buy a bottle of oolong tea. As he picks up the bottle, he notices Yasumi and Yukio conversing secretly. After the small talk, they head out and split off. Then, Takuya hesitantly comes out of a room and follows Yasumi, and Conan follows him. Yasumi meets with Hiroko, who tells her the stage is good and ready. Hiroko asks her if she wanted to check the stage, but she said no because she trusted her.

summary.en:
On a rainy night at the Mouri Detective Agency, Detective Chiba arrives and begs Kogoro for help. He wants Kogoro to help him to find a woman that he believes is in danger.

Chiba swiftly explains that recently, he's been seeing a woman at the Ikitsuke Café. The woman named Mio Ashida said she felt like something dangerous will occur. She gave him threatening letters she had received from someone who had recently been released from prison. When questioned, it was revealed that they had been coming for nearly a year and that she had changed jobs and moved because she was afraid of them stalking her. However, recently, she felt she was being watched, thus prompting her to tell Chiba. He had said that if she saw the person, or anyone suspicious, she must tell him immediately. However, when Chiba went to the restroom, Mio left. Concerned, Chiba questioned the owner who said the customer left, and seemed upset or afraid. As Chiba went to follow her, he grabbed an umbrella and realized that he had hers, meaning that in her rush, she had grabbed his.

While Saeki is standing at her door, she hears Morita screaming at her boyfriend Atsushi Tabata. When she enters with the spare key, Mifuyu is lying down on the floor having been stabbed in the chest apparently. There are footprints leading to the balcony. Mifuyu tells Saeki to run for her life saying that her boyfriend is still in the apartment.

motive.zhHans: 面对这个证据，凶手供认：她杀死千寻，是因为千寻与成田交往后又狠心把他甩了，逼得他自杀（其他朋友只以为他是在擦枪时出了意外）。

motive.replacedEn: Megure and Takagi on the scene realize that since the message is "KIX" (the airport code of the Kansai International Airport, located in Izumisano), that means the culprit is Izumi Sano.
motive.translationNote: 按 DCW 原文原句重新指派（原值系切块错位，旧值存于 replacedEn）

method.zhHans: 柯南解开案件，指出犯人通过（错误地）模仿烟花爆响的声音来制造不在场证明，并抓住被害人的手指写下血字 S，企图把嫌疑从自己身上引开。这种“故布疑阵”的手法后来在多起案件中被使用，例如《园子的危险夏日物语》里那位无辜的被害人；从《小小的委托人》起在动画中被完整运用，只有《兰也倒下的浴室》因剧情需要算是例外。
method.en: Conan solves the case and reveals that the culprit manufactured their alibi by (incorrectly) imitating the noise of the fireworks going off and tried to deflect suspicion from themselves by writing the bloody S using the victim's finger. This type of censorship would later be used in various cases, such as the innocent victim in Sonoko's Dangerous Summer Story, and is fully used from A Small Client onward in the anime with a small exception in Bathroom Where Ran Collapsed As Well due to plot reason.

evidence.zhHans: 她犯下此案的证据在她的冰刀刃上——她在不知不觉中踩到了被害人的血。【动机】面对这项证据，凶手供认：她杀死千寻，是因为千寻与 Narita 交往后又无情地甩了他，逼得他自杀（但其他朋友以为他只是在擦枪时发生了致命意外）。

Motive When confronted with this proof, the murderer confesses: she killed Chihiro for dating Narita then ruthlessly dumping him, driving him to suicide (but the other friends thought he'd simply had a fatal accident while cleaning his gun).

resolution.zhHans: 柯南解开案件，指出犯人通过（错误地）模仿烟花爆响的声音来制造不在场证明，并抓住被害人的手指写下血字 S，企图把嫌疑从自己身上引开。他指出，那个 S 并不是临终留言——真正的留言是那部电话：除了 Oda 之外，所有朋友（包括已故、曾是其中一员的 Narita）的姓氏都对应着设有机场的城市。现场的目暮和高木由此想到，留言是「KIX」（关西国际机场的机场代码，该机场位于泉佐野），也就是说犯人就是 Izumi Sano。她犯下此案的证据在她的冰刀刃上——她在不知不觉中踩到了被害人的血。
resolution.en: Conan solves the case and reveals that the culprit manufactured their alibi by (incorrectly) imitating the noise of the fireworks going off and tried to deflect suspicion from themselves by writing the bloody S using the victim's finger. He reveals that the S was not the dying message, but the phone was: except for Oda, all of the friends (including the now deceased Narita, who was once part of this group) had last names that correspond to cities with airports in them. Megure and Takagi on the scene realize that since the message is "KIX" (the airport code of the Kansai International Airport, located in Izumisano), that means the culprit is Izumi Sano. The proof that she committed the murder lies in the blades of her ice skates, where she'd stepped in the victim's blood without realizing that she had done so.

As it is usual for red wine to be decanted before serving, it wouldn't be too unusual to lead the service person into one's kitchen. The publisher mentioned that even though he saw the female bellhop arrive at the suite, since they were too focused on eating as much food as possible, they couldn't have noticed her leaving or staying in the suite.

motive.quote: The publisher mentioned that even though he saw the female bellhop arrive at the suite, since they were too focused on eating as much food as possible, they couldn't have noticed her leaving or staying in the suite.

method.quote: Amongst many of the deliveries which he has ordered to his room, Minazuki came to the suite disguised as room service who delivered red wine.

evidence.quote: As conclusive evidence Sera mentions the page uniform which they found on another floor in the trash, which could easily be tested for the culprit's and victim's DNA and sweat.

motive.zhHans: 出版社的人提到，虽然他看见了那个女侍应生来到套房，但因为他们当时太专注于尽可能多吃些东西，所以不可能注意到她是离开了还是留在了套房里。他让她在那里等他，并脱掉酒店侍应生制服，因为要给尸体脱衣服并不容易。下午4点30分他出门去买香烟，却去了受害者的房间，把她放到门前，好让送香槟的男侍应生看到她。他从自己房间里拿走了洗发水的瓶盖，因为受害者之前用过它们，而他想把它们换掉，但他没来得及换，身上还一直带着它们。Keigo承认了罪行，说关于她是“吃男人”的传闻是假的，相反，多次拒绝他的人是她，因为他已经结婚了。Keigo说这是一个幼稚的暗号，柯南回答说这并不让他意外，因为这是小孩子想出来的。她之所以保密，是想给他一个惊喜，并希望一旦暗号被解开，他能猜出她的身份。
motive.en: The publisher mentioned that even though he saw the female bellhop arrive at the suite, since they were too focused on eating as much food as possible, they couldn't have noticed her leaving or staying in the suite. He asked her to wait there for him and take off the hotel page uniform, since it wouldn't be easy to undress a corpse. At 4.30 PM he left in order to buy cigarettes, but went to the victim's room to place her in front of the door for the bellboy to see her once he delivered the champagne. He has removed the shampoo bottle caps from his room since the victim had used them earlier and he wanted to replace them, which he didn't do in time, and he still carried them on him. Keigo admits to the crime, saying that the "man eating" rumors about her were false, instead, she was the one who declined him many times since he was married. Keigo says that it is a childish code, to which Conan replies that it doesn't surprise him since it was thought up by a child. The reason she kept it a secret was because she wanted to surprise him and hoped that he would figure out her identity, once the code was reveal.

method.zhHans: 在他让人送到自己房间的众多送餐服务之中，Minazuki乔装成送红酒的客房服务人员来到了套房。世良解释说，当出版社的人在主房间吃饭时，Keigo在浴室里勒死了受害者。他杀掉她之后把她放进了大行李箱里，利用绳子和一种特殊的结，经过一些练习后，他轻易地在客人们离开后把她放到了下层阳台上。他从自己房间里拿走了洗发水的瓶盖，因为受害者之前用过它们，而他想把它们换掉，但他没来得及换，身上还一直带着它们。当“'Denwa, umi watashi'”（でんわ, うみ わたし ?, “电话，海和我”）从日语翻译成英语并调换词序后，它可以被读作“I, sea tel”，用罗马字发音连在一起可以读作“Aishiteru”，意思是“我爱你”。
method.en: Amongst many of the deliveries which he has ordered to his room, Minazuki came to the suite disguised as room service who delivered red wine. Masumi explains that while the publishers were eating in the main room, Keigo has strangled the victim in the bath. He had put her in the big suitcase after murdering her, and by using a rope and a special knot he easily, after some practice, was able to lower her on the lower balcony after the guests have left. He has removed the shampoo bottle caps from his room since the victim had used them earlier and he wanted to replace them, which he didn't do in time, and he still carried them on him. When "'Denwa, umi watashi'" (でんわ, うみ わたし ?, "cellphone, sea and I") is translated from Japanese to English and the word order is switched, it can be read as "I, sea tel" which with Romaji pronunciation can be combined and read as "Aishiteru" meaning "I love you".

evidence.zhHans: 作为决定性证据，世良提到了他们在另一层楼的垃圾桶里找到的侍应生制服，它可以很容易地用来检测犯人和受害者的DNA及汗液。
evidence.en: As conclusive evidence Sera mentions the page uniform which they found on another floor in the trash, which could easily be tested for the culprit's and victim's DNA and sweat.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是Keigo Hiura。在他让人送到自己房间的众多送餐服务之中，Minazuki乔装成送红酒的客房服务人员来到了套房。红酒在上桌前先倒入醒酒器是常事，因此把服务人员领进自己的厨房也不算太不寻常。出版社的人提到，虽然他看见了那个女侍应生来到套房，但因为他们当时太专注于尽可能多吃些东西，所以不可能注意她是离开了还是留在了套房里。
resolution.en: The culprit is Keigo Hiura. Amongst many of the deliveries which he has ordered to his room, Minazuki came to the suite disguised as room service who delivered red wine. As it is usual for red wine to be decanted before serving, it wouldn't be too unusual to lead the service person into one's kitchen. The publisher mentioned that even though he saw the female bellhop arrive at the suite, since they were too focused on eating as much food as possible, they couldn't have noticed her leaving or staying in the suite.

This is because between 1:30pm-2:30 the system turned on the natural pesticide, pyroligneous, in the north field and acidic fluids turns sliver oxidized. The method she used to commit this murder is known as the as Ebi-Sora, she tied a robe around Kengo's neck and had him curl up his body while on his stomach. She then tied the other end of the rope to his ankles forcing to him keep his body curled up to prevent him from choking himself.

resolution.zhHans: 凶手是 Yurika Suwayama。最关键的线索是她的发饰。一整天下来它都是漂亮的银色，如今却变成了黯淡的黑色！这是因为下午 1:30 到 2:30 之间，系统在北边的田里喷洒了天然农药木醋液，而酸性液体会让银氧化。她用来实施这起谋杀的手法被称为 Ebi-Sora：她把一件和服衣带系在 Kengo 的脖子上，并让他趴着把身体蜷起来。随后她把绳子的另一端绑在他的脚踝上，迫使他一直保持蜷缩的姿势，以免他自己勒住自己。最终他等不到救援、精疲力竭，还是窒息而死。证明这一点的，是 Kengo 脖子上多道绳痕——那是他试图阻止自己窒息时留下的。Yurika 这样做是为了在死亡发生的时段制造不在场证明，因为她知道他迟早会死。Yurika 供认，Kengo 打算跟她离婚，因为他说 Yurika 对葡萄酒生意一窍不通，这让她怒不可遏。她高喊 Kengo 爱葡萄酒胜过爱她，又加了一句：「葡萄才没有更重要！葡萄酒根本无足轻重！」随后崩溃痛哭。
resolution.en: The culprit is Yurika Suwayama. The biggest clue is her hair ornament. Throughout the day, it was a beautiful sliver, now it was a tarnished black! This is because between 1:30pm-2:30 the system turned on the natural pesticide, pyroligneous, in the north field and acidic fluids turns sliver oxidized. The method she used to commit this murder is known as the as Ebi-Sora, she tied a robe around Kengo's neck and had him curl up his body while on his stomach. She then tied the other end of the rope to his ankles forcing to him keep his body curled up to prevent him from choking himself. Eventually he was too tried to wait for help and ended up choking himself. The proof of this is the multiple rope marks on Kengo's neck from trying to stop himself from choking. Yurika did this to establish an alibi during his death, as she knew it was only a matter of time till he died. Yurika confessed that Kengo was going to divorce her because he said Yurika knew nothing about the wine business, which makes her furious. She yells out that Kengo loved wine more than her and adds, "GRAPES AREN'T MORE IMPORTANT! WINE IS INSIGNIFICANT!" and breaks down in tears.

Location: Barrel warehouse

Age: 33 years old

title.ja: 逃げ回るゲームソフト (Nigemawaru Gēmusofuto)

summary.en: Conan, Ayumi, Genta, and Mitsuhiko came to visit a video game company called Shining Corp, because they want to learn about the "Seven Mysteries" of the hit game Gyadorin, which will be revealed when the sequel of the game, Gyadorin Episode 2, releases the following week. Genta was suddenly in need to use the toilet, which makes him (along with Ayumi and Mitsuhiko) rush into the employee-only area uninvited, causing the company's security guard to chase them.

locations: Nobukazu Michiba's office, Shining Corp. Building
locationsZh: 闪亮公司大楼内道场信道一的办公室

title.en: The Scar that Evokes the Past
title.ja: 532: 初恋の傷跡 (Hatsukoi no Kizuato) 533: 過去を呼ぶ傷跡

summary.en: A blind rich woman named Kurumi Shodo asks Kogoro to help her find a boy who saved her life in the past, and whom she plans to reward very nicely in thanks. Her only clue is that the boy should have a large scar across either his torso or his chest, which he got while saving her life. She has been able to narrow it down to two people, Ryuichi Kusumoto and Sogo Banba, after giving a public interview about it, and they are both staying at her house: Kogoro must now identify which of the two is the boy, and which one is a swindler. Conan meanwhile notices the police are stalking the woman's house. He confronts them and finds Matsumoto, Megure, Takagi and others, who tell Conan that a serial killer from a past case may be there, as the killer also has a scar on his upper body.

locations: Douji Hiramune's room in Ayumi's apartment complex
locationsZh: 步美公寓楼内平宗道司的房间

title.ja: 緋色の序章 (Hiiro no Joshō) 緋色の追求 (Hiiro no Tsuikyū) 緋色の交錯 (Hiiro no Kōsaku)
紅の修学旅行 (Kurenai no Shūgakuryokō)

summary.en: Shinichi eventually manages to take part to the Kyoto trip with Ran and their friends, thanks to the series of antidotes Haibara gave Conan. Each time Conan takes an antidote, he has to wait 8 hours after the back shrinking before taking another one. Shinichi and Ran secretly hope that Ran will give an answer to Shinichi's love declaration back in London. On the Kiyomizu-Dera, Shinichi meets Keiko, an actress and old friend of his mother, who stays in the same hotel as Shinichi and his class, with some university friends with which she shot a blockbuster revolving around a tengu and other monsters. She asks Shinichi to help her to decipher a mysterious code written and sent by their late friend Michio Dekuri, who committed suicide some time ago. The code was received by Nishiki, the movie's screenwriter, along with red aralia leaves, typical from Kyoto. Shinichi tries to solve it, while enjoying Kyoto with his friends, in particular Masumi, who knows Conan is Shinichi but still keeps it a secret. The group of friends visit Kyoto's temples and their gruesome crimson ceilings, that were at first the temple's floors spilled with the blood of samurais who committed mass suicide/seppuku and left many footprints, it was so astounding that the floors were kept and turned into ceilings.
