culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Eiichiro Kondo. Conan investigates the scene and realizes that it was a murder made to look like an accident. He explains that Kondo was the one who they saw jump off the observation deck and reveals that when Kondo jumped, he landed on a tree below the cliff where he then proceeded to push the unconscious Hirai off the tree. As evidence, Conan reveals that the tree had a mejiro's nest and that spider's web, a collectible that mejiro birds use to build their nests, was found on Hirai. To incriminate Kondo, Conan explains that Kondo's footprint from his mountaineering boots was f

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are on a hiking trip in Nishitama. When they reach the Mt. Kotengu observation deck, they witness a man jump off the edge to his death. The body was found at the bottom of the hill and is identified to be Takaya Hirai.

He escaped her room by using a secret entrance, that one of the former owners, the oldest of two rich brothers, had built. The older brother build the passage to be able to spy on a birdhouse, which his wife and his younger brother used to signal their time of their affair. The older brother pretended to have seen a demon to shut the window and build the secret passage. He in fact only shut the left half of the window adding a fake window pane at the left of it leaving the ri

motive.zhHans: 哥哥修出那条暗道，是为了窥视一只鸟笼——那是他妻子和他弟弟用来互传幽会时间的信号。Yoji 承认有罪，并说自己是在一时激愤之下杀了伦子：她侮辱了他最喜欢的音乐家，还说他应该从头再来，因为他已经不合新潮了。证据是：由于柯南指出伦子房间书架最下层的百科全书排列没有按顺序，Yoji 夜里从暗道进去把它们换了回去——因为那些书挡住了暗道口——以免警方注意到这个奇怪之处，结果被园子、小兰、英佑、其他乐队成员和山村目击。最后，柯南在心里说，他没有让山村刑警或园子睡着，是因为他注意到英佑正在看着他。
motive.en: The older brother build the passage to be able to spy on a birdhouse, which his wife and his younger brother used to signal their time of their affair. Yoji admits his guilt and say that he killed Rinko in a fit of anger after she insulted his favorite musicians and said that he should start over because he didn't fit in the new trend. The proof is that because Conan pointed out that the encyclopedias at the bottom of Rinko's room's bookshelf aren't in order, Yoji at night went in the passage to replace them since they were in front of the passage to avoid the police noticing the oddity and was seen by Sonoko, Ran, Eisuke, the other band members and Yamamura. In the end, Conan said to himself, that the reason that he didn't put Detective Yamamura or Sonoko to sleep is because he noticed Eisuke was watching him.

method.zhHans: 他利用一条秘密通道逃出了她的房间——那是一个旧房主、一对富有兄弟中的长子修成的。哥哥修出那条暗道，是为了窥视一只鸟笼——那是他妻子和他弟弟用来互传幽会时间的信号。哥哥装作看见了妖魔，于是封上窗户、修了这条暗道。实际上他只封了窗户的左半边，在左侧装了一块假玻璃，把右半边留在暗道墙后，好让他能窥视两人。进到暗道之后，他看到了那条用来杀死哥哥妻子的绳索，便决定用它来杀伦子。
method.en: He escaped her room by using a secret entrance, that one of the former owners, the oldest of two rich brothers, had built. The older brother build the passage to be able to spy on a birdhouse, which his wife and his younger brother used to signal their time of their affair. The older brother pretended to have seen a demon to shut the window and build the secret passage. He in fact only shut the left half of the window adding a fake window pane at the left of it leaving the right half of it behind the walls of the secret passage where he would be able to spy on them. Upon going in the secret passage, he saw the rope that was used to kill the older brother's wife and decided to kill Rinko with it.

evidence.zhHans: 证据是：由于柯南指出伦子房间书架最下层的百科全书排列没有按顺序，Yoji 夜里从暗道进去把它们换了回去——因为那些书挡住了暗道口——以免警方注意到这个奇怪之处，结果被园子、小兰、英佑、其他乐队成员和山村目击。

resolution.zhHans: 柯南以小五郎的名义给山村刑警发邮件，告诉他真凶是谁。犯人是 Yoji Kuramoto。他利用一条秘密通道逃出了她的房间——那是一个旧房主、一对富有兄弟中的长子修成的。哥哥修出那条暗道，是为了窥视一只鸟笼——那是他妻子和他弟弟用来互传幽会时间的信号。哥哥装作看见了妖魔，于是封上窗户、修了这条暗道。实际上他只封了窗户的左半边，在左侧装了一块假玻璃，把右半边留在暗道墙后，好让他能窥视两人。他可能是出于愧疚杀了妻子后自杀。弟弟和他的妻子其实与那桩旧案无关，是清白的。Yoji 承认有罪，并说自己是在一时激愤之下杀了伦子：她侮辱了他最喜欢的音乐家，还说他应该从头再来，因为他已经不合新潮了。进到暗道之后，他看到了那条用来杀死哥哥妻子的绳索，便决定用它来杀伦子。证据是：由于柯南指出伦子房间书架最下层的百科全书排列没有按顺序，Yoji 夜里从暗道进去把它们换了回去——因为那些书挡住了暗道口——以免警方注意到这个奇怪之处，结果被园子、小兰、英佑、其他乐队成员和山村目击。最后，柯南在心里说，他没有让山村刑警或园子睡着，是因为他注意到英佑正在看着他。
resolution.en: Conan sends a mail to Detective Yamamura as Kogoro telling him who the actual culprit is. The culprit is Yoji Kuramoto. He escaped her room by using a secret entrance, that one of the former owners, the oldest of two rich brothers, had built. The older brother build the passage to be able to spy on a birdhouse, which his wife and his younger brother used to signal their time of their affair. The older brother pretended to have seen a demon to shut the window and build the secret passage. He in fact only shut the left half of the window adding a fake window pane at the left of it leaving the right half of it behind the walls of the secret passage where he would be able to spy on them. He might have killed his wife and committed suicide out of guilt. The younger brother and his wife are in fact not involved in the past case and are innocent. Yoji admits his guilt and say that he killed Rinko in a fit of anger after she insulted his favorite musicians and said that he should start over because he didn't fit in the new trend. Upon going in the secret passage, he saw the rope that was used to kill the older brother's wife and decided to kill Rinko with it. The proof is that because Conan pointed out that the encyclopedias at the bottom of Rinko's room's bookshelf aren't in order, Yoji at night went in the passage to replace them since they were in front of the passage to avoid the police noticing the oddity and was seen by Sonoko, Ran, Eisuke, the other band members and Yamamura. In the end, Conan said to himself, that the reason that he didn't put Detective Yamamura or Sonoko to sleep is because he noticed Eisuke was watching him.

title.ja: 秘密の残像 (Himitsu no Zanzō)

summary.en: Juzo Megure is standing in front of Mouri Detective Agency with a worried look on his face when he is spotted by Conan Edogawa. Up in the agency Ran Mouri has just returned home when she finds Kogoro Mouri enthusiastically cheering for a horse race, which Kogoro is following over his radio. Kogoro says that he can't help but to listen to horse races because he doesn't have work. Although he ensures Ran that he didn't bet any money on horse races, he says it's because they're completely broke, a detail which is overheard by Conan. Conan has taken Megure up the stairs to the agency, but while Kogoro tries to cover up the situation, Megure doesn't mind it and instead has a much more important matter. He suspects that one of his subordinates is having an affair, and he would like Kogoro to help investigate.

title.en: The Secret Hidden By the Cards
title.ja: カードに伏せられた秘密 (Kādo ni Fusera Reta Himitsu)

culpritSource.quote: Via Professor Agasa, Conan was able to convey that the culprit is Tsukasa Nitta.

motive.quote: Since the strength from the fall would not cause a person to die, logically speaking.

method.quote: The Mechanical Gimmick The diagonal path that Tsukasa took to activate the trick.

evidence.quote: The Evidence and Motive Nevertheless, Naoto did not die due to the fallen bookshelf.

motive.zhHans: 从逻辑上讲，坠落产生的力量并不会致人死亡。阿笠博士随后揭示了可以证实 Tsukasa 实施杀人的证据：要使书架倒塌，必须施加相当大的力量；因此，必然会留下痕迹。他杀害 Naoto 的原因是——Naoto 不仅勒索了 Daigo，还勒索了 Tsukasa。由于他没有钱购买更昂贵的，他决定在夜间偷一些。事后 Tsukasa 跪下，感到相当后悔，因为阿笠给他上了一课：纸牌游戏可以重来，人的生命却不能。
motive.en: Since the strength from the fall would not cause a person to die, logically speaking. Professor Agasa then revealed the evidence that may verify Tsukasa carrying out the murder: in order to make a bookshelf collapse, considerable strength must be applied; therefore, traces are bound to be left. The reason that he murdered Naoto was because that - not only did Naoto blackmail Daigo, but also Tsukasa. Since he didn't have money to purchase more expensive ones, he decided to steal some at nighttime. Aftermath Tsukasa kneeled down and felt rather regretful, since Agasa had taught him a lesson: A card game can be played over again, but human life cannot be.

method.zhHans: 机械装置 Tsukasa 为启动这个手法所走的对角线路径。Tsukasa 用一根尼龙绳实施杀人；他把绳子的一端固定在自己腰带的后侧，事先将另一端绕过那座倒塌书架顶部的钉子。
method.en: The Mechanical Gimmick The diagonal path that Tsukasa took to activate the trick. Tsukasa used a string of nylon to carry out the murder; he fixed one end of the string to the back of his belt, passing the other end over the nail on the top of that collapsed bookshelf beforehand.

evidence.zhHans: 证据与动机 然而，Naoto 并非因倒塌的书架而死。阿笠博士随后揭示了可以证实 Tsukasa 实施杀人的证据：要使书架倒塌，必须施加相当大的力量；因此，必然会留下痕迹。另一项证据是留在 Tsukasa 裤子上的血迹。警方对 Tsukasa 的裤子做了鲁米诺测试，发现了血迹。
evidence.en: The Evidence and Motive Nevertheless, Naoto did not die due to the fallen bookshelf. Professor Agasa then revealed the evidence that may verify Tsukasa carrying out the murder: in order to make a bookshelf collapse, considerable strength must be applied; therefore, traces are bound to be left. Another piece of evidence would be the blood that remained on Tsukasa's trousers. The police did a luminol test on Tsukasa's trousers and found the blood stains.

resolution.zhHans: 通过阿笠博士，柯南得以传达出犯人就是 Tsukasa Nitta。
resolution.en: Via Professor Agasa, Conan was able to convey that the culprit is Tsukasa Nitta.

summary.en: Within a certain bookstore, the Detective Boys were playing trading cards - Mitsuhiko was having a confrontation with Genta. While they play, Conan, Haibara, Ayumi, and Professor Agasa were watching nearby. On the other side of the table, stood two mystical people... also watching their games in silence.

title.en: The Secret of the High Sales
title.ja: 商売繁盛のヒミツ (Shōbai Hanjō no Himitsu)

summary.en: A boy named Rintaro Koizumi asks the Detective Boys to investigate a strange man named Yuji Kamekura. Rintaro explains that Yuji appeared one day at his family restaurant claiming he owes Rintaro's grandfather a favor and would like to work at the restaurant. Yuji soon after begins living with the family and helps them improve the restaurant to the point the family are constantly busy with the costumers. The Detective Boys investigate and all but Conan are convinced Yuji is planning to dig a tunnel into a store to steal merchandise. The Detective Boys learn from a manager of a jewelry store that a robbery occurred five years ago and the thief was never caught.

title.en: The Secret of the Insect Man
title.ja: 昆虫人間のヒミツ (Konchūningen no Himitsu)

summary.en: Genta brings Conan, Ayumi, and Mitsuhiko to Kuronosu, a small village, so he can catch "insect men" at a town organized event where townspeople are disguised as insects. After running to a sound they thought was the cry of the insect man, the Detective Boys find out that it is only the sound of bulldozers working the land in a forest. The workers get angry and chase them until they are able to go back in town. There, they meet two kids dressed as insects who tell them what is happening in the village currently. Using a picture-story show, they explain that there was once a government official that went in Kuronosu to plan the construction of public baths and casinos in the forest land for the villagers. Unfortunately, the mayor opposed the project as the forest had cultural and historical value since it was the legendary nature-loving Princess Gaga's supposed resting place. The mayor devised a plan and kicked out the official from the village and then planned to open an insect man ranch in the forest instead. Since villagers opposed, the mayor retired a year ago and bought the forest with his own money and moved bulldozers over the place. The mayor then died from a heart attack before being able to put his plan in action. The villagers found out that the whole idea of an insect man ranch was a fraud and a scheme of his to dig up Gaga's grave and sell its treasures.

victims.name: Conan Edogawa, Ayumi Yoshida, Genta Kojima and Mitsuhiko Tsuburaya

title.en: The Secret of the Missing Young Lady
title.ja: 若奥様が消えた秘密 (Wakaokusama ga Kieta Himitsu?)

summary.en: While humming the song "Nazo", Ayumi jogs toward school, but as she passes by the Makabe residence, she sees a man carrying a woman. Both people look injured, and Ayumi, peeking through the bushes, believes the man killed the woman. Ayumi suspects that Jun Makabe is having an affair with a foreign looking woman, evidence from their rather affectionate hug and kiss on the cheek, and they plan to finish off Yuri in the mountain.

title.en: The Secret of the Moon, the Star, and the Sun
title.ja: 月と星と太陽の秘密 (Tsuki to Hoshi to Taiyō no Himitsu)

summary.en: The Detective Boys inform that there have been rumours about flavour change in Ramen restaurant “Ogataken”, so they, Conan and Haibara come to the restaurant to verify this. Ogataken has been opened for 32 years by Masashi Ogata and now it is run by him and Kosaku Ogata, his son. In addition, this restaurant also has signatures from famous people who came here to eat and commented that it was delicious.

title.en: The Secret of the Search for his Wife
title.ja: 妻探しの秘密 (Tsuma Sagashi no Himitsu)

summary.en: A man named Masaki Higuchi is showing a poster of his missing wife Tomomi Higuchi to several people while he is getting wet from the rain. Ran and Conan approach him with an umbrella to offer him shelter and ask to see the poster. Ran immediately recognizes Tomomi from her workplace, a florist shop. Masaki asks for their help and Ran suggests he talk to her father Kogoro Mouri, known as "Sleeping Kogoro".

title.en: The Secret of the Statue of Kogoro Mouri
title.ja: 毛利小五郎像の秘密 (Mōri Kogorō-zō no Himitsu)
title.zhHans: 毛利小五郎铜像的秘密

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Yuzuru Sada. To explain the truth, Kogoro was knocked out by Conan and placed under the statue. He invited everybody to come where he was and started to explain. He said that it was a murder set up to look like an accident. He told them the hint was the bruise on his cheek. Megure thought he got it because he fell, but Kogoro tells him that was what he thought at first until he looked at the statue. He then asks everybody to look closer at it and tells them its nose is broken. It was a recent rupture due to something hitting it strongly earlier that day. It was, in fact, Kataoka

motive.quote: Megure thought he got it because he fell, but Kogoro tells him that was what he thought at first until he looked at the statue.

method.quote: He said that it was a murder set up to look like an accident.

evidence.quote: After, he put traces of Kataoka's shoes on the ladder and placed it just next to him to make it look like he fell.

motive.zhHans: 目暮以为他是因为摔倒才那样的，但小五郎告诉他，那是他最初的想法，直到他看了看那尊雕像。小五郎告诉大家这很奇怪，因为片冈的披风本该被撕破。然而，片冈的尸体上披风并没有撕裂的痕迹，因为他们追的那个人其实并不是片冈。兰说这不可能，因为 Sada 全程都和他们在一起。Sada 说他杀片冈是因为片冈忘掉了已故的妻子，过着奢侈的生活。现任妻子则说这种说法是假的，因为片冈只爱侦探和他的已故妻子。
motive.en: Megure thought he got it because he fell, but Kogoro tells him that was what he thought at first until he looked at the statue. Kogoro tells everybody that it is strange because Kataoka's mantle should have been torn. However, the corpse of Kataoka didn't have a tear on the mantle because the person they were chasing actually wasn't Kataoka. Ran says that it isn't possible because Sada accompanied them all throughout the game. Sada says he killed Kataoka because he forgot about his late wife and lived an extravagant life. The current wife then says that this statement is false because Kataoka only loved detectives and his late wife.

method.zhHans: 他说这是一场伪装成意外的谋杀。之后他被运到假装要摔落的地方，并再次被撞击在石质地面上而被杀死。起初他们追的是片冈，但在游戏中，犯人换掉了真正的片冈，取而代之。假装成片冈并杀死他的人就是 Yuzuru Sada。他利用众人被引开的时机，抄近路穿过宅邸。然后他乔装打扮，袭击了片冈，把他藏在雕像后面。高木和一名警官用音响发出同样的声音，那显然是 Sada 所用的。他提前把声音录在一张 CD 上，并用定时器在适当的时间播出声音。当其他人跑过来时，他抱着片冈的尸体，以掩盖已经沾在他衣服上的被害人的血。
method.en: He said that it was a murder set up to look like an accident. He was then transported to the place where he would pretendedly fall and struck again on the stone floor to kill him. Initially, they were chasing Kataoka but during the game, the culprit swapped out the real Kataoka and substituted himself. The culprit that pretended to be Kataoka and killed him was Yuzuru Sada. He used the moment of diversion to take a shortcut through the manor. He then disguised himself and struck Kataoka, hiding him behind the statue. Takagi, along with an officer, makes the same sound with the stereo, which Sada obviously used. He recorded the sound in advance on a cd and used a timer to broadcast the sound at the right time. He held Kataoka's corpse when the others ran over to disguise the blood of the victim that was already on his clothes.

evidence.zhHans: 之后，他在梯子上留下了片冈鞋子的痕迹，并把它放在自己旁边，制造出他从梯子上摔落的假象。Sada 要求拿出证据，小五郎说他把戏服藏在了篮球里面。
evidence.en: After, he put traces of Kataoka's shoes on the ladder and placed it just next to him to make it look like he fell. Sada asks for evidence and Kogoro says that he hid his costume inside the basketball.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人就是 Yuzuru Sada。为了解明真相，小五郎被柯南击晕并放在雕像下面。他把大家都叫到他所在的地方，开始解说。他说这是一场伪装成意外的谋杀。他告诉他们，线索是他脸颊上的瘀伤。目暮以为他是因为摔倒才那样的，但小五郎告诉他，那是他最初的想法，直到他看了看那尊雕像。然后他让大家仔细看看雕像，并告诉他们它的鼻子断了。那是当天早些时候被某物强烈撞击而造成的近期破裂。事实上，撞到它的是片冈——因此才有那块瘀伤。他解释说尸体倒在人行道附近，如果他是从梯子上摔下来的，就不可能在脸颊上留下瘀伤。他没有从梯子上摔下来。首先，他被人打晕，撞到了雕像。然后他被运到假装要摔落的地方，并再次被撞击在石质地面上而被杀死。之后，他在梯子上留下了片冈鞋子的痕迹，并把它放在自己旁边，制造出他摔落的假象。当他问高木片冈的披风有没有撕裂的痕迹时，高木说完全没有撕破。小五郎告诉大家这很奇怪，因为片冈的披风本该被撕破。他们追他的时候看到他的披风被栅栏挂破了。然而，片冈的尸体上披风并没有撕裂的痕迹，因为他们追的那个人其实并不是片冈。起初他们追的是片冈，但在游戏中，犯人换掉了真正的片冈，取而代之。假装成片冈并杀死他的人就是 Yuzuru Sada。兰说这不可能，因为 Sada 全程都和他们在一起。小五郎打断了她，说有一次他们分开了：在来到后院之前。当 Sada 让他们继续、自己走了另一条路时他们就分开了，那是事先计划好的。他利用众人被引开的时机，抄近路穿过宅邸。然后他乔装打扮，袭击了片冈，把他藏在雕像后面。随后他以 Kaito K 的身份出现在兰和柯南面前。继续追赶的是 Sada。真正的那个人跑进密道时，鞋子完全弄脏了，但自行车的踏板却很干净。就在谋杀之后，他处理掉了戏服并恢复了原样。为了为自己辩护，Sada 问小五郎片冈是怎么发出大家都听到的那声喊叫的。高木和一名警官用音响发出同样的声音，那显然是 Sada 所用的。他提前把声音录在一张 CD 上，并用定时器在适当的时间播出声音。他播出片冈的喊叫声时，片冈还活着。当大家在宅邸里搜寻时，Sada 在后花园杀死了片冈。当其他人跑过来时，他抱着片冈的尸体，以掩盖已经沾在他衣服上的被害人的血。他的失误是声音放得太大了：喊叫声通常传不了那么远。Sada 要求拿出证据，小五郎说他把戏服藏在了篮球里面。柯南玩起那个球，球发出了奇怪的声音。高木找出了戏服和球里面的那块青铜碎片。小五郎解释说，Sada 犯了两个错误：他没有考虑到野猫会把球弄走，也没有意识到那块弹珠碎片会在球里发出奇怪的声响。Sada 供认了罪行，并说他最大的错误是太小看毛利的推理能力。Sada 说他杀片冈是因为片冈忘掉了已故的妻子，过着奢侈的生活。现任妻子则说这种说法是假的，因为片冈只爱侦探和他的已故妻子。
resolution.en: The culprit is Yuzuru Sada. To explain the truth, Kogoro was knocked out by Conan and placed under the statue. He invited everybody to come where he was and started to explain. He said that it was a murder set up to look like an accident. He told them the hint was the bruise on his cheek. Megure thought he got it because he fell, but Kogoro tells him that was what he thought at first until he looked at the statue. He then asks everybody to look closer at it and tells them its nose is broken. It was a recent rupture due to something hitting it strongly earlier that day. It was, in fact, Kataoka that hit it- hence the bruise. He explains the body had fallen near the sidewalk, and that if he had fallen from a ladder it would be impossible for him to get a bruise on his cheek. He didn't fall from the ladder. First, he was struck unconscious by someone and collided with the statue. He was then transported to the place where he would pretendedly fall and struck again on the stone floor to kill him. After, he put traces of Kataoka's shoes on the ladder and placed it just next to him to make it look like he fell. When he asks Takagi if there is a tear on Kataoka's mantle Takagi says it isn't torn at all. Kogoro tells everybody that it is strange because Kataoka's mantle should have been torn. When they were running after him they saw his cape get torn on the fence. However, the corpse of Kataoka didn't have a tear on the mantle because the person they were chasing actually wasn't Kataoka. Initially, they were chasing Kataoka but during the game, the culprit swapped out the real Kataoka and substituted himself. The culprit that pretended to be Kataoka and killed him was Yuzuru Sada. Ran says that it isn't possible because Sada accompanied them all throughout the game. Kogoro interrupts her and says that there was one moment where they separated: before coming to the backyard. They separated when Sada told them to continue as he took the other path, which was a premeditated plan. He used the moment of diversion to take a shortcut through the manor. He then disguised himself and struck Kataoka, hiding him behind the statue. He then reappeared as Kaito K in front of Ran and Conan. The one that continued the chase was Sada. When the real one ran in the secret passageway, his shoes when completely dirty but the pedals of the bike were neat. Just after the murder, he disposed of the costume and rehabilitated himself. To defend himself, Sada asks Kogoro how Kataoka made his cry that everybody heard. Takagi, along with an officer, makes the same sound with the stereo, which Sada obviously used. He recorded the sound in advance on a cd and used a timer to broadcast the sound at the right time. When he broadcasted Kataoka's cry, Kataoka was still alive. As they were searching in the manor, Sada murdered Kataoka in the back garden. He held Kataoka's corpse when the others ran over to disguise the blood of the victim that was already on his clothes. His mistake was that the sound was played too loud: shouts don't usually travel so far. Sada asks for evidence and Kogoro says that he hid his costume inside the basketball. Conan plays with the ball and it makes a weird sound. Takagi uncovers the costume and the piece of bronze inside the ball. Kogoro explains that Sada made two mistakes: he didn't take into account that a stray cat would move the ball and he also didn't realize that the marble shard would make a strange noise in the ball. Sada confesses to the crime and says that his biggest mistake was taking Mouri's reasoning ability too lightly. Sada says he killed Kataoka because he forgot about his late wife and lived an extravagant life. The current wife then says that this statement is false because Kataoka only loved detectives and his late wife.

summary.en: Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are invited by Eisuke Kataoka, a property tycoon and Kogoro's fan, when they arrives, Kataoka is dressed like a bandit and challenges Kogoro to chase him, but when he was searching him with Kataoka's butler, they hear a scream. And later his son and his second wife discover him lying on the floor after falling of a ladder.

suspects: Yuzuru Sada, Seiya Kataoka, and Yurie Kataoka

title.en: The Secret of the Vanished Masterpiece
title.ja: 消えた名画の秘密 (Kieta Meiga no Himitsu)

summary.en: The Detective Boys decide to investigate a spooky château but realize a man is currently inhabiting the house and had remodeled the garden. The next day, the man living in the château, Rokuro Wada is revealed to have died. They learn from Keiichi Yagami, Wada's agent who sells his paintings, that Wada had been working on a masterpiece at the château for three months. They decide to search the château for the painting but to no avail. Afterwards they are visited by Wada's old aunt Saeko Takato and her caretaker Mina Eguchi who reveals that Wada sent them a letter telling them to visit the château tomorrow to view the masterpiece. Eguchi reveals Wada's masterpiece is going to help Takato regain her memories which she lost from an accident a year ago. Conan finds a photo revealing a château Takato owned in the past and realizes what Wada's masterpiece is.

The anatomy figure running around, statues appearing to move, dolls showing up in the hall with the students' names, and a missing Vice Principal. The Detective Boys decide they need to sneak in at night to uncover these mysteries, but what they learn could lead to a laugh and to a horrible nightmare.

summary.en: Returning from a mountain hike, Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are blocked by a heavy thunderstorm in the waiting room of Ofumoto train station, in a campaign of Tochigi Prefecture, with other people. All trains arriving and departing for Tokyo were suspended until the end of the storm.

What makes the guest so peculiar is that he has his eyes constantly fixed on Tooru Amuro while he is working. While discussing about the mysterious customer's real identity, Conan asks Rei about his status in the Black Organization, as well as the Public Security Bureau.

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Chozo Usagi. The woman was Chozo's girlfriend and a kindergarden teacher. The dying message was her fingers in the shape of a rabbit ([兎]usagi) shadow puppet. He killed her because she stuck him in a small dark cabin with her despite his claustrophobia. She was trying to cure him of it when Chozo had a panic attack and killed her.

There is construction work going on next door, so the restaurant constantly shakes from the work, causing spills and broken plates. They go back the next morning only to find Shigeru Hanaoka, who wanted to go swordfish fishing in Hachijou Island after long time, dead.

summary.en: Kogoro and Conan pass by a lonely shopping street. They try to shop at a greengrocer that catches their eyes, but the owner, Yoshinobu Yamazaki, seems to be in a bad mood. Madam Gaga, a producer who revitalizes the exhausted shopping district, and her assistant, Rabbit Suzuki, came there. Madam calls out holding a professional wrestling tournament to liven up the shopping district, using as icon the female wrestler and Gaga's daughter, Cutie Mimi. The shopkeepers of the shopping district train their bodies through various trainings, and Kogoro will also participate as a referee. Ran, with the provocation of Cutie Mimi, also decides to fight her and prepares.

summary.en: Kogoro Mouri had previously received a request from a woman named Satsuki Makabe about an ill speaking note, so he is now observing the man who could have done it. After he gets out of the elevator, Kogoro enters the elevator and sees a similar one, so he assumes that man was the culprit, but Kogoro has to take him back to the Detective Agency when he doesn’t admit his wrongdoing. There, Satsuki reveals that he is her younger brother named Yuto Makabe. Yuto blames his sister for not lending him money when he was in financial trouble, which angers Satsuki and she slaps him. Kogoro initially plans to take him to the police station, but Satsuki decides to make Yuto sign a contract not to bother her again, although after he leaves, she tears up the contract, thinking that it might continue.

He yells angrily at him to be careful with hawks. Later, they are at Takehara Cafe, a cafe managed by Genichi Takehara and his wife Satoko, where a festival is being held. They also meet a local farmer called Masahiko Ishima who made puffed rice. The cafe owner later goes hunting boar. The main event of the festival is sending the hawk to a target. When the hawk is arriving to the target, the hawk suddenly falls down and a gunshot is heard. They found Genichi Takehara dead.

suspects: Tetsu Akashiba, Satoko Takehara, and Masahiko Ishima

summary.en: In an abandoned house, Ayumi, Mitsuhiko, and Genta are playing a horror story using store nude mannequins, but Ayumi repeatedly blows the mood because her fear always makes way for amusement at the sight of Mitsuhiko and Genta wielding mannequin arms. They become alarmed, however, when in one of the next rooms they hear glass shattering, and upon investigating, they witness two men calling each other Kurata and Suzuki arguing: Suzuki, apparently wishing to ditch the transportation company he's working for in favor of a better salary, has already diverted some of his company's loyal customers to their rival, Sanada Transportation. The argument quickly escalates into a fight, and while the Detective Boys are at a loss about what to do, one of the men soon lies dead.

The woman gets angry, as Genta calls her aunt, but quickly apologizes afterward, with Genta also apologizing to her. Then they have a fun football game together until the lightning strikes, the woman then waves goodbye to the boys while she is waiting for someone.

resolution.en: The culprit is Sanpei Kokuri. The motive was that Hotta used his late sister's corpse for his show. A few years ago Kokuri's sister committed suicide in the mountains due to a break-up. But her body was never found. Later Hotta was making a show in the mountain (most likely in connection with a missing person case, that Conan and Kogorō discussed in the taxi) and 'found' the body claiming to have 'felt' its spirit. Kokuri realized that Hotta must have found his sister's body a long time ago, but instead of reporting it to the police, he had buried it to use it in his show. So he killed Hotta in revenge for having humiliated her.

title.en: The Suspected Infidelity of the Triple Collab
title.ja: トリプルコラボの浮気疑惑 (Toripuru korabo no Uwaki Giwaku)

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Yasuko Aijima. Yasuko killed Tokumi with poison that she ended up consuming with the fruit cream puff she ate.

motive.quote: Yasuko knew which chair Tokumi would sit on because in every group photo they’ve ever taken, Tokumi always stood on the right, believing that she looked better from that angle.

method.quote: Yasuko killed Tokumi with poison that she ended up consuming with the fruit cream puff she ate.

evidence.quote: His girlfriend was revealed to be Yasuko and after his relationship was exposed to the public, his reputation was ruined and he found it harder to produce music and get more sponsors.

motive.zhHans: Yasuko 知道 Tokumi 会坐哪把椅子，因为在他们拍过的每一张合照里，Tokumi 总是站在右边，认为从那个角度看自己更好看。事后，江户川柯南（Conan Edogawa）向灰原哀（Ai Haibara）透露，千叶和伸（Kazunobu Chiba）、白鸟任三郎（Ninzaburo Shiratori）、Shukichi、Naeko、Kobayashi 和 Yumi 一直在那家餐厅碰面的原因，是三个女孩告诉了自己的男友，她们 8 日要碰面参加一个特别活动。当 Yasuko 提到 Sumika 与另一支乐队出轨时，Yumi 和 Naeko 立刻看向千叶和伸和白鸟任三郎。在 Kobayashi、Yumi 和 Naeko 谈起她们都熟悉的那张王牌之后，江户川柯南打了个喷嚏，随后灰原哀希望案子能尽快解决，这样她就能知道这三对情侣的戏码如何收场。
motive.en: Yasuko knew which chair Tokumi would sit on because in every group photo they’ve ever taken, Tokumi always stood on the right, believing that she looked better from that angle. Aftermath Conan reveals to Haibara that the reason why Chiba, Shiratori, Shukichi, Naeko, Kobayashi, and Yumi had been meeting at that diner was because the three girls told their boyfriends about meeting on the 8th for a special event. When Yasuko mentioned that Sumika cheated with another band, Yumi and Naeko immediately look at Chiba and Shiratori. Conan sneezing after Kobayashi, Yumi, and Naeko talked about their ace-in-the-hold that they are all familiar with, followed by Haibara hoping the case can be solved soon so that she could know how the three-couple drama ends.

method.zhHans: Yasuko 用毒杀死了 Tokumi，而那毒最终随着 Tokumi 吃下的水果奶油泡芙被她自己吃了下去。Yasuko 实际上在 Tokumi 最初坐的那把椅子上下了毒，还故意把椅子弄得摇晃不稳。但这样做之后，Tokumi 的手上就沾到了毒。在把那把有毒的椅子与旁边桌子的椅子调换之后，那把有毒的椅子因为位于另一张桌子，现在会被认为与谋杀无关，被检查是否下毒的可能性也就更小。她还通过预订那张桌子，确保一行人会坐在放有毒椅子的那张桌子旁。
method.en: Yasuko killed Tokumi with poison that she ended up consuming with the fruit cream puff she ate. Yasuko had actually poisoned the first chair Tokumi was sitting on and also purposely made it wobbly. But by doing so, Tokumi had gotten the poison on her hands. After swapping the poisoned chair with the chair at the table beside, the poisoned chair, being at a different table, would now be considered irrelevant to the murder and there is less chance it would be checked for poison. She also made sure that the group would sit at the table with poisoned chair by reserving that table for the group.

evidence.zhHans: 他的女友被揭露是 Yasuko，而在他的恋情被公开之后，他的名声被毁，他也发现更难制作音乐、更难拉到赞助。然而令她震惊的是，那名粉丝透露，她是从 Tokumi 那里得知 Kenya 的下落的。
evidence.en: His girlfriend was revealed to be Yasuko and after his relationship was exposed to the public, his reputation was ruined and he found it harder to produce music and get more sponsors. However, to her shock, the fan revealed that she had learned about Kenya's whereabouts from Tokumi.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Yasuko Aijima。Yasuko 用毒杀死了 Tokumi，而那毒最终随着 Tokumi 吃下的水果奶油泡芙被她自己吃了下去。Yasuko 实际上在 Tokumi 最初坐的那把椅子上下了毒，还故意把椅子弄得摇晃不稳。当 Tokumi 注意到椅子摇晃时，她会以为自己的体重把椅子弄坏了，于是会偷偷地换到另一把椅子上。当灯光为一个小女孩的生日庆祝蛋糕而熄灭时，Tokumi 开始换椅子，她抓住椅子底部，把椅子紧贴着自己的腿和臀部，这样就避免了拖动椅子发出的声响。但这样做之后，Tokumi 的手上就沾到了毒。在把那把有毒的椅子与旁边桌子的椅子调换之后，那把有毒的椅子因为位于另一张桌子，现在会被认为与谋杀无关，被检查是否下毒的可能性也就更小。
resolution.en: The culprit is Yasuko Aijima. Yasuko killed Tokumi with poison that she ended up consuming with the fruit cream puff she ate. Yasuko had actually poisoned the first chair Tokumi was sitting on and also purposely made it wobbly. When Tokumi notices the wobbliness, she'll think that her weight had broke the chair, and would sneakily try to swap to a different chair. When the lights went out for a little girl’s birthday celebration cake, Tokumi begin swapping her chair by grabbing the bottom while having it pressed against her legs and bottom, in this way avoiding the sounds created from dragging a chair. But by doing so, Tokumi had gotten the poison on her hands. After swapping the poisoned chair with the chair at the table beside, the poisoned chair, being at a different table, would now be considered irrelevant to the murder and there is less chance it would be checked for poison.

motive.en: Yamada killed Asuka because Asuka had discovered that he was a fraud who wanted to expand the business with the extra money he'd saved by buying cheap wine that he served as expensive vintage to the restaurant clients. Other hints to Yamada's faked profession as a sommelier were provided when: Yamada did not sniff the cork of the wine bottle he had served Higo and Yoko, something a real sommelier always does in order to find out whether the wine has been spoiled by the residue of the chemicals used in making the bottle corks, and the fact that the cigarettes found in the toilet were of the same brand, but smoked in two different ways, proving that they were consumed by two different people. Yamada thus attempted to conceal his habit of smoking (a taboo for a sommelier, since his profession heavily depends on an unspoiled sense of taste) by mixing his own cigarette stubs with the ones used by Konoe.

method.zhHans: Yamada 在第二次搜寻时下到储藏室，杀死了 Asuka，随后用 Higo 和 Asuka 的手机发消息，将 Asuka 引诱到僻静处实施谋杀。接着 Yamada 用吸尘器、真空压缩袋、Asuka 的衣服以及他侍酒师刀具上的开瓶器，假装 Asuka 在案发时以及员工搜寻他时显然还活着（从而为自己建立不在场证明）：他先从真空袋中抽出所有空气，再用刀上的开瓶器刺破袋子，使空气涌入并使袋子鼓起，在毯子下方瞬间形成一个假人。为了提供这个手法的证据，Ai 从厨房的垃圾桶里拿到了 Higo 扔掉的手机和真空袋，上面布满了 Yamada 的指纹。其他暴露 Yamada 侍酒师身份造假的线索包括：Yamada 没有嗅闻他端给 Higo 和 Yoko 的那瓶酒的软木塞，而真正的侍酒师总会这样做，以检查酒是否被制造软木塞所用化学物质的残留污染；以及在卫生间里发现的香烟是同一品牌，却有两种不同的吸法，证明它们是由两个不同的人抽的。Yamada 因此试图隐瞒自己抽烟的习惯（这对侍酒师是禁忌，因为该职业在很大程度上依赖于完好的味觉），把自己的烟蒂和 Konoe 用过的烟蒂混在一起。
method.en: Yamada killed Asuka during the second search when he went down to the storage room, then used Higo's and Asuka's phones to send a message to lure Asuka to a secluded spot for the murder. Using a vacuum cleaner, a vacuum compression bag, Asuka's clothes, and the corkscrew from his sommelier's knife, Yamada then pretended that Asuka was apparently still alive at the time of the murder and during his employees' search for him (thus establishing his alibi): By first sucking out all the air from the vacuum bag, then puncturing the bag with the corkscrew from his knife, caused the air to rush in and inflate the bag, creating an instant dummy beneath the blankets. To provide the evidence for that trick, Ai secures Higo's discarded phone and the vacuum bags from the kitchen's waste bin, which are riddled with Yamada's fingerprints. Other hints to Yamada's faked profession as a sommelier were provided when: Yamada did not sniff the cork of the wine bottle he had served Higo and Yoko, something a real sommelier always does in order to find out whether the wine has been spoiled by the residue of the chemicals used in making the bottle corks, and the fact that the cigarettes found in the toilet were of the same brand, but smoked in two different ways, proving that they were consumed by two different people. culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Tomoko Hirota. Conan figures out the truth and traps her by hiding nearby waiting for her to return to Kanae's house at night and asks her: «Why're you here so late». He then tells her that they found out who really killed Kanae. She murdered Kanae before 8am that morning after Kanae finished preparing her breakfast.

motive.quote: Conan told them that he was right but that Kogoro couldn't come because so he brought the kids there.

method.quote: After that, she left Shinpei's bandana which she prepared earlier by the front door and went for a walk with Matsunosuke disguised as Kanae to create eyewitness that Kanae walked Matsunosuke that day establishing her alibi.

evidence.quote: He then tells her that they found out who really killed Kanae.

motive.zhHans: 江户川柯南告诉他们他是对的，但毛利小五郎来不了，所以他把孩子们带到了那里。她抗议说，牵引绳上拴着的狗是她的，但那其实是 Matsunosuke，因为小岛元太喊它去接飞盘，而只有 Matsunosuke 会追着飞盘跑。
motive.en: Conan told them that he was right but that Kogoro couldn't come because so he brought the kids there. She protests and says the dog tied to her leash is hers but it is in fact Matsunosuke because Genta yells him to come get the frisbee and only Matsunosuke would run after it.

method.zhHans: 在那之后，她把事先准备好的 Shinpei 的头巾留在了前门口，然后带着 Matsunosuke 伪装成 Kanae 去散步，制造目击者看到 Kanae 当天遛了 Matsunosuke 的假象，从而确立自己的不在场证明。如果她走完整条路线，就无法确立不在场证明了。所以，她直接带着 Matsunosuke 回到自己家，并遇到一个被她叫住的人，以此完成不在场证明。Hirota 回答说没有证据，但江户川柯南立刻打断了她，指出证据就在她旁边：被她调包的那只狗，真正的 Matsunosuke。
method.en: After that, she left Shinpei's bandana which she prepared earlier by the front door and went for a walk with Matsunosuke disguised as Kanae to create eyewitness that Kanae walked Matsunosuke that day establishing her alibi. If she'd walked the whole route, she wouldn't be able to establish her alibi. So, she directly went back to her house with Matsunosuke and met with someone she called out to complete her alibi. Hirota replies by saying there is no proof but Conan immediately stops her and points to the proof right by her side: the dog she swapped, the real Matsunosuke.

evidence.zhHans: 然后他告诉她，他们已经查出真正杀死 Kanae 的人是谁了。她本来很容易就会被发现，但她靠着带着那只狗骗过了所有人。正如 Tomoko 所说，她带着 Matsunosuke 的兄弟，这与证据吻合。Hirota 回答说没有证据，但江户川柯南立刻打断了她，指出证据就在她旁边：被她调包的那只狗，真正的 Matsunosuke。
evidence.en: He then tells her that they found out who really killed Kanae. She could've been found really easily but fooled everyone by having the dog with her. As Tomoko said, she had Matsunosuke's brother which coincide with the evidence. Hirota replies by saying there is no proof but Conan immediately stops her and points to the proof right by her side: the dog she swapped, the real Matsunosuke.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Tomoko Hirota。江户川柯南推理出真相并设下陷阱，躲在附近等她深夜回到 Kanae 的房子，然后问她：«你怎么这么晚还在这里»。接着他告诉她，他们已经查出真正杀死 Kanae 的人是谁了。那天早上在 Kanae 准备好早餐之后、8 点之前，她杀死了 Kanae。然后，她清理掉 Kanae 准备好的早餐，穿上刚从干洗店取回来的外套，让人以为她是在遛狗之后被杀的。在那之后，她把事先准备好的 Shinpei 的头巾留在了前门口，然后带着 Matsunosuke 伪装成 Kanae 去散步，制造目击者看到 Kanae 当天遛了 Matsunosuke 的假象。
resolution.en: The culprit is Tomoko Hirota. Conan figures out the truth and traps her by hiding nearby waiting for her to return to Kanae's house at night and asks her: «Why're you here so late». He then tells her that they found out who really killed Kanae. She murdered Kanae before 8am that morning after Kanae finished preparing her breakfast. Then, she cleaned away the breakfast she prepared and put on her coat that had just come back from the cleaners to make it look like she had been killed after walking her dog. After that, she left Shinpei's bandana which she prepared earlier by the front door and went for a walk with Matsunosuke disguised as Kanae to create eyewitness that Kanae walked Matsunosuke that day establishing her alibi.

summary.en: Conan and his friends were playing Frisbee at the park, when a dog named Matsunosuke launched off of Conan's head and caught the Frisbee. Matsunosuke's owner, Kanae Asakawa, apologized and took Conan's jacket in order to get it cleaned after Matsunosuke left dirt all over it. The next day when Conan and the Detective Boys arrived at her house to get the jacket they met Kanae's friend Tomoko and see Matsunosuke in his dog house, asleep.

Later they witness an arguing couples who then leaves. They then set up the tent in the couple's area. Later, the couple returns demanding their place back and the girlfriend decides to let them have it. Later Ran is drugged and kidnapped.

Jinpei Matsuda deduced the bomb's location and realizes that the bomb contains a clue to an even larger bomb and that the clue is only revealed during the last three seconds before detonation; Matsuda sacrifices his life and allowed the police to locate the second bomb. In the present time, the bomber returns and sends a fax to the Police station.

summary.en: This time Kogoro's client turned out to be a lady who had just recently lost her husband; according to herself, her husband, Yutaka Nemoto, died in a traffic accident three months ago. However, when she was going over her late husband's belongings, she noticed a big stack of bank notes, summing up to 20 million Japanese yen (that's about 134 thousand US dollars) in total. She also called Nemoto a "tragic genius", since he was fairly good in baseball competitions and achieved quite a success, but injured himself right before playing within Koshien Stadium; he also developed himself amongst the racing aspect, but he encountered an accident and was forced to retire; he also attempted to become a competitive eater, but unfortunately, he ended up in the hospital when he was supposed to compete in the world championship... Therefore, Nemoto had lots of trophies and souvenirs regarding his splendid career experiences but never managed to reach the top for each of them. Thereafter, he went into despair and was considering committing crime activities... until he met the lady, Eriko Nemoto. Despite undertaking numerous obstacles, they still managed to make a change and were successfully married to each other. They have been married for nine years, and they took one photo for each year, which can be seen in the lady's home. She wondered if her husband had been committing a crime before the car accident, and thus she would want Kogoro to investigate the source of the 20 million yen she found earlier.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Tatsuhiko Kido。证据是粘在犯人和被害人身上油漆的气味。两人在一张刚涂过漆的长椅旁扭打，未干的油漆粘在了他们身上。逃跑的犯人试图把被害人从自己的车上甩掉时，被害人的纽扣被扯了下来。那名男子被甩到地上，头部撞上了长椅。随后，那人下楼梯前往下方的空地去打出租车追赶他。进一步的证据是，被害人的指纹与在犯人车窗上发现的指纹相符。
resolution.en: The culprit is Tatsuhiko Kido. The proof is the smell of the paint stuck to the culprit and the victim. The two of them fought near a freshly painted bench, and the wet paint stuck to them. As the fleeing culprit tried to shake off the victim from his car, the victim's button tore off. The man was thrown to the ground and hit his head on the bench. Then, the man descended the stairs to the vacant lot below to get a taxi to chase after him. As further evidence, the victim's fingerprints match to the fingerprints found on the culprit's car window.

Accidentally, Genta used excessive strength to kick the football, which led the ball to land midst the bush. Ayumi thus went inside to fetch the football. And luckily, she found the ball effortless, but just as she raised her head to observe the vincinity, she was utterly astounded - right next to the fallen football, there was a rather "fresh" corpse lying on the ground...

The truck soon arrives with the fireflies and they are released into the fields. Later one of the truck drivers, Tokuro Nakamine, is found murdered and three of the villagers are the prime suspects.

title.ja: 20年目の殺意 シンフォニー号連続殺人事件 (Nijūnenme no Satsui Shinfoniigō Renzoku Satsujin Jiken)
title.zhHans: 二十年的杀意——交响曲连续杀人事件

culpritSource.quote: The murderer/culprit is Sadao Kujirai. He entered the ship as an old man to create an illusion that Kanou, the Organizer of the Shadows, was on board. He then proceeded with his plans and invited Teruyoshi Kameda to the maintenance room where he was killed. He hid the body in a box at the rear of the ship. He then came back to the group and arranged a meeting with Korehisa Kanie, who he drugged. He took Kanie's watch and clothes and placed them on Kameda to make it appear that Kanie was the burned corpse.

motive.quote: Since then, Ebina had been trying to find the robbers and planned to use a bomb to kill all of them in revenge for killing his beloved Yoshimi.

method.quote: It appeared as though Kujirai had been shot in the arm, though that was also a set up by Kujirai who had shot himself earlier when he killed Kanie.

evidence.quote: It was revealed that Nagisa Isogai is Kanou's daughter and that Minoru Ebina was romantically involved with Toji Samezaki's daughter, Yoshimi, who was shot and killed during the robbery twenty years ago, and whom Samezaki recognizes as a young man who was sobbing uncontrollably all through her funeral.

motive.zhHans: 此后，Ebina 一直在寻找那伙劫匪，并打算用炸弹把他们全部炸死，为他心爱的 Yoshimi 复仇。在他、Kanie 和 Kameda 杀害 Saizo Kano 之后，他杀害同伙的动机是独吞劫匪抢来的全部钱款，并报复已死的 Kano——Kano 曾羞辱过 Kujirai、把他当成傻瓜。Samezaki 指出，Kujirai 之所以失败，是因为他在抢劫案追诉时效刚过就动手杀人，结果除了原来的抢劫罪，如今还要为杀人罪负被捕之责。Samezaki 又说，Kujirai 从来没有赢过 Saizo Kano 的可能——他被骗了整整二十年。此外还注意到，Kujirai 用香烟来布置各种机关，例如烧掉旗帜等场景。
motive.en: Since then, Ebina had been trying to find the robbers and planned to use a bomb to kill all of them in revenge for killing his beloved Yoshimi. After he, Kanie, and Kameda murdered Saizo Kano, his motive for killing his accomplices was to usurp all the money the robbers stole and to spite the dead Kano, who had humiliated Kujirai and viewed him as an idiot. Samezaki reveals that Kujirai failed because committing murders right after the statute of limitations for the robbery expired makes him now liable for arrest for murder in addition to the original robbery. Samezaki then said that Kujirai never had a chance to win over Saizo Kano, since he had been fooled for twenty years. Also noted is Kujirai's use of cigarettes in order to accomplish the set-ups, such as the burning flag and other scenarios.

method.zhHans: 表面上 Kujirai 手臂中了一枪，但那也是他自导自演——他在杀害 Kanie 时先朝自己开了一枪。Samezaki 指出，报纸上用的那个化名其实就是「Saizo Kano」这几个字把汉字倒过来写的。他脱掉了身上所有衣物以免溺水，只留下裤子与和叶做的护身符，并用手电筒发出灯光信号。
method.en: It appeared as though Kujirai had been shot in the arm, though that was also a set up by Kujirai who had shot himself earlier when he killed Kanie. Samezaki reveals that the alias used in the paper was in fact the name Saizo Kano, if it, written in kanji, was turned around. He took off all of his clothes to stop himself from drowning, save for his pants and the charm made by Kazuha, and used a flashlight to make light signals.

evidence.zhHans: 经揭示，Nagisa Isogai 是 Kano 的女儿；而 Minoru Ebina 与 Toji Samezaki 的女儿 Yoshimi 有过恋情，Yoshimi 在二十年前的抢劫案中被枪杀，Samezaki 认出他就是葬礼上从头哭到尾的那个年轻人。所幸炸弹被柯南发现，并在距船 100 码处被引爆。平次无意中发现了 Kanie 的尸体，Kujirai 因此想杀他，平次被抛入海中。最终揭示，平次被抛入海中后活了下来。
evidence.en: It was revealed that Nagisa Isogai is Kanou's daughter and that Minoru Ebina was romantically involved with Toji Samezaki's daughter, Yoshimi, who was shot and killed during the robbery twenty years ago, and whom Samezaki recognizes as a young man who was sobbing uncontrollably all through her funeral. Fortunately, the bomb was discovered by Conan and was detonated 100 yards from the ship. Heiji had inadvertently found Kanie's body, and Kujirai tried to kill him as a result Heiji was thrown overboard. In the end, it is revealed that Heiji survived being tossed into the sea.

resolution.zhHans: 最终，在目睹一场爆炸、并发现两具尸体之后，柯南解开案件，意识到犯人有两人：一人是炸弹犯，一人是杀人犯。经揭示，Nagisa Isogai 是 Kano 的女儿；而 Minoru Ebina 与 Toji Samezaki 的女儿 Yoshimi 有过恋情，Yoshimi 在二十年前的抢劫案中被枪杀，Samezaki 认出他就是葬礼上从头哭到尾的那个年轻人。此后，Ebina 一直在寻找那伙劫匪，并打算用炸弹把他们全部炸死，为他心爱的 Yoshimi 复仇。所幸炸弹被柯南发现，并在距船 100 码处被引爆。
resolution.en: In the end, after witnessing a bombing and discovering two dead bodies, Conan solves the case, realizing there were two separate culprits: one as the bomber, and one as the murderer. It was revealed that Nagisa Isogai is Kanou's daughter and that Minoru Ebina was romantically involved with Toji Samezaki's daughter, Yoshimi, who was shot and killed during the robbery twenty years ago, and whom Samezaki recognizes as a young man who was sobbing uncontrollably all through her funeral. Since then, Ebina had been trying to find the robbers and planned to use a bomb to kill all of them in revenge for killing his beloved Yoshimi. Fortunately, the bomb was discovered by Conan and was detonated 100 yards from the ship.

summary.en: A man known as the Organizer of the Shadows is shot to death by his three subordinates. Twenty years later, Conan helps Ran and Kogoro solve a puzzle for which the prize is an all-expense-paid trip on a giant boat built for a small number of people. After eleven people have entered the boat, the boat sets sail. Kogoro meets an inspector that he used to work with on the boat and finds that Heij is on the boat as well. After a passenger is murdered, they learn that a man named Saizou Kanou, the Organizer of the Shadows, is on the boat.

suspects: Toji Samezaki, Minoru Ebina, Sadao Kujirai, and Nagisa Isogai

Kogoro then receives a call from Inspector Megure who reveals that a bomber called the police station to tell them a bomb was placed on Kogoro's car and will detonate when his speed goes below 20 km/h. Kogoro concludes the man who gave him the deal is the bomber.

title.ja: 不運で不審な被害者 (Fu'un de Fushin'na Higaisha)

summary.en: Inside the Doterasu Shrine, a lad named Jupita Okamoto seemed to be praying for something. Just as he was about to leave, he encountered a pungent, robbery thief who had a knife held in their hand, provoking Jupita to hand them all of his money. Jupita got scared and started to run in the opposite direction, towards the staircase that leads to the exit of the shrine, going down. The thief then swiftly gripped Jupita's wallet and cut the iron chain attached to it, attempting to steal the wallet. With a slight kick from the thief, Jupita fell off the stone staircase from the shrine.

suspects: Juria Okamoto, Kotaro Saimon, Ren Mizutani, and Yuzuru Kariba
suspectsZh: 冈本朱里亚、西门前太郎、水谷莲与刈叶让

title.ja: 仲の悪いガールズバンド (Naka no Warui Gāruzu Bando?)

However Conan, Amuro, and Masumi reveal that the weapon has already left the studio. The police carried it out because it was one of the victims belongings. The murderer had taken her knit hat and unraveled it and used it as the murder weapon and then knitted it back together using the drumsticks. Amuro reveals that the culprit is Rumi Kogure. motive.quote: The police carried it out because it was one of the victims belongings.

method.quote: The murderer had taken her knit hat and unraveled it and used it as the murder weapon and then knitted it back together using the drumsticks.

evidence.quote: However Conan, Amuro, and Masumi reveal that the weapon has already left the studio.

motive.zhHans: 警方执行了搬运，因为那是被害人的遗物之一。Rumi 只需把键盘往远离架子鼓的方向移动一点，好让其他人把自拍杆移到监控摄像头前面。被害人相信自己要为 Akane 的死负责，不是因为她严厉批评了她的声音，而是因为她和 Akane 约定在声音好转之前不出声。这就是 Akane 冲上马路而不是喊叫的原因，因为喊叫会伤到她的嗓子。事故（过去）地点：公路交叉口被害人：Akane Shuto死因：被车撞死案件结束后，世良向兰和园子透露，她之所以成为侦探，是因为她的大哥 Shuichi，他是一名 FBI 探员。
motive.en: The police carried it out because it was one of the victims belongings. Rumi just had to move the keyboard further away from the drums so that the others would have moved the selfie stick to in front of the cctv camera. The victim had believed that she was responsible for Akane's death, not because of her harsh words about her voice, but because she had made a deal with her not to speak until her voice had gotten better. This was why Akane ran into the road rather then shouting, because it would hurt her voice. Accident (Past) Location: Highway Intersection Victim: Akane Shuto Cause of death: Hit by a car After the case, Masumi revealed to Ran and Sonoko that the reason she became a detective was because of her oldest brother Shuichi, who is an FBI agent.

method.zhHans: 凶手把她的针织帽拆开，用拆开的毛线作为凶器，然后用鼓棒把帽子重新织回去。

Accident (Past) Location: Highway Intersection Victim: Akane Shuto Cause of death: Hit by a car After the case, Masumi revealed to Ran and Sonoko that the reason she became a detective was because of her oldest brother Shuichi, who is an FBI agent.

resolution.zhHans: 警方已经检查过所有形似线的物品，并进行了鲁米诺测试。然而柯南、安室和世良揭露，凶器已经离开了录音室。警方执行了搬运，因为那是被害人的遗物之一。凶手把她的针织帽拆开，用拆开的毛线作为凶器，然后用鼓棒把帽子重新织回去。安室揭露犯人就是 Rumi Kogure。另外两名嫌疑人进入房间是为了做一些不可能事先计划的事情。而 Rumi 据称是背对镜头演奏键盘，没有人看得见她在做什么。她一直在偷偷把帽子织回去。由于架子鼓固定不动，自拍杆摄像头的位置取决于键盘的位置。Rumi 只需把键盘往远离架子鼓的方向移动一点，好让其他人把自拍杆移到监控摄像头前面。她还在被害人的水瓶里下了安眠药，以确保被害人处于熟睡状态。
resolution.en: The police have already checked all of the items that resemble string and have tested for luminol. However Conan, Amuro, and Masumi reveal that the weapon has already left the studio. The police carried it out because it was one of the victims belongings. The murderer had taken her knit hat and unraveled it and used it as the murder weapon and then knitted it back together using the drumsticks. Amuro reveals that the culprit is Rumi Kogure. The other two suspects had gone into the room to do things that couldn't have been planned. Where as Rumi was supposedly playing her keyboard with her back to the camera where no one could see what she was doing. She had secretly been knitting the hat back together. With the drums fixed in place, the placement of the selfie stick camera would be dependent on the position of the keyboard. Rumi just had to move the keyboard further away from the drums so that the others would have moved the selfie stick to in front of the cctv camera. She has also spiked the victims water bottle with sleeping pills to ensure that she was asleep.

title.en: The Unknown Gunshot That Rings in the Dark
title.ja: 闇に響く謎の銃声 (Yami ni Hibiku Nazo no Juusei)
title.zhHans: 黑暗中响起的莫名枪声

summary.en:
Kogoro is invited to a house as a way to impress a client's mother. The mother, a powerful finance trader, is murdered and the suspects are her second son, her first daughter, and the maid.

Location: Furukawa household

suspects: Azusa Machida, Koji Furukawa, and Etsuko Furukawa
suspectsZh: 町田梓、古川浩司与古川悦子

title.ja: 見えない容疑者 (Mienai Yōgisha)
割れない雪だるま (Warenai Yukidaruma)
誰にもとけない氷の罠 (Darenimo Tokenai Kōri no Wana)

summary.en: At the Ice Festival in Yamakawa Village, under Shibata jurisdiction, Niigata Prefecture, Conan, Haibara, Professor Agasa, and the Detective Boys are having a great time together. While in the festival, they meet the chairman of the executive committee of the Ice Festival named Mika Itakura. Her father, the former village head, was Agasa's old friend but unfortunately, he died in a car accident last year. While the detective boys and the others are walking together, they meet the ice engraver named Tetsuya Shiota who made an awesome ice sculptures. The Detective Boys are really impressed at him when he built an ice sculpture of a bear while using a chain saw. The people in the village also made an awesome work of the ice festival. Until sudden, the village head named Tarou Yamaguchi and the secretary named Kazuyuki Ogi appear and they both say that they are going to remove the ice sculptures so the hotels are going to be built soon. Yamaguchi has already signed the contract which make Mika and Shiota disappointed. Suddenly, the main gate collapses which makes Yamaguchi decide to cancel the festival but Mika and Shiota along with the other villagers insist on rebuilding it.

suspects: Mika Itakura, Tetsuya Shiota, and Kazuyuki Ogi
suspectsZh: 板仓美香、盐田哲也与小木一之

culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Atsufumi Fukamachi.

motive.quote: The real reason Amuro had remembered Elena was because the truth of the case resembled his behavior when he'd injure himself intentionally so he could go to the clinic Elena worked at.

Yusaku introduces himself as the owner of the house and invites Amuro for tea since, unlike the previous time, his comrades are not surrounding the house.

method.zhHans: 案件结束后，Amuro 用兰的钥匙的复制钥匙进入了工藤家。

Yuri also makes a successful recovery. The real reason Amuro had remembered Elena was because the truth of the case resembled his behavior when he'd injure himself intentionally so he could go to the clinic Elena worked at.

title.ja: 言えないアリバイ (Ienai Aribai)
title.zhHans: 未说出口的不在场证明

summary.en: Cona, Haibara, and the Detective Boys are going out, when they see a police officer. An old lady admits that ahe was pushed by a strange young woman from the stairs. However, there is no one who witness the incident.

title.ja: 消えたおまわりさん (Kieta Omawarisan)

summary.en: Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys run into Ayumi's neighbor, Yasuyo Akimoto, who is searching for a kind bearded policemen, who she ran into multiple times last week. At the police station, they reveal they do not have an officer like that and it was against police regulation to have facial hair. The police assume that the officer was linked to a serial burglary, however Akimoto and an elderly couple disagree claiming the officer was too kind and gentle to be the burglar.

title.ja: 腹話術師の錯覚 (Fukuwajutsushi no Sakkaku?)

culpritSource.quote: The real culprit is Riichi Tengan. The motive was obviously the affair between his wife and Togawa, which had injured his personal pride.

motive.quote: The motive was obviously the affair between his wife and Togawa, which had injured his personal pride.

method.quote: In order to make it appear that Togawa wanted to drive him into insanity, Tengan stole the speakers and recorder from Togawa and planted them inside his own house to be easily found.

evidence.quote: In order to make it appear that Togawa wanted to drive him into insanity, Tengan stole the speakers and recorder from Togawa and planted them inside his own house to be easily found.

motive.zhHans: 动机显然是他的妻子与 Togawa 之间的外遇，这伤了他的个人自尊。为了让人以为 Togawa 想把他逼疯，Tengan 从 Togawa 那里偷走了扬声器和录音机，并把它们安放在自己家里，以便被轻易发现。
motive.en: The motive was obviously the affair between his wife and Togawa, which had injured his personal pride. In order to make it appear that Togawa wanted to drive him into insanity, Tengan stole the speakers and recorder from Togawa and planted them inside his own house to be easily found.

method.zhHans: 为了让人以为 Togawa 想把他逼疯，Tengan 从 Togawa 那里偷走了扬声器和录音机，并把它们安放在自己家里，以便被轻易发现。决定性的证据是 Togawa 的眼镜，Tengan 用 Kazuko 的血浸透了它，然后把它塞进 Togawa 的包里。在陈述事实之前，Conan 另外在木偶上藏了两只假手套，使 Tengan 不由自主地脱口供认，从而彻底粉碎了他的不在场证明。
method.en: In order to make it appear that Togawa wanted to drive him into insanity, Tengan stole the speakers and recorder from Togawa and planted them inside his own house to be easily found. The decisive pieces of evidence are Togawa's glasses Tengan had drenched with Kazuko's blood and then planted inside Togawa's bag. Before his presentation of the facts, Conan additionally hid two fake gloves on the puppet, making Tengan burst out with an involuntary confession and thus completely shattering his alibi.

evidence.zhHans: 为了让人以为 Togawa 想把他逼疯，Tengan 从 Togawa 那里偷走了扬声器和录音机，并把它们安放在自己家里，以便被轻易发现。决定性的证据是 Togawa 的眼镜，Tengan 用 Kazuko 的血浸透了它，然后把它塞进 Togawa 的包里。在此过程中，眼镜沾上了 Tengan 手套的一些纤维，鉴识人员发现它们粘在眼镜框上。但 Conan 推断出了它们的藏匿之处，经检验，在木偶上发现了带有 Kazuko 的血和 Tengan 的汗液的手套纤维痕迹。
evidence.en: In order to make it appear that Togawa wanted to drive him into insanity, Tengan stole the speakers and recorder from Togawa and planted them inside his own house to be easily found. The decisive pieces of evidence are Togawa's glasses Tengan had drenched with Kazuko's blood and then planted inside Togawa's bag. In the process, the glasses had caught some fibers from Tengan's gloves, which were found clinging to the glasses' frame by the forensics. But Conan has deduced their hiding place, and by having it examined, traces of the gloves' fibers with Kazuko's blood and Tengan's sweat were found on the puppet.

resolution.zhHans: 真正的犯人是 Riichi Tengan。动机显然是他的妻子与 Togawa 之间的外遇，这伤了他的个人自尊。为了让人以为 Togawa 想把他逼疯，Tengan 从 Togawa 那里偷走了扬声器和录音机，并把它们安放在自己家里，以便被轻易发现。此外，开场时表演的突然改变，是为了进一步“证实”他在雇佣 Kogoro 的时候就已经被逼疯了。这一切都是为了先让自己蒙受嫌疑，然后再通过把罪名嫁祸给自己的徒弟、并以“被诱导的”分裂人格为由主张无罪，来使自己脱罪。
resolution.en: The real culprit is Riichi Tengan. The motive was obviously the affair between his wife and Togawa, which had injured his personal pride. In order to make it appear that Togawa wanted to drive him into insanity, Tengan stole the speakers and recorder from Togawa and planted them inside his own house to be easily found. In addition, the sudden change of the act in the opening scene was meant to further "confirm" that he was already driven into insanity by the time he hired Kogoro. This was all meant to initially cast suspicion on himself, only to have him cleared by both pinning the blame on his apprentice and claiming innocence by reason of his "induced" split personality.

title.ja: 戻って来た被害者 (Modotte Kita Higaisha)

summary.en:
The Detective Boys while walking around town hear a woman in an apartment scream. They investigate the source of the screaming and find a dead old woman stuffed inside of a sofa.

Location: Apartment

Victim: Old lady

title.ja: 被害者はクドウシンイチ (Higaisha wa Kudō Shin'ichi)

summary.en:
Heiji was invited to go to a real demon dog extermination, and invites Conan, Kogoro, and Ran to come with him and Kazuha.

Five years ago, the womanizing chairman of the Inubushi group, Tsunechika Inubushi, died of terminal cancer. Due to his past habits, several people appeared, claiming to be related to Inubushi by presenting a picture of their mother with the president. Without the president or their mothers to confirm whether the claims were true or not, it became impossible to confirm or deny their claims. Regardless, the president's wife took in all eight people as her own adopted children. And now, with the president's wife ill herself, the inheritance is to be divided amongst the eight children.

title.en: The Water Palace of Five Colors Legend
title.ja: 五彩伝説の水御殿 (Gosai Densetsu no Mizu Goten)

culpritSource.quote: Conan searches for clues to who murdered the headmaster and finally figures out the trick that was used: the killer swam underneath the bridge, stabbed the victim and tied him in a complicated fisherman's knot so that when the waterwheel would turn, the body would be lifted up to the ceiling onto the beam which would make it look like a suicide. The culprit is Morio Yakura. His motive for killing the headmaster was to stop him from officially announcing that his son, Ryoichi, was going to be the next headmaster. Morio claims the headmaster had betrayed him since they were selling expensive cou

summary.en: While Kogoro is sleeping from drinking too much, the Detective Boys listen to one of his messages and end up talking to Nichiuri TV newswoman Aki Asano. When she goes missing though, it's up to the Detective Boys to solve the clues she is sending them on Conan's pager.

title.en: The Wedding Reception and the Two Gunshots
title.ja: 披露宴と二つの銃声 (Hirōen to Futatsu no Jūsei)

summary.en: Sonoko must go to a wedding representing her family, and since she doesn't want to go alone, she ropes Conan and Ran into going with her. The groom Masaru is the eldest son and heir of the incredibly rich Hatakeyama family, and he's marrying a young woman named Miho. The wedding takes place in a very nice villa, and though things are going well at first. Until the end of the reception.

Yoshifumi Ito, Arisa Hatakeyama, and Rikako Ishihara

Her apartment was closed, so he asks the building manager Hayashi for a spare key to her room. When they open the room, however, she is found dead inside. The police find a cup of coffee containing cyanide, suggesting the cause of death. They also find an investigation report made by Kogoro, so he is summoned to the scene.

After three months, they open a book café that is visited by the Detective Boys and Conan.

Location: Tamaki's used bookstore

Victim: Yujiro Tamaki

Akiko even admits that even if she paid Sawada a fair share, he might of continued to blackmail her and she would end up with less money for herself. The class is held at Ryoji Nojima's house, who sponsored Omura for his books. method.zhHans: 锁上大门后，他把钥匙绑在一只甲虫身上——绳子是用纸巾搓成的——从信箱口放了下去。他在大门的地砖上铺了一件毛衣，让甲虫走起来更容易。他在模型顶部涂上能吸引雄性甲虫的气味，用来给它引路。甲虫走过桥时，钥匙掉进模型的护城河里，纸巾绳也化开了，钥匙就留在那儿。之后甲虫被窗外的光吸引，从窗户飞了出去。就这样，他做出了一个密室。
method.en: After locking the front door, he attached the key to a beetle with a string made of toilet paper and dropped it through the mail slot. He put a sweater on the front door tiles so that the beetle could walk more easily. He covered the top of the model with a scent that attracts male beetles in order to guide the beetle. As it walked across the bridge, the key fell into the model's moat and the string melted, leaving the key behind. The beetle would then fly out of the room through a window, attracted to the light outside. In this manner, he was able to create a locked room.
method.replacedEn: In this manner, he was able to create a locked room.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Yoshihiko Kido。他锁上大门后，把钥匙系在由卫生纸搓成的绳子上，绑在一只甲虫身上，从投信口投了进去。他在玄关地砖上铺了一件毛衣，好让甲虫爬得更顺；又给模型顶部涂上能吸引雄性甲虫的气味，用来引导它。甲虫走过那座“桥”时，钥匙掉进模型的护城河里，纸绳随即溶掉，钥匙便留在了那里。之后甲虫被屋外的光吸引，从窗户飞出房间。他就这样制造出了密室。证据是 Yoshihiko 的手帕，上面沾满了 Mitsue 那天下午带到公寓来的自制果汁。他事先还打扫过公寓，免得甲虫被果汁的浓烈气味引开。
resolution.en: The culprit is Yoshihiko Kido. After locking the front door, he attached the key to a beetle with a string made of toilet paper and dropped it through the mail slot. He put a sweater on the front door tiles so that the beetle could walk more easily. He covered the top of the model with a scent that attracts male beetles in order to guide the beetle. As it walked across the bridge, the key fell into the model's moat and the string melted, leaving the key behind. The beetle would then fly out of the room through a window, attracted to the light outside. In this manner, he was able to create a locked room. The proof is Yoshihiko's handkerchief, which was covered in Mitsue's homemade juice that she brought to the apartment that afternoon. While in the apartment, he had cleaned it up earlier to keep the beetle from being distracted by the juice's strong scent.

summary.en: Two days ago, some of the cyanide in the Teitan University research lab was stolen. In the present, Takagi stumbled upon a person who was holding cyanide, so he had him taken to the police station for interrogation. He then finds Conan and Kogoro walking on the street, so he comes for consultation about this particular case. Takagi mentions that the man kept looking at his watch for some reason, and that the amount of cyanide he was holding is less than the amount stolen from the lab. These two may suggest that the three still have time to prevent someone from consuming the cyanide since the target was absent when the man put the poison. The location is quickly narrowed down to buildings on their south, which is still too broad for them to find the exact target. Conan then asks Takagi for photos of the man, and one of the photos reminds Kogoro of a restaurant 500 meters away from them in the south called Namikawa.
